tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 1)༄༅/ /skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i dbang phyug zab gter rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rin po che pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa'i rnam thar snya
1)༄༅/ /skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i dbang phyug zab gter rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rin po che pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa'i rnam thar snya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i dbang phyug zab gter rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rin po che pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa'i rnam thar snying gi mun sel dad pa'i shing rta rna'i chun 'phyang ut+pa'i phreng ba bzhugs so/// / 2) ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gdod nas rnam dag sems nyid bde ba che// rig dbyings mi 'gyur kun bzang chos kyi sku// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i kun gyi bdag /dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud// rang bzhin mi 'gags yon tan lhun rdzogs pa// snang stong gnyis med rdo rje sems dpa' che// ye shes ji snyed du mar 'char ba'i gzugs// brda brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud// mkhyen gnyis shes rab ma 'gags don gyi dbyings// gsal khyab rang grol rigs gsum 'gro ba'i mgon// rig stong 3) sgyu 'phrul sems dpa' mchog gi gzugs// snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud// rigs kun yongs 'dus sangs rgyas kun dngos 'chang*// bden gnyis lam mchog dam chos rgyud sde'i mdzod// rtogs grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun kun gyi rje// mchog gsum ngo bo pad+ma saṃ bhar 'dud// rang byung pad sdong las 'khrungs mtsho skyes rje// bla med bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje 'chang*// yi dam rgya mtsho sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin// 'khor 'das mkhar sdud klong chen dgongs pa'i mdzod// 'gro ba'i mun sel gang 'dul skur bzhengs pa// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i spyi dpal mchog la 'dud// ngo bo mi 'gyur bde chen kun bzang mo// rang bzhin mi 'gags rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// thugs rje'i bdag nyid dz+nya na 4) sang ga ra// mkha' 'gro'i rje mo mkhar chen gza' la 'dud// rtsa gsum dhu ti'i 'khor lo gsum pa'i dbus// dwangs bcud 'od lnga'i thig le byang chub sems// brjod med rang gdangs bzhi ldan (nam mkha'i rlung la 'byung bzhi'i rlung 'dus pa/)

ye shes rlung*// rnam dag ngo bo sku gsum mkha' 'gror 'dud// o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje'i phrin las gar// log rtog tshar gcod badz+ra gro bo lod// bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud// byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por rol// rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// mkhyen brtse ye shes gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos// gter chen bla ma pad+ma las 'brel la// sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas rtag tu 'dud// thugs rgyud byin rlabs snying la 'phos nas kyang*// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med thugs rjes zungs// gang gis rang bzhin bde chen 'dus ma byas// gdul bya'i mos ngor gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// sna tshogs thabs kyis 5) bstan 'gro'i gsos su sman// gter chen bla ma'i mdzad pa phrin las kyi// rnam par thar pa snying gi mun sel 'di// lhag bsam dag pa'i bri ba brtsam pa yi// chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gnang ba stsol// de la 'dir o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje dang dngos zhal mi gnyis pa klong chen rdo rje gzi brjid pad+ma las 'brel rtsal lam rig 'dzin pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa de nyid bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs nas mdzad pa tshul bzhi dang mthun pa'i bstan 'gro'i gsos su sman pa ni/ thog mar phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams dwangs ba 'dren pa dang yid ches rnyed pa'i phyir du/ sngon byon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi lung gi bsngags pa'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ pad ma dbang rgyal gter lung gab sbas yang byang las/ klong chen sprul pa gsang sngags ming mtha' can// mdo smad lcags sbrul nag po'i lto bar 'khyil// zhes dang*/ rata gling 6) thugs bsgrub kha byang las/ nga min nga yi thugs kyi sras// sbrul lo rasmi'i ming can 'byung*// thugs sgrub rnam gsum chos sgo 'gyed// ces dang*/ rog rje gling pa'i gter lung las/

shar smad smug po'i nye char na// klong gsal sprul pa rasmi pa// khyi 'am 'brug gi grogs dang 'phrad// snying thig ma bu'i chos skal 'byed// ces dang*/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i rtsi dmar yang byang las/ shar smad rdo rje gro lod 'byung*// rigs kyi myu gu rasmi'i ming*// dgongs 'dus skor gsum chos la dbang*// nga yis bstan pa de yis 'dzin// ces dang*/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rjes 'jam dpal gsang 'dus kha byang las/ rig 'dzin g.yu sgra snying po yi// sprul pa dri med 'od zer 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon byon gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar mdzad pas som nyi dang bral zhing*/ don la khyab bdag gdod ma'i 7) mgon po dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa gter chen chos kyi rgyal po de nyid gdul bya'i don dang gang 'dul gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin skur bzhengs pa'i tshul ni brjod du mi nus kyang*/ cung zad brjod na sngon thub pa'i drung du dge slong chen po kun dga' bo/ 'o ma can la grub pa'i dbang phyug dharmā lak+ṣi pa/ rgya gar mkhan po bi ma mi tra/ bsam yas su rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ rgyal mo tsha rong du pad+ma'i rjes bzung g.yu sgra snying po/ rgya bal gyi mtshams su 'dar 'phyar pa/ yar lha sham por pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ bod yul bsgrags mda' sgrogs mo cher klong chen rdo rje gzi brjid/ bum thang thar pa gling du pad+ma gling pa/ yar lung du o rgyan bsam gtan gling pa/ yar lha sham po rba nam mkha' rdo rje/ kong po'i la sgang bzhad pa rdo rje/ 'phrang 'gor 'gro 'dul gling pa/ spo bde chen gling tu hūm̐ nag me 'bar/ lho ka nam du chos rgyal nam mkha' 'jigs 8)med/ kaḥthog tu klong gsal snying po/ khams sde dge rogs bde chen gling pa/ 'bri gong du brag sgom pa chos nyid rang grol/ rgya nag mkhan po shākya de wa/

mdo smad khams su mañju shri pa de nyid rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa nyid du snang nas bstan 'gro'i dpal du shar ba ni/ mdo khams bdud sde srin po'i yul du nag phyogs gdug pa can rnams 'dul bar gzigs pa dang*/ stod nor gyi mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor dmod ngan gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub ri la nye bar dgongs nas bstan 'gro'i don du chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du ye shes sgyu ma'i sku gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar rus kyi tshul bzung ba la/ yul zal mo sgang drug gi nang nas dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa'i sa 'dzin yul chen su war+ṇa zhes pa'i nye char du/ gdung rigs lcags khung zhes pa'i rus chen du/ yab gter rigs bdud 'dul gsum pa khrag 9) 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje dang*/ yum ḍāk+ki'i rigs can ske gza' sangs rgyas mtsho zhes pa'i sras su skye srid bzung nas/ lcags sbrul lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la sku 'khrungs pa'i dus rtags mtshan khyad par can 'byung bas/ yab kyi zhal nas nga yi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bu gcig 'dug gsungs/ de nas zla ba gsum tsam lon tshe ma'i mnal lam la mkha' 'gro rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba zhig gis bu 'di nga rang gi yin khyod la bu 'di mi dbang zer ba lan mang por rmis pas/ yum gyis bu 'di 'chi 'gro ba i yin snyam nas bla ma la zhus pas/ 'o skyon med bu 'di skye ba bzang po zhig 'dug pas/ tshe ring bas (mas ?)bdag byed pa yin te khyod kyis de'i gsol kha re 'don dang skyon med gsungs/ mtshan dri med 'od zer du gsol/ gnyis pa gleng bzhi'i tshul ni/ de nas dgung lo gsum tsam yin dus skad rigs mi 'dra ba dang yig rigs mi 'dra 10) ba mang po thugs la 'char kyang nar chung bas btang snyoms su lus/ lo ngo drug lon dus sku mched che ba rdo grub rin po ches spun zla thams cad yab kyi drung du yong pas/

rtsang chen dgon du nga rang gcig pu yin pas spun zla rnams kyi nang nas rje de nyid khong la gnang dgos yab la zhus nas de la gnang de sgrub sgar du pheb/ a khu blo gros zhes pa grub rgan gyi yongs 'dzin byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul zhig yod pa des gces spras su bskyang nas bzhugs tshe/ nub gcig mnal lam la mi byol song gi mgo can zhig gis/ khyod klong chen pa'i dus nga la sdug gtad pa de len zer zhing ral gris lan gsum g.yug kyang ma phog par/ thugs dam gyi dpe cha zhig yod pa de rlung 'tshubs kyis gtor bar rmis pas mnal sad pa dang*/ a khu blo li la de ltar 'byung 'dug smras pas/ ngam rin po che la zhu dang cang o yin zer zhing btang snyoms su lus/ phyin chad klog slob pa shin tu thugs 11) rig zhan pa ltar byung nas lo 'ga' la 'o rgyal che ba tsam mdzad/ de'i skabs su mi slob pa'i rigs gsang snying dang ngal gso sogs rin po ches bu slob gzhan la gsungs pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis thugs su chud par byung nas gdan (gzhan ?)dge rgan rnams la grub mtha'i 'dod tshul rnams de ltar red gsung pas/ rin po che'i snyan te khyod kyis ye ge mi shes par 'dug pas slob gnyer shes pa lta zhog da dung khyod byis pa yin pas slob ma bskyang nas chos 'chad grab kyi dgos med/ kha rog sdod la yi ge 'di blo ru tshud par gyis gsungs pas kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung gi dpe cha zhig gnang nas/ rje de nyid kyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin snying rus mdzad de zla ba gcig gi dbu zhabs med par thugs su chud par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo bdun brgyad nas mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gyi skor dang/ o rgyan rin po che zhal mjal ba sogs byung yang a khu la gsungs pa ma gtogs rin po che la zhu ma phod/ 12) de nas rin po ches gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan 'jigs med phrin las kun bzang rnam rgyal du gsol/

gsar rnying ris med kyi slob gnyer re dgongs nyams su bzhes par mdzad/ dgung lo dgu tsam lon dus gzims khang lcags bzhi pa'i yang thog tu rje de nyid bzhugs yod pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po zhig gis bya kha ta zhig tu sprul nas gnod bskyal bas/ gzhan dge rgan rnams kyi mthong lam la rje de nyid khang steng nas lhung song snang ba 'char yang*/ don la rgyal po dam la btags nas bya ltar du 'phur te khang pa'i phyi rol dang rtsa bar byon/ snang ba la dbang thob pas sgo dang them skas la ma ltos par zang thal du nang du byon pa sogs mdzad kyang*/ a khu dang rin po che rnam pa gnyis ka khu 'phrig zhig kyang ma song bas sbas pa'i tshul mdzad/ rjes sor du dge rgan mthong mi rnams kyis de ltar lo rgyus zhib pa rin po che la zhus pas bka' bskyon phyag 'beb 13) mdzad nas khyod khang steng 'og tu 'gang dgos pa don ci yod/ gsungs nas bka' bkyon drag tu gnang yang don zhu ma spobs/ a khu blo li la de ltar red ces zhib par smras tshe/ khyod rigs pa pad ma rong zer zhing dga' spro chen po mdzod/ dgung lo bcu gnyis lor mnal lam la mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha yin skad pas bud med sngo sang rus pa'i rgyan drug spras pa zhig gis 'di skad zer/ ho ho/ gson dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma// nga nyid su yin i shes// skye 'phreng du mar 'bar ba'i// las smon rten 'brel mthu yis/ khyod la ngag gsal sgron 'ong*// rta bdun dkyil 'khor rgyas par// mun pa'i skyon gyis mi gos// seng dkar rang la zung dang*// dbyar rngas ngar skad gzhom nus// gser dang ga gan ma nor// rang yul byon na legs bsam// pad+ma'i smon lam mthu yis// pha bu 'brel zab che yang*// rang nor mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod// dus dang dus su lon 14)bsam// da ni mi 'gyang myur du// rang yul phyogs la chas zhu// zhes zer rmi lam sad la rkyen byas nas de phyin chad pha yab shin tu dran nas yul phyogs su byon pa'i 'dun pa yang yang che skabs/

lo gsum g.yu thog dgon du mtsho byed sman pa'i mdun sar phebs pa gsan nas/ rin po che la pha yul du byon dgos par gnang ba zhus kyang sku mched thugs 'dun che bas mngag par mi mdzad kyang*/ a khu blo li'i sems kyis ma bzod nas khyed kyi pha yab dran pa khag med zer nas gsang thabs su mngag de nas yab kyis mdun sar pheb nas yab sras mjal 'phrad byed skabs bla ma'i thugs dgyes par mdzad nas brtse ba'i rjes su bzung ste zhag cha shas su bzhugs/ de nas nyin gcig byis pa rnams kyi rtse gral du rje de nyid bzhugs yod pa la thugs nyams su/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ dam chos rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas/ thar pa'i lam 15)ston gyi ded dpon chen po yin par 'dug pas/ snga sor yab yul du byon khar rin po che'i bka' gnang ma thob pa yin pas/ da phyir byon nas ci gsungs bsgrub dgos dgongs te/ ma yum la de ltar lo rgyus zhus pas yab la zhu dang ci gsung mi shes zer/ yab la zhus pas yar thon na mar 'gro bsam/ mar phyin na yar 'ong bsam/ khyod byis pa yin pas blo mang ba red gsungs te bka' bkyon gyi tshul mdzad kyang*/ rje nyid kyi yang yang gsol ba'i lan du bla ma'i drin go na bu rab red/ bla ma'i thugs mi mnyes pa sgrub mi nyan/ gsungs nas/ khal rta grwa pa rnams nas lta gon mdzad nas grogs 'ga' dang bcas grub sgar du byon/ thog mar a khu blo li la mjal 'phrad mdzad tshe gshin gson 'phrad pa ltar dga' spro chen po mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin rin po che'i sku mdun du phebs 16) tshe thugs chung ba'i tshul mdzad de nga mi rgan nad ro cong sgog tu song tshe/ khyod kyis nga dgos med byas nas lkog bros byas te song bas ci 'dra 'dra 'dra gsungs/ rje nyid kyis nga rang pha yab dran che ba dang*/ rtogs (rtog ?)pa cung zad la brten nas song ba yin pas/ khyod kyi thugs la 'gal ba yod na ci gsung gi bka' bsgrub nges pa dang*/

da lan gyi thad nas bshags sbyangs ji ltar dgos gsungs kyang nges par bsgrub lags thugs mi khrel ba zhu zhus pas/ a khus kyang de ltar zhu ba phul rogs byas/ rin po che'i 'u cag spun zla la bshags sbyangs mi dgos kyang*/ nga rang gis khyod shin tu spras bcas (gces spras ?)kyis bskyangs pa dang sems phreng ba yin ma gtogs gnad bshad min pas bshags pa mi dgos gsungs/ de nas thugs brtse brtse mdzad nas/ khyod da lan 'ong don gyi bsam pa ji ltar yin/ bla mas song gsungs sam/ ma dang spun zla rnams kyis song 17) gsungs sam/ khyod kyis dran pa i yin gsung tshe/ yab yum spun zla rnams kyis gsungs pa yin(ma yin?)/ bdag rang rtse mo byed cing byis pa rnams dang lhan du 'tshogs yod skabs bsam mno la/ nyid kyis gces par bskyangs nas zas gos sogs gang bzang gnang ba dang*/ khyad par dam pa'i chos kyi lugs nas thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ste dbang khrid sogs gces nor zab mo rnams gab sbas med par gnang ba dran tshe/ nga pha yul du 'ong skabs khams bde tsam ma zhus pa red bsam nas glo bur du yab la nga 'gro dgos zhus pas/ dang po bka' mi gnang*/ de nas yang yang zhus tshe bka' gnang thob nas 'ong ba yin lags/ snga sor yul phyogs su 'gro skabs nyams snang 'byung tshul cung zad zhus tshe/ rin po ches khyod nga'i bstan pa 'dir phan pa zhig e yong bsam pa'i 'dun pa yod kyang*/ da bstan pa gang la phan thog 'byung na yang khyad med 18) pas/ pha rgan gyi bka' bzhin du bsgrub dang don ldan re 'ong thang gsungs/ de kar zhag cha shas re bzhugs/ yang phyir yab yul la tshab khar/ rin po ches gos chen pad+ma cod pan las grub pa'i rten kheb dang*/ dngos po rin thang che ba sna re gnang sbyin mdzad de lugs gnyis kyi thad nas zhal ta du ma mdzad/ a khu blo lis kyang nga rang na so lon pas da phyin chad 'u cag i 'phrad mi shes zer nas thugs ngal mdzad bzhin dngos rdzas re gnang nas/

rin po che dang khyod gnyis thugs nang mthun pa dang dam tshig gtsang ba yin pas/ da phan gnas 'dir byon thabs re ldan na ma 'chug zer/ rje nyid kyis zhal nas bdag rang la rin po ches bstan pa 'dzin skyong 'ongs na khyad med pa sogs gsungs nas bka' gnang thob pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan re 'byung 'dug pas bstan zhabs 'dir 'ong 'dun yod kyang stabs i ldan dka' mo red/ 19) a khu khyod kyi sems ring mi nyan smras/ blo lis da ji ltar byas kyang khyod kyi bstan pa'i bdag po re 'ong nges par red/ rin po che'i thugs rtsis shin tu che 'dug pas de lugs kyis khyed ma 'chug zer nas skyel ma mdzad/ de nas yab kyi drung du chag (phyag ?)phebs nas lo rgyus rnams zhib par bsnyad pas/ bla ma'i thugs la mnyes pa bsgrub na tshe 'di phyi kun tu don 'grub nges pa yin bsam/ de nas yab rje bla ma'i mdun nas gter kha snga phyi kun gyi dbang khrid phyag bzhes rnams legs par gsan/ khyad par yab rje bla ma'i gsung chos kyis dbang khrid phyag bzhes dbyangs 'don sogs thams cad thugs su zhib rgyas su chud par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug tsam lon tshe yab rje bla ma'i gter gsar gyi rtsa rlung*/ sku mched 'bring ba lha chen stobs rgyal dang mnyam du nyin zhag brgyad cur khrid sbyangs mdzad tshe/ rlung khug re la 'khrul 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga re rdzogs par nus pa'i rlung stobs la mnga' dbang mdzad/ de skabs mnal lam la rnga yab 20) zangs mdog dpal ri red zer ba yul yangs pa can rgya che la khyon yangs pa'i dbus su ri tsit+ta'i dbyibs lta bu la/ rtsa ba khyon yangs shing mtha' skor du srin po'i yul chen bco brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi la keng rus kyi lcags ri sum brtsegs su yod pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ mtsho chen po bdun gyis bskor ba/ yul 'jigs su rung ba/

ri bo thams cad zangs las grub pa/ rtsi shing dang nags tshal lhun 'thug par gnas so/ rje nyid kyi thugs bsam la yul 'di zangs mdog dpal ri min pa 'dra/ srin yul lang ka pu ri yin 'dug dgongs/ de'i skabs mkha' 'gro ma rigs pa'i dbang phyug bde chen mo dang*/ ral gri 'bar ma gnyis byon nas 'di skad gsung*/ ya ya/ bde chen mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer// gzhan na yod pa ma yin// rang byung rig pa'i klong du// 'khor 'das chos sku 'ub chub// rnga yab zangs mdog dpal rir// nga cag rnams kyi gnas yin// dpa' bo khyod kyang 21) byon bsam// zer tshe bdag gi bla ma rin po che dgung grangs lon pas re zhig dpal ri la 'dug stabs med kyang*/ gu ru pad+ma'i zhal mjal i 'ong snyam gyis zhus tshe/ mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis dar gyi 'do li la btegs nas da bzhud zer/ rje nyid kyang mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi ngag lam ltar byon tshe/ rje'i zhal nas yul 'jigs su rung ba pha gi rnams ci red gsung tshe/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas yul 'di rnams dpal ri'i mtha' 'khor srin yul lang ka pu ri srin yul tri sha ku na su warbu pu ri la sogs pa'i yul chen bco brgyad/ ngo mtshar ba'i gnas brgyad/ rang byung gi mtsho chen bdun/ sbas yul gyi nags khrod lce spyang rol rtsed kyi shing sna tshogs la sogs par red gsungs/ rin bo che'i rked par ngo shes kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi rang rang gi 'khor dang pho brang sogs yid du 'ong ba mang po'i bang rim gyi phyogs phyogs su bzhugs yod pa la/ rje'i zhal nas khong rnams su red zhus tshe/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas pha gi rnams gu ru pad+ma'i sprul 22) pa'i gter chen rnams red gsungs/ nyid kyis grub pa'i dbang phyug 'di rnams la mjal 'dod yod pas nga der 'gro dgos gsungs/ ḍāk+ki'i 'gro mi dgos da lta dpal ri'i tshogs gral la byon 'ong zer/ de nas ri de'i rtse mo ru phyin tshe pho brang chen po sum thog tu yod pa/

phyogs bzhi rin po che shel mu tig byu ru mu man las grub pa'i lcags ri'i bskor ba'i dbus su/ gzhal yas khang yangs shigs rgya che ba rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyi nang gsal sgrib med pa zang thal du mthong zhing pad+ma rā ga'i sa gzhi rnams brdal zhing khod snyoms pa/ rin po che sna tshogs bcal du bkram pa/ phyi rol du me tog dang ljon pa lo 'dab 'bras bu sna tshogs smin pa/ chu bo yan lags brgyad ldan gyi khrus kyi rdzing bu dang*/ dpag bsam shing gi me tog rab tu rgyas pa'i steng na bya rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kyi chos kyis sgra sgrogs pa/ spos dang dri bzang gi ngad pa 'thul zhing 'ja' 'od kyi na bun rlangs 'khrigs pa/ phyogs mtshams rnams su 'ja' yis sprin dpung 'khyil zhing*/ gnas der 23)mthong ba tsam gyis 'od gsal chos sku'i dgongs pa'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa byed do/ pho brang gi shar sgo rin po che rdo rje pha lam las grub pa/ lho sgo gser gtso ma'i kha bad byas shing in+d+ra ni la las byas shing grub pa/ nub pad+ma rā ga dang*/ byang mar gad kyi kha bad baiḍūr+ya las grub pa/ sgo skyong rgyal chen sde bzhis mdzad yod pa la/ rje'i zhal nas yul 'di dang pho brang 'di ci zhes bya red gsungs pas/ ḍāk+ki'i yul 'di pad+ma dra ba can red/ pho brang pad+ma 'od rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du ra red/ da khyod pho brang nang du 'dong zer te chags (pyag ?)phebs pa'i gser gyi them skas la g.yu yi phra tshom byas par 'dug pa de la brten nas 'og khang du byon pas/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas tshogs dpon mdzad nas rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pas bdud rtsi bam sgrub mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ rje nyid kyi phyag dang smon lam 24)mdzad/ zab gter gyi bgro gleng mang du mdzad nas sangs rgyas gling pas khyod las 'phro dag pa'i skyes bu rigs can du 'dug pas/

dgongs 'dus 'bring po bdag gi zab chos kyi snying po yin pas gces nor gyi tshul du khyed la gdams/ grangs bdun phrag song tshe nga nyid mjal ba'i skal ba yod gsung*/ gter gyi lung byang gi brda don rnams gnang*/ de nas bar khang du byon te phar gzigs tshur gzigs mdzad tshe/ shākya rde wa dang*/ ka ya sid+dhi/ rdo rje mtsho/ bde ba'i go cha rnams kyis rdo rje'i gzungs ma mo mdzad nas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi sman sgrub mdzad kyin 'dug de kar mar chag pheb (phyag phebs ?)tshe dbus su za 'og gi bla bre dang gdugs 'phen sna tshogs bkra ba'i klong du/ rin po che'i khri seng ge brgyad kyis gtegs pa'i steng du gu ru rin po che o rgyan snang srid zil gnon gyi tshul du bzhugs/ de'i g.yas gral dang g.yon 25) gral rnams su grub chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ dge slong nam mkha'i snying po/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ zur chung dpal gyi ye shes/ zur chen dpal gyi rdo rje/ dpal gyi seng ge sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ ba gor bai ro tsa na/ rgya mo g.yu sgra snying po/ sna nam ye shes dang*/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ khye'u chung lo tsa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ sog po lha dpal/ dpal gyi dbang phyug ldan ma rtse mang*/ rgyal ba'i blo gros/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/ 'o bran dbang phyug dran pa nam mkha'/ sma thog rin chen/ rgyal ba byang chub la sogs pa rje 'bangs rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs thams cad sngags btsun grub thob kyi chas rang rang bstun nas lhang nger lham mer bzhugs yod pa la/ rje nyid kyi phyag mdzad nas gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ e ma ho/ snang ba khyab brdal yangs pa'i zhing khams na// gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang 26) rdo rje 'chang*// pad+ma thod phreng rigs gsum 'gro ba'i mgon// mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzim par// brtse bas thugs rjes bdag brgyud smin grol nas// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med thugs rjes zungs// rigs kun yongs 'dus gu ru pad 'byung gi// smon lam mthu las grub pa'i rigs pa 'dzin// ma nges gang 'dul thabs kyis gar bsgyur ba// rje 'bangs rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// bdag ni mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs// thugs brgyud rtogs pa'i byin rlobs dngos grub stsol// 'di nas mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu// bzang ngan 'brel thob mthong thos dran reg tu// 'gro kun bdag gis dbang bsdud chos la btsud// dpal rir pad+ma 'od du 'dren par shog

/de tshe dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs gral du// rigs gnyis sbyangs bgrod lam la mi ltos par// smin grol gdams pa'i lam la mi dgos 27) dpal thob nas// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbye med sangs rgyas shog /ces gsungs ma thag mkha' 'gro rnams kyis dbyangs gcig dang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs/ dri mas ma gos rgyal ba rnams dang mtshungs// kun dang mthun pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab// skye med mkha' 'gro'i nye ba'i sras gcig pu/

thugs kyi bu yin/ mchan/ /'od snang mtha' yas rgyal tshabs sprul pa'i sku// nus ldan thugs kyi 'od zer rig pa 'dzin// gnas 'dir phebs pa skal bzang las 'phro ldan// gzungs ma rdo rje spun grogs mi shes sam// gu ru pad+ma'i drung du byon lags sam// zhes zer nas rje nyid kyis phyag g.yas g.yon la 'jus nas zhabs zhu byed tshul mdzad nas yar pho brang du byon pas/ rje 'bangs ston 'khor gyi tshogs rnams kyis dbyangs gcig dang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad po che// rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa khyed// pad+ma'i smon lam mthu bskyed kyis/ 28) /las skal ldan pa'i dpal du shar// gang 'brel zhing 'dir 'dren ston mdzad// shes rab gsum gyi rtsal dang ldan// brtse chen dbang phyug khyed min nam// las dang smon lam dus 'dzoms pas// zhing 'dir byon pa ngo mtshar che// gsungs nas thams cad thugs dgyes tshul mdzad/ de nas rje nyid gu ru rin po che'i drung du byon nas phyag phul te gsol ba btab pa ni/ rje btsun gu ru rin po che// khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bdag /'gro ba kun dang khyad par du// bdag cag bod 'bangs dad can la// thugs rjes lhag par gzigs pa yi// bka' drin dran no 'khor thabs bral// rgyal kun spyi gzugs rdo rje 'chang*// bdag ni khyed las re sa med// dus kun 'bral med rjes bzung nas// rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam mchog /ma nor tshul bzhin brten thob ste// gzhon nu bum sku'i 'od klong du// pad 'byung rje dang dbyer med shog /ces gsol 29) ba btab mthar/ gu ru rin po che'i zhal 'dzum pa'i ngang nas rdo rje dril bu zhig gnang bas rje de nyid kyis ci yin dgongs tshe/ ḍāk+ki na re khyed kyi dril bu dkrol gsungs nas dkrol tshe/ skad snyan la ring ba skyon thams cad dang bral ba gcig 'dug pas/

rje'i zhal nas ḍāk+ki 'di'i don ci red gsungs pas/ na re rdo rje dril bu gsang sngags gsang ba'i rdzas yin pas/ khyed la mkha' 'gro yang tig gi chos la dbang ba yin gsungs nas/ gsang spyod myur lam gyi sgrub sde mo rdo rje mtshos mdzad nas mtshan gyi cod pan pad ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa ru gsol/ gu ru rin po ches der 'dus kyi rig 'dzin mched lcam rnams la rig pa don gyis dbang gsung skabs/ rje de nyid kyis me tog nub tu bab pas rig 'dzin pad+ma dgyes pa'i rdo rje ru cod paṇa du gnang nas pusti ka sum cu'i bka' dbang dang gter 'don pa'i dus tshig 30) gter gnas thabs bral chos bdag lung byang dang bcas pa legs par bstsal/ rje 'bangs rig 'dzin rnams kyis thugs dgongs dbyer med kyi ngang nas 'di ltar gsungs/ ye gdod nas dag pa ka dag gi gnas lugs// gnas 'gyu ba rang gi 'od gsal dang dbyer med// dbyings khyab brdal ye shes rang babs la skyongs dang*// dus da lta'i thad ka'i shes pa nyid rig pa// blos bsgom pa'i dran 'dzin rang grol la thong dang*// nged rig 'dzin rnams kyi dgongs pa dang dbyer med// thugs rgyud kyi yon tan pha phog tu thob nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'bad med du 'byung ngo*// zhes gsungs/ de nas nam snying dang g.yu sgra bai ro rnams kyis gsang gtam gyi tshul du zhal ta mang du mdzad/ khyad par dgongs zab kyi gnad 'di ltar gsungs/ gdod ma'i rig pa rang bzhin spros dang bral// rtag brtan yongs grub bde chen 'dus ma byas// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid rnam thar gsum dang ldan// phyogs dang ris 31) med mnyam nyid lta ba'i ngang*// gnyug ma'i ye shes 'gags med sgom pa'i klong*// tha dad bzung ba'i yul dang yul can kun// re dogs bzo bcos ma bslad spyod pa yi// ting 'dzin rig pa'i ngang bzhag gnad la skyongs// gzhi 'bras dbyer med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// rang rig mngon gyur gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'grub// lhun grub bde ba chen po e ma ho// de skad rdo rje'i tshig 'di tsit+tar sbos// zhes gsungs te/

shog ser lnga gnang nas 'di chos bod du ma bsgyur ba mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu yin pas gces nor du khyod la sprad/ lnga tshan bcu'i dus su gsal 'ong gsungs/ de nas ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi dbu mdzad nas mkha' 'gro rnams kyis pho brang gi sgo khyams du skyel ma mdzad do/ rje nyid kyis thugs chung gi tshul mdzad nas ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/ bdag skye ba nas tshe rabs kun tu rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo khyed kyis mngon sum du rjes su bzung 32) nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dam pa bstsal du gsol// zhes gsungs pas/ rje mo'i zhal nas/ e stong pa shes rab chen po'i mkha'// waṃ mi 'gyur rdo rje bde ba che// zung 'jug thabs shes gnyis su med// kha sbyor dga' bzhi stong pa'i dbyings// 'od gsal snang ba'i lam du mjal// zhes gsungs te dga' 'khyil gyi dbus su a lir ka li g.yas g.yon du 'khor ba'i tsaka li'i dbyibs lta bu zhig gnang nas 'di nga mi brjed pa'i rten yin gsungs/ gter gi slong tshad dang gter 'don pa'i tshul gyis zhal ta mdzad/ de nas rje nyid kyis steng khang la byon dgos gsungs kyang*/ ḍāk+ki rnams kyis da lan min rjes nas steng khang du phyag phebs na chog gsung nas/ sngar gyi mkha' 'gro gnyis pos dar gyi 'do li la 'jus nas rje nyid kyi zhabs zhus tshul mdzad nas pho brang gi phyi rol du 33) phebs/ de'i shar phyogs su sa gzhi thams cad shel las grub pa ljon shing rnams dkar la dri bsung 'thul ba me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i steng na bya byi'u thams cad dkar gsal snum la 'drel ba skad snyan pas chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ chu mtsho thams cad zlum la 'khyil zhing yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i dbus su rin po che man shel las grub pa'i pho brang tshad dang mtshan nyid ma lus rdzogs par 'dug pas/ rje de nyid kyi zhal nas yul zhing khams pha gi ci red gsungs pas/

ḍāk+ki na re pha gi rdo rje rigs kyi zhing khams rnam par gsal ba'i zhing der zer/ der lhags dgos gsungs kyang da dung min/ 'jig rten du gangs ri thod dkar bya ba 'di dang khyad med/ khyed der song dang gnas 'di dang nye 'ong zer/ yang nub phyogs na byon tshe sa gzhi thams cad pad+ma rā ga las grub pa ljon shing dang me tog dang chu mtsho la sogs dmar gsal dri bzang 'thul 34) bka la ping ka la sogs byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i bya rigs rnams kyis chos kyi sgra 'ur dir sgrog pa'i dbus su rin po che las grub pa'i pho brang sum brtsegs su yod pas yul pha gi ci red gsungs/ ḍāk+ki na re zhing khams pha gi 'od zer mtha' yas pad+ma rigs kyi zhing khams red zer/ der lhags dgos gsungs kyang da dung min/ 'jig rten du gu ru'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum yod pas de gar khyod song dang gnas 'di dang nye 'ong gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas zhing 'di'i lho byang gnyis la zhing med dam/ yod na mi mngon nam/ gsungs pas/ ḍāk+ki na re shar nub kyi zhing 'di dpal ri'i bar khang steng gi 'od zer red/ da dung bgrod pa'i dus min pas khyed kyis ma brjed par zhing 'di'i bkod pa rnams rjes 'jug gi las ldan rnams la smros shig dang*/ nam zhig na zhing 'dir skye bar the tshom med do zer ba dang mnyam du mnal las sad do/ nang snga mo yang 35) bla ma'i dngos slob bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge legs dpal bzang zhes pa rtsa rlung gi khrid dpon yin pas khong la mnal lam gyi lo rgyus rnams gsungs tshe/ de nyid kyi zhal nas khyod klong chen pa'i sprul pa yin par bla ma rin po che'i gsungs bzhin dang mnal lam ltar na/ bod yul gyi gnas chen dang khyad par gangs ri thod dkar du byon dgos pa i yin snyam/ da rten 'brel gyis thog ma yin pas zhing khams kyi smon lam dang*/ gu ru yab yum gyis sgrub thabs byin rlabs che ba zhig gnang du gsol gsungs pas/

rje de nyid kyis kyang chos kyi bdag por dgongs nas dag snang skor gsum gyi chos gter 'ga' re gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu bzhi bco lnga'i skabs 'bul sdud la byon skabs/ dge rtse go 'phan zer ba'i mtha' ba rgan mo ma bu gnyis yod pa de 'khon 'thab zhig la rkyen byas te bu mo gri ru shi bas/ 36) de kar nged nyid 'bod pa thon pas khong mi byon gsungs kyang*/ bla mchan sgo ya'i zab gsang zhes pas byon gos zer nas/ byon tshe spur ro lang byas byung bas/ rje de nyid dgongs pa la cung zad bzhugs nas spur gyi steng du bsham 'dug mdzad de bgegs bskrad lus sbyin sogs gsung tshe/ ro lang zhi nas der 'dus kyi mi rnams ngo mtshar du gyur to/ de nas yab rje gter chen rin po che la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas/ rje de nyid la sku gegs shin tu che bar 'dug pas rang gter gyi khros ma'i mtshams dam sbyar bzhugs dgos bla ma'i bka' gnang phebs tshe/ de ltar du zla zhag brgyar bzhugs/ de'i tshe mnal lam la mkha' 'gro ral gri 'bar ma yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ he he: byang mun pa'i gling na nyi gzhon bkra// gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sgyu ma'i gar// de'i yan lag las skyes ni gu ma// dbyings lhan skyes 37) ye shes ḍāk+ki'i sprul// g.yang dkar gyi lo 'dzin gzugs byed legs// gnas gsum na smre ba'i thig le yod// de nye rgyur spyod la rang skal gyi// chos zab pa'i don la spyod re ran// de'i gnas dang ldan par ma gyur na// dbyings ḍāk+ki'i bsu ba khyod la yod// brda go 'am rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// nga skye med dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma// gdangs lnga ldan ye shes klong nas shar// sngon tshe rabs mang pos ma bzhin brtse/ khyed dgongs pa zab kyi na so gzhon// cor chung gis bdud dbang ma shor bar// rang skal gyi pha phog len par brtson// da gsang zhig gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i tshig

/zhes zer te mnal las sad pa dang mnyam du nang snga mo skyo tsha gsol te/ yab rje bla ma'i drung du byon nas phyag phul te mdun du bzhugs/ bla mas khyod kyis mtshams legs po i 'ong 'grub rtags ci yod gsungs pas/ rje de 38)nyid kyis mtshams kyi lo rgyus ma gtogs mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung ba'i rnam grangs zhu ma spobs*/ de nas dgung lo bcu drug lon/ snga ma'i rten 'brel stabs dben kyang*/ zab gter gyi chos bskor rdzogs chen gyi skor dang bsgrubs thabs cha shas re phyag bris mdzad nas/ yab rje bla ma'i spyan lam du phul tshe/ dang po thugs mi mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad nas bka' bkyon dang phyag 'beb gnang*/ de nas rje nyid kyi zhal nas nga rang gis slob ma lam gyis rtsom chos dang gang dran yig bris su bgyis pa'i blo ngan med nges pa yin kyang*/ 'gro ba bslu brid dang rang gi don shor gyi rgyu yin min bla ma rin po che khyod kyis gsung du gsol/ gsungs nas phyag phul zhing yang yang zhu ba phul te/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal gzigs lung bstan yong tshul rnams zhib par zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyi yi ge tsam chos dang gang dran yig ris su 39) bris pa red bsam pa min nges khyod kyi rgyud brtag pa yin pas/ 'u cag pha bu yin kyang khyod nga la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes nges par 'dug pas/ zab gter gyi dngos grub re thob 'ong*/ snga ma'i rten 'brel 'grigs na bzang gi ta/ da dus las yol 'dug min kyang spun zla dang nye 'khor rnams kyis khyod da dung byis pa yin pas ci zer mi shes gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas yi ge 'di rnams ci byed zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas phyi nang kun la gsang rgya gyis la zhog gsung*/ de nas lo khyim de'i nang du rdo lung ri zab zer ba'i nang du sa phug zhig yod pa de kar myur lam thod rgal gyi nyams len zla ba drug dang zhag bcu 'gro skabs/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i mi mo gzugs mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba dar dkar gyis lwa ba mnabs pa rma bya'i sgro thul g.yang lugs su gsol zhing phyag na me long dang

40) gter bum 'dzin pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig gi 'di skad gsungs/ e eḥ gson dang rigs ldan dbang mo// kun gsal rta bdun khyon yang*// dbyar rnga'i rang sgra shugs ldan// ru sbal rgyu rtsal rgod kyang*// ngang pa'i chab srid gsal 'ong*// lha lam yul nas 'ong ba'i// bzhin mdzes ḍāk+ki nga rang*// dga' ba'i 'gros la mkhas pa'i// bde chen bcud la dbang 'byor// mkha' dbyings rol mo'i sgya rtsal/ khyod dang 'brel na legs bsam// pad+ma'i pha phob (g)thob pa// zab gter grogs mo ngas byed// zer nas skus gar bsgyur te 'khril sbyor gyi sta gon byed tshe/ rje de nyid na so chung ba'i rkyen la ltos nas mkha' 'gro'i gsung ltar ma nus shing bzhugs pas/ yang ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas khyod klong chen rdo rje gzi brjid yin skabs nga rang bde bskyed gsang ba'i grogs yin kyang da lan ngo ma shes pas len/ da nga 'gro ba 41) yin zer zhing 'gro grab byed 'dug rje'i zhal nas nga klong chen pa'i skye srid yin tshul ji ltar red smras pa'i tshe/ ḍāk+ki na re/ khyod kyis pha yab la dris dang gsal 'ong gi dang*/ de rten 'brel gyi sna kha las kyis ma bsgyur ba zhig dgos zer zhing g.yu drug dkar zhig rje la phul te/ 'u cag dam tshig gi rten yin zer nas mi snang bar gar song cha med du gyur/ de nas nangs snga mo bla ma'i drung du byon nas phyag phul te mdun du bzhugs tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod la ci dgos gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas bla ma rin po che khyod kyis bdag la skye 'gro phreng (skye phreng ?)lung bstan zhig gsung du gsol zhus nas phyag phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas phas bu la lung bstan pa 'di mi mdza' a gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas bdag gi 'di phyi bar gsum du skyabs mgon bla ma khyod las med pas/ bdag gi las ji ltar 'gyur gyi lung bstan 42) zhig ci nas kyang gsung du gsol/

zhes yang yang zhu ba phul ba'i tshe/ bla mas da chog gi gsungs te 'di skad gsung*/ gnyid 'od gsal 'dres pa'i dag snang ngor// ma mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dbang phyug ma// yin skad pa'i bud med zhig na re// nga 'ong ba chos kyi dbyings nas 'ong*// dbyings zag med nam mkha'i 'khor yug nas// gdangs lhun grub rol pa 'phrul mo che// tshul ma nges sna tshogs snang ba shar// 'di yod pa kun la yod na yang*// de mngon du gyur pa nyin skar tsam// 'dir sna tshogs snang ba'i rdzun ris kun// med bzhin du 'khrul snang kun la yod// tshul stong nyid yin par sus ma mthong*// nga rig rtsal rol pa'i mdza' na mos// mi khyod la lung bstan tshigs su bcad// gzhi 'khor 'das rol pa'i ma chen mos// bu'i grangs la brjed du ma mchis kyang*// bu yid la bcag pa sgyu ma'i 43) bu// sngon sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor klong chen ma// ma 'gro la rjes chags gar gyi dbang*// don rnam 'phrul mañju shri pas// yang smon lam rnam dag sgyu ma'i 'phrul// dus deng sang mi yi rdzu la zhugs// da yi dam lha tshogs gang lags kyang*// lha rdo rje gro lod phur pa legs// bka'i srung ma gang lags ci yin na// bka'i srung ma gnod sbyin shan pa dang*// gza' khyab 'jug sngon las 'brel ba'i lha// gnas gang bde dben pa'i ri ngogs bde// las ci byed phyogs med 'gro ba skyongs// phug gar gtod gzhi yi reg pa yis// mthar gar bsdu snang bzhi mtha' ru bsdu// zas ci za slong mo'i kha zas bzang*// rkyen bar chad gang gis sel srid na// chos bdud gcod zab mos sel yang srid// dus lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dal yam la// sngags rdo rje'i go khrab bsgo ba gal// las mtha' ma bdud la ma shor dgos// tshe'i 44) tshad ni ci yin bya ba na// lo bdun bcu rtsa gnyis grangs tsam mam// rkyen bar chad pho nyas g.yul bzlog phyir// ma mkha' 'gro'i dal la tshogs mchod btang*// gnad tshul bzhin spyod pa'i skal ldan na// tshe 'di phyi gnyis la legs yon 'thob/

ai/ nga dbus nas lhags pa'i mdza' na mo// bar mngon ga'i zhing nas stong gzugs ston// yul sgyu ma'i ltad mo ston du 'ong*// lho gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas// nges (ngas ?)bde sdug gar gyis rnam rol ngom// gnas de ru 'thog par ma gyur na// nub pad+ma btsegs pa'i dur khrod nas*// ngas nyon mongs ro bsnyil cho 'phrul gyis// gdangs 'jigs med zang thal nor du ster// gnas de ru yun gcig ngal gso'i mthar// byang sde sdug med pa'i a thang nas// nga dbyings nas mi ring bsu mar 'ong*// gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min nas// nga lam 'dren ma mo sde bzhi 'khor// 'od dbang po 45) gzhu yi lam byas te// bdag ma bu kun bzang rgyal sar 'gro// da nga 'gro chos kyi dbyings su 'gro// nga lus med mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer du// bde sdug med pa'i dbyings su 'gro// zhes zer zhing 'ja' mtshon yal bzhin thal/ gsungs nas de ltar gyis dang rang gzhan gyis don 'byung 'ong gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu bdun lor sku gegs shin tu che bas/ yab rje bla mas gegs sel gyi phyir du rje nyid la bka' bkyaun dang phyag 'bebs sogs gnang nas dus rgyun du thugs drag po byas te spyan gyis gzigs pa med pa tsam mdzad tshe/ bla ma rin po che'i dngos slob lung zin rnams kyi nang nas bso sprul tshe dbang rig 'dzin nam sna tshogs rang grol dang*/ gling sprul pad+ma lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ bla ma dge legs dpal bzang la sogs pa'i skyes chen rnams dang*/ las ldan gyi slob bu 'gas gtsug gi rgyan du 'chang nas/ bla mar mthong*/ gzhan bu 46) slob rnams kyi bla ma'i mdzad spyod la ltos te brnyas dmod dang log par blta zhing*/ rje de nyid la khyod bla ma gter ston gyi bla btsong red zer zhing mig gi ling tog dang 'dra bar byung*/ bla mas kyang chos gral dbang gral tsam la'ang rje de nyid bzhugs su mi bcug par mdzad/

de'i skabs rje de nyid thugs shin tu skyo drag nas rang gnas kyi lung pa 'dam lung zhes pa'i sgang kha ru byon nas thugs skyo ba'i glu 'di gsungs so/ pha kun mkhyen pad 'byung chos kyi rje// don dbyer med bdud 'joms he ru ka /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs// sprang ri khrod zin par mdzad du gsol// sngon smon lam bzang po'i las 'phro ldan// pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i rjes su bzung*// chos zab pa'i gdam ngag sna tshogs thob// rang gzhan gyis don gnyis ngang gis 'byung*// ma mkha' 'gro'i gral phral lung bstan bzhin// chos zab pa'i gter la dbang ba'i dus// sab+ta yi 47)smon lam las kyi bsgyur// de ji bzhin ma nor gnad la 'bad// don ma nor rang byung 'grub par 'gyur// de bsam shing bsam na skyo ba skyes// gnas gang du bsdad kyang dben ri dran// rang gcig pur sgrub tshugs zin pa zhig /mgon pad 'byung gis byin rlobs lam sna drongs// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyi rlobs// blo chos la 'gyur bar byin gyi rlobs// pha bka' drin can gyi mdzad spyod la// yid the tshom med par byin gyi rlobs// las bya ba dam pa'i chos dang bstun// gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud rgya dbyings su zhig /rang byung gi ye shes mngon gyur shog /gsungs nas da bla ma'i bka' gnang zhig thob na nges med kyi ri khrod zhig tu 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ de nas ma yum yod sar phebs te/ rje'i zhal nas a ma nga sngar bla ma'i thugs kyis shin tu gces par bskyang nas spun zla rnams dang khyed med par mdzad/ 48) khyad par zab chos kyi khrol don dmar khrid du gsungs pa sogs yin kyang*/ da res kyis dus rnams su chos gral tsam la'ang 'du mi chog gsungs nas/ nub mo gzim g.yog sogs zhabs zhu byed skabs rnams su gsung mdzad mi gnang bar 'dug pas/ da ci nas kyang bla ma'i thugs zin gyi slob bu zhig mi 'ong nges par red/

da ni bla ma'i sras su gyur pa bka' yang thugs mnyes par gyur pa'i lus ldan zhig lon pa la smon lam btab nas lus ngan 'di bor song na ci ma rung gsungs te bshum par mdzad tshe/ ma'i sems kyis ma bzod kyang yab la ni zhu ma phod par rje de nyid kyi thugs gsos nas/ da khyod kyi lus bzang po da phan lon thabs dka' mo red/ khyod skye ngan zhig min pa 'dra/ sngar nga rang la mkhyen sprul dang mi pham gnyis yod skabs lus na sdug bsngal chen po byung*/ khyod yong dus mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du sleb snang 'char ba dang*/ lus la 49) na tsha med cing shes pa dwangs shing dge sbyor 'phel ba dang*/ btsas dus gnas khang phyi nang thams cad 'od kyis khyab cing*/ khang steng du rgod babs nas gar byed pa'i tshul gyis phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed 'dug pa gzhan gyis rig zer/ mo'i snang ba la'ang khyod mngal skyon gyi ma gos par 'od kyi rnam par gnas pa sogs rtags mtshan khyad par ba yod pas/ bla mas kyang khong gi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bu zhig 'ong gsungs pa sogs smras nas/ da khyod kyis bla mas ci gsung bsgrub la bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs gnang rung dgos pa chen po yod thang log lta ma byed zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas bla ma la log lta ci la skye/ bka' drin 'khor thabs dang bral ba yin pas srog la bab dgos pa bka' gnang phebs kyang bsgrub nges pa yin/ bla mas lung zin gyi bu slob che ba rnams kyi nang nas nga rang gis dbang 'brel yod pa gling sprul dang bsam sprul bla ma dge 50)dpal chos bstan la sogs pa'i bu slob 'ga' re ma gtogs/ thams cad kyis brnyas dmod byed 'dug pas nga rang bla ma'i sras min par 'dra snyam gyis gsungs/ ma yum gyis na re khyod la tshe gegs che bas lan pa red/ kun gyis dman ldang ci la yin zer nas/ da bzhugs gnas spor dgos pas de lugs kyi bla ma'i zhal zhu gyis zer/ de nas lo khyim der ston zla tha chung gi nang du ba ra tshangs kyi stod du lung kha ma zer ba de la sgar gzhis dgun sar phebs tshe/

rje de nyid kyis sngar ltar bla ma'i gzim sbra'i nang du ra ba dang*/ phyi'i spyod lam gyi sa brkos pa sogs mdzad nas gzim sbra phub/ de nas bla ma'i gzim lam bca' skabs/ rje de nyid kyi thugs bde gsos la bdag skye ba nas tshe rabs gar skyes kyang bla ma rin po che 'di dang mi 'bral ba thugs mnyes pa'i zhabs zhu legs po re bsgrub na/ dben ri brgya yi do zla med pa 'dra dgongs nas smon lam rnam dag re mdzad/ 51) de nas bla ma'i gzhungs gnas kyi sta gon rnams legs par 'grub ste/ rje de nyid bla ma'i drung du byon nas bka' skyon phyag 'bebs gnang nas bla ma gzims sbra'i nang du byon song rjes/ rje de nyid thugs skyo ba'i bshum par mdzad nas bzhugs yod skabs/ hor 'od chung dang*/ bla ma sher gsang*/ mkhyen rab rgya mtsho sogs mched grogs 'ga' byon nas khyed kyi thugs chung ma mdzad dang*/ bla ma rin po ches khyed la sku gegs yod pa'i lo rgyus gsungs 'dug pas bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs ji ltar gnang yag log rtog mi nyan gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs ji ltar gnang yang log lta skye ba mi dgos/ nga rang gi bla ma'i thugs zin pa zhig mi 'ong gi snyam nas sdug pa yin gsung*/ yang mched grogs rnams kyis bla ma'i thugs la zin nges pa red/ bla ma'i zhal nas khong mched grogs bu slob rnams la bar skabs chang gsol zhor ba (l)'di ltar gsung*/ 52) nga rang gi bu dri med 'di gzhi bzang bas dman sdang byas nas brdung btsog byed pa yin/ bu de la tshe 'phreng che ba yin pas de sel thabs byed pa yin ma gtogs sdang ba min/ ngas bstan pa 'di kho rang la rag las yod gsung pa yin pas/ khyed kyis de lugs kyi thugs gzab mdzod la sku tshe mthar phyin thabs re ma 'chugs zer/ de skabs gzhi chen bla sprul 'ga' dang*/ phyogs gzhan nas byon pa'i bla sprul mang po la gter sar gyi phur pa khros ma seng gdong sogs kyi dbang lung 'bul dgos pas/

bla mas rje de nyid la gsung mdzad mi gnang*/ gzhan bu slob zhig la gsung cha'i tshul du/ rje de nyid la khyod kyis phyogs kyi sgar ba 'di rnams la dbang lung sogs gang dgos kyi bya ba gyis shig gsung*/ de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin rje nyid kyis bla sgar rnams la dbang lung 'bul skabs/ dbang gi mgor thon tshe bla ma bskyed lam la byon te gzigs tshe/ thugs snang la/ rje 53) de nyid kyi mdun thad du 'ja' yi gur khang 'khyil ba'i klong du mkha' 'gro ma rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa zhig gis ḍa dril dkrol bzhin snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis tshigs bdun gsungs pa gzigs tshe/ bla ma'idagongs pa la bu chung dri med de klong chen pa'i skye srid yin nges pa 'dra/ sngon las 'brel rtsal gzugs sku dbyings su bsdu skabs las ldan rnams kyi mthong snang la mkha' 'gro rus pa'i rgyan drug can zhig dbu gtsug nas thon te/ steng gi nam mkhar thim song ba mthong chos su yod pas rdo rje phag mos rjes su bzung ba zhig yin par dgongs/ gzhan mched grogs rnams kyis 'ja' dang 'od re shar ba kun gyis mthong nas ngo mtshar du smras/ de nas dbang lung gi mjug tu rje de nyid la maṇ+ḍal gyi rten du phul ba chos dung g.yas 'khyil spus ldan zhig dang rin po che gnyis pa dar gos phrugs la sogs pa phyag tu 'byor ba rnams yab rje bla ma'i 54)drung du phyag bcas phul bas/ de sngon bla ma'i gsungs mdzad mi gnang ba'i tshul byas kyang*/ da ras kyi skabs gsung gnang nas chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pas chos dung ma spus ldan 'di legs go gsung*/ rje de nyid bla mas gsung gnang ba la dga' dra nas ci yin 'di yin med par rab dga'i sa thob pa'i skyes bu lta bur gyur pa dang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas da khyod kyis nga'i bka' bsgrub bsam na nges med du sprang ldom gyi tshul du grogs zhig dang bcas te song gsungs/

de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin rje de nyid bya bral gyi tshul du byon nas/ thog mar gser 'bros rir gnas bskor mdzad nas byon pa'i lam khar mi dmar rta dmar can zhig byung nas khyed su yin/ da lta gar byon zer ba la/ rje nyid kyi ci yang mi gsung par byon pas mi de yang gar song med par yal/ de nas gnas kyi g.yon lung mdor 55) phebs nas mdun lung gong ma'i nang du gsol phog mdzad cing yod pa la/ yang sngar gyi mi de 'ong nas khyed su yin gang du byon zer ba la/ nga rgis lis gter sras yin/ nges med kyi gnas su 'gro/ khyod su yin gsungs pas/ kho na re nga se ra dgon nas 'ong ba yin/ lo cha shes la 'u cag mjal rgyu ma byung bas/ da lan khyed bsu mar 'ong ba yin pas/ da nga sngon du 'gro/ khyed rjes nas byon shog zer nas rta la lcags kyis brabs pa'i tshul byas nas mi snang bar gyur/ de'i nyin rje de nyid sdong ra zer ba'i lung mda' ru phebs nas de gar bzhugs/ de'i nub gzim lam la bud med yid du 'ong ba dar dkar gyi lwa ba gyon pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa gnyis yu mo dang rma bya bcibs nas rje'i drung du 'ong ste sku khams bde lags sam zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas nga 56) bde mor gnas/ khyed gnyis su yin gsungs pas/ khong gnyis na re nged gnyis 'brong ri'i lcam gnyis yin pas khyed gnas nang la i byon zer/ rje'i zhal nas khyed gnyis kyis 'gro rogs byas na 'gro gsung*/ de nas rje de nyid mkha' 'gro gnyis dang bcas te byon pas mdun lung bar ma red zer nas dung gi sgo dang them skas yod pa zhig tu thon song bas/ grogs gnyis la rje'i zhal nas gnas 'di gang red gsung*/ mkha' 'gros na re gnas 'di dge bsnyen 'brong ri smug po yin zer/ de nas nang du byon pa'i gzhal yas khang sum thog tu yod pas/ 'og khyams su sras mchog nor bu 'od 'bar red zer ba'i gser rgog dang gser khrab gsol phyag na sba lcag dang nor bu 'dzin pa/

'khor du dpal (dpa'?)thul lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba/ 'dod yon gyi lha mo mang pos rang rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i zas sna tshogs thogs nas mgron thabs kyi tshul 57) du yod pa/ de'i bar khang la 'brong ri smug po yin zer ba'i mig dmar smug khro nyams ldan pa/ dar mthing gi ber g.yang lugs su gsol nas rin po che'i khri'i steng du rol stabs kyis tshul du bzhugs pas/ 'khor du mgon po'i lha dmag red zer ba mang pos bskor nas yod pa la/ rje'i zhal nas grogs gnyis la da steng khang du 'gro gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro na re steng khang du mjal rgyu du ma yod pas khyed yar phebs khar 'gro dang chog zer/ rje na re mjal ba ci yod gsung*/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas pho brang ri bo gru 'dzin zer ba thugs rje chen po'i gnas red/ pha gi mi smug po zhig yod pa 'di spyan gzigs kyi sprul pa mgon po tshogs bdag zer ba/ phyi ltar na dpal dge bsnyen 'brong ri bla dpon sogs bsod nams can gyi dgra lha gzhi bdag mthu bo dang*/ nang ltar na dpal mgon tshogs kyi bdag po sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi bsrung*/ 58) mtha' mi ha ri nag po la sogs dam nyams bstan dgra'i rnams kyi srog gi gshed po tshe dam ldan gyi mi rnams kyi skyabs na lha dang*/ gsol na sdong grogs byed pa dang*/ rbad na stong gsum g.yo nus pa'i stobs shugs dang ldan zhing mthu rtsal che zer/ rje'i zhal 'og khang gi bdag po sras mchog nor bu 'od 'bar zer ba de ci red gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro na re de thugs chen gyi sras nor bu 'dzin gyi sprul pa nor bu 'od 'bar rtsal red zer/ yang mkha' 'gro gcig gi na re wa shu dpon gyi pha red zer/ gcig na re nu bo red zer nas kha ma 'chams pa'i tshul byed/ rje'i zhal nas 'brong ri spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin na/ khyed gnyis de'i lcam yin zer ba khyed gnyis sprul pa dang sprul gzhi ci red gsung*/

mkha' 'gros na re khyod kyis nged gnyis kyis sprul gzhi la gzigs bsam na 'di ltar red zer zhing*/ taṃḥyig dkar ljang 59)du gyur nas rje de nyid kyi thugs kar thim song snang shar ba dang mnyam du mnal las sad do/ de nas nangs snga mo skyo tsha gsol nas lam la bzhud skabs nam mkha'i mthong na sprin gyi gses nas lha'i bu mo 'dra ba zhig gis skad snyan pa'i ngag gis 'di skad smras/ ho hoḥ sngon nam snying dang bi ma'i smon lam mthus// dus da res zab mo gter la dbang*// rang skal gyi nor bu 'od 'bar de// stod g.yu 'brug rgyal po'i nor bu rnyed// las 'bad rtsol mi dgos smon lam mthus// nor bu de rgya mtsho'i dpal du shar// gnas mi ring rang gnas nye ba'i sar// mtsho rgyal gyi gar bsgyur pā sham ming*// bzhin mdzes ldan sna sme g.yon na yod// de nye rgyu'i grogs kyi dpal ldan na// gter gnyis kyi sgo 'phar longs spyod ldan// re zhig gi tshe 'phreng sel bar nges// dus ring mo 'grogs pa'i stabs 60) legs na/ sngon rten 'brel// gnad de la stabs ka gzab gal che// de de dang de sogs rigs pas dpyod// dus dus su nga yis legs nyes smra/ zhes zer mi snang bar sprin gyi rnam par yal/ de nas dam can gyi gnas yod sar phebs nas bskor ba zhig mdzad tshe/ lam kha nas ban rgan smra ra thams cad dkar por song ba zhig 'dug yod pas/ rje'i zhal nas khyed kyis skor ba byed pa i yin gsungs pas/ kho na re nga grangs bdun brgya dang nyi shu tham par rang sems la skor bar byed pa yin/ da rig sgog skam po la skor ba byed pas ci phan zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas na re 'di dam can gyi gnas khyad par can zhig yin pa kun gyi zer bas/ khyod kyang rang sems stong pa la skor tshod med pas gnas 'di la skor ba bzang gsung*/ kho na re khyed col chung gi byis pa red/ ri 'bar 'bur dang sa rtsi shing can gyi 'bras

61) bu thob pa ga la yod/ de'i 'bras bu thob na srid pa'i mi rgan mgo 'khor de ka mtha' med 'khor bar cis phyir 'khyams zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas srid pa'i mi rgan mgo 'khor red zer ba de su red gsungs tshe/ kho na re srid pa'i mi rgan zer ba yar sangs rgyas kyi sa ma mthong zhing*/ mar ngan song 'khor ba'i gnas su gzhis bzung gi chung ma lta bu yul drug gi grong khyer du nyin mtshan bar med par 'khyams mkhan de la zer/ khyed kyang ri 'bur sa 'bur la bskor ba byed pas ci phan*/ rkang pa la sdug gtad pa red/ de bas sems nyid stong pa'i gsal cha la 'gags pa med pa'i rtsa khams yi ge'i 'khor lo 'di la bskor ba byed nas chos mdzad kyi 'gro don re bsgrub na bzang gi zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas rje de nyid bla ma rong du byon tshe zhag cha shes bzhugs skabs/ yang sngar 'gros mdun nas 'ong ba'i mi rta dmar po de 62) 'ong nas khrod ma 'gor bar myur du se re'i ri khyod du byon dgos/ sngar bla ma 'jam dbyangs kyis nga la shog dril zhig gtad yod pas/ de dus la bab pa yin pas khyod byon na nges khyed la 'bul dgos zer nas tham(thal?)/ de nas mi 'di ci yin rje'i dgongs nas yod pa la/ yang bud med zhig thon byungabs de la rje'i zhal nas tham mi dmar rta dmar zhig 'ong ba de su red gsungs tshe/ mo na re khyed kyi ngo ma shes sam/ rjes 'brong mdun nas lan ma gnyis reg de min cha rgyus med gsungs/ mo na re khyod ri khrod bla ma yin skabs kho bka' srung gi gtso bo yin rab yod/ dam can skyes bu srid pa gsal byed red zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas khyod su yin gsungs pas/ mo na re gnas 'di'i bsrung ma 'dzi chen nor skyong ma yin zer nas bshud pa gcig byas nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas rje de nyid yar 63) ser gon du byon nas ri khrod bla ma'i sgrub khang du byon te mtshams bcad brgya mdzad cing bdun phrag gsum tsam du bzhugs tshe/

nyin gcig mnal lam la mkha' 'gro rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i g.yas dar snas brgyan pa'i mda' dang g.yon na rin chen gyis bkang ba'i gser gyi gzhong pa 'dzin pa dar dkar gyi lwa ba mnab cing rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa zhig gi 'di skad zer/ ye yeḥ gangs can shol gyi pho brang nas// 'ong ba'i tshe sngon khyod kyi grogs// skye ba med las rang byung nang*// 'gags med rang gsal brda ngo sprad/ khyod ma yengs sgra 'dzin dbang po gson// rang gnas kyi rang byung gnas khang du// thabs rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i ri mo bkra// dus g.yu 'brug mjug ma ngom pa'i tshe// blo rigs pas smon lam stabs ldan na// dbyings mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul gyi yi ge 'di/ khyod las 'phro smon lam dus la bab/ kho rdo rje legs pa phrin las bcol/ 64) /las mi 'byangs myur du gsal bar nges/ zhes zer nas mda' mo sgro ldan 'di khyod la gtad zer nas mi snang bar yal/ nangs snga mo skyo tsha gsol skabs rje'i thugs dgongs la mdang gi rmi lam de lung bstan zhig yin par 'dug kyang don go dka' mo red dgongs/ de nas nyer lnga mkha' 'gro'i dus chen gyi nyin rje'i thugs rgya glo bur du sad nas gnas khang gi gyang ngo la gnam chos dbang ldan zhig lhan yod pa de gzigs nas nyi shar 'brug yol 'gro skabs rdo mdung zhig gis gyang log brkos pa'i nang na bum gter zhig bzhag yod pa de'i kha khob blang nas gzigs tshe/ mthing shog gi ngos la gser gyi bris pa'i shog dril gcig 'dug pa de gtan la phab tshe/ kha byang dang bstan pa spyi bo'i lung bstan du ma yod kyang phyi nang kun la gsang rgya dam po mdzad/ de nas nyin gcig skyo sangs la byon skabs thugs dgongs 65) la 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i skyes bu zhig yin na dga' dgongs nas zhag cha shas tsam song tshe/ de tsha'i (che'i ?)ri khrod du bla ma rin po che lung zin gyi bu slob dam pa rje nyid kyi dngos slob bso sprul rin po che'i rab byung gi mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po de tsho bla ma chos rgyal zhes pa'i drung du byon nas dge tshul bsgrub dgos dgongs tshe/

de nub gzim lam la bud med gzugs mi sdug pa zhig gis dus kyi khug so'i spyod pa 'di thabs sdug zer zhing brang brdung ste drag tu ngus kyin 'dug pas/ rje'i zhal nas khyod 'di tsam gyis sdug ci la byed gsungs pas/ mo na re nga ngu ba la khag ci yod/ deng sang gi mi'i spyod pa 'di la ltos dang*/ rgan mo nga'i mi tshad gnas dang yul gyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyang thugs khrol (khrel?)bar 'dug zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas gnas yul gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'khrug don ci 66) red gsungs/ mo na re bshad na bshad tshod med pa 'dra yang*/ da khyod la zur tsam smras na rang mtshang la go 'gro zer/ rje'i zhal smros dang rag mtshang la ci la phog gsungs/ mo na re mtshang la ma phog na bzang gi ta/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i rang rtags la ltos dang*/ sngags pa'i dam mi bsrung bar mgo rag byad/ dge slong gi gsum ldan yin zer zhing sngags su zhugs/ zab mo gter la dbang yang mi ngan pa'i rkyen gyis ngo so chung bas btang snyoms su shor ba de so khyod gter ston tsho'i mtshang red zer zhing*/ rje'i zhal nas gter ston rnams 'dul ba'i bslab pa la zhugs kyang gter la ci gnod/ sngon gu ru pad+mas kyang kun dga' bo'i mdun nas rab tu byung ste/ shākya seng ge'i mtshan gsol nas dbu reg zhabs rjen mdzad pa yin kyang*/ mthar bod khams thams cad gter gyis 'dren pa yin gsung*/ 67) mo na re ngas gu ru pad+ma'i cha rgyus ngas shes/ khyod kyis mi shes/ gu ru sngar 'og min zhugs dus nga las byed yin/ lho nub 'o ma can la rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu dril nas rang byung sprul pa'i sku ru byon/ spang thob kyi yon tan thams cad sa lam gyi rim par mi ltos par mkhyen gzigs ye shes yon tan thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa'i rtags su/ o rgyan rgyal po'i rgyal srid bzung nas rigs ldan 'od 'chang lha mo khab tu bzhes nas/

gnas dang yul gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad dbang du bsdus nas srid gsum zil gyis gnon par mdzad/ de nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la zhugs nas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas lha 'dre mi gsum klu gnyen sa bdag sde brgyad 'byung po la sogs pa gzugs med thams cad dbang du bsdus nas mnga' 'og 68) tu chos la bkod pa bden/ dge sbyong mgo reg byas nas brtul zhugs 'ong ba ngas mi shes zer nas mi snang ba song ngo*/ de nang nang snga mo skyo tsha gsol tshe rje de nyid kyi sku khams mi bde bar zug rngu chen po zhig byung 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs la cham pa zhig bzhes 'dug dgongs kyang*/ gsang rgya mdzad nas zhag cha shas tsam song rjes/ rje de nyid bsnyungs las grol skabs yul phyogs de'i nye char du ske yams kyi nad byung nas 'gro ba mang po na ba dang*/ khyad par rje nyid kyi lcam sring ma 'bring po dpal mtsho zhes pa'i gza' mi gnyis yod pa de nad kyis mnar nas 'chi la thugs par yod pas/ de'i yul mi gnyis byung nas rje de nyid 'bod pa la 'ong ste dpon g.yog bcas de kar phebs tshe/ lcam sring mo dang khyo pho gnyis ka 'chi kha la thug yod pas/ rjes dam rdzas dang bla ma rin po che'i chag sbyar sbyin 69) nas lus sbyin dang bka' bsgo mdzad pas/ khyo pho 'chi ba las ma grol te shi song*/ lcam sring ma nad las grol te/ 'jig rten gyi zhal ta mdzad nas/ rje de nyid phyir byon nas mkha' 'gro 'khrug bskang dang gsol kha sogs mdzad nas/ yul de'i nad thams cad zhi la song ngo*/ de nas rje de nyid kyis kha byang ltar dgung lo bco brgyad lor gser smad rnga ma stag rtse nas gsang gter skor gsum gyi gter sgrom rin po che smug po las byas pa dbyibs glang chen lta bur yod pa dang*/ gnam lcags kyi phur bu dang*/

thugs rtags rdo rje rtse lnga bcas gsang gter du bzhes/ de nas rje de nyid grogs gcig dang bcas dbus phyogs la byon par dgongs tshe/ yab rje bla mas mkhyen te rong tshong pa la gsungs shog gnad mo zhig bskur lugs pas/ rje de nyid yab yul la byon grabs byas/ de na yon 70) bdag 'ga' la srung skyob mdzad tshe/ 'bul sdud rin thang che ba sna tshogs phul/ de nas yab yum la byon pa'i lam khar rnal 'byor pa dmar smug skra dang smra ra thams cad dkar sang du yod pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon o rgyan bhan thod bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs dkris pa/ ri dwags e na ya'i gdan la bzhugs pa zhig 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la yab rje bla ma rin po che'i sprul pa i yin dgongs nas myur bar mdun sar phebs nas gzigs tshe bla ma rin po che'i min par dgongs/ de nas rjes phyag phul nas gsol ba/ rnal 'byor pa khyod su yin gang du byon gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga 'gro ba'i don du 'ong ba yin/ khyad par khyed la ngas gdams pa'i man ngag re bstan du 'ong ba yin pa ste/ thang stong sgrub thabs dang zhal lung le'u lnga bcu pa bcas gces nor du gnang nas gnas 71) skabs dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang rten 'brel sel thabs la 'di ltar gsungs/ ngang gnas mngon gyur chos kun de bzhin nyid// rig dbyings zung 'jug 'od gsal chen po'i khams// ye shes rlung lnga'i lhun grub 'phrul du shar// kun 'byung 'khor lo ma rig glo bur gyis// nyer btab srid pa'i khams su rol par shar// phyi nang gzung 'dzin yul dang yul can gyi// snang sems tha dad so sor 'dzin shugs rlabs// bde sdug bar ma gsum gyis 'obs su tshud// rten 'brel bcu gnyis shing rta'i 'khor lor 'khor// dug gsum dbal gyis ngan song rmi lam bzhin// med bzhin snang ba'i shugs kyi las sna tshogs// ma nges sna tshogs 'byung ba chos kun mtshan// bskal pa rdzogs ldan sum ldan rtsod ldan nas// bltas bgad 'o 'khyud chags pas tshims pa sogs// nyon mongs che phra rags spyod shin tu rags/

72) /der 'byung las kyi 'bras bu chud mi gsan// snyigs ma lnga 'byung mi thub lnga yi dus// skye 'gro'i bde nyams sa bcud yul lha nyams// nad rims dmu ge'i bskal pa mtha' nas dar// gnyan dang sa bdag ko long gdug rtsub 'gyed// theg gsum lam zhugs dge 'dun gang dag gis// so thar sdom pa gzhan bslus chas su 'dzin// byang chub sems nyid rgyud kun log ltas bslad// bskyed rim dmigs gtad rang rgyud sa ru 'dzin// bde stong gnad dor nag chang rtag tu spyod// sngags par khas 'cha' rtsa rlung dbyings su bskyil// mdo sngags bstan pa mi nag tshogs gral gleng*// sde gsum tha dad sar bzung 'dod gzugs bslab// yang na gzugs med khams kyi las byed do// kha cig bla ma'i drin gyi theg rtse'i chos// ci bzhin mthong ba'i blo mig ldan na yang*// mi tshe rnyed 'tshol 'du 'dzi'i gnas su zad// rang la yon tan 73) med bzhin snyan grags phyir// chos 'chad skye bo'i dbus su bstod pa sogs// ci srid las dag 'dres mar spyod pa'i stobs// gzung 'dzin gdon gyis bslang ba'i mtha' dmag sde'i// 'phel kha chu stag lo nas rim par rgyas// gzhan don lhur blang pad 'byung sprul pa res// smon lam rang rig nus mthu gyad kyi stobs// lo grangs drug cur kla klo'i 'phel kha bzlog /de ltar drug cu drug cu bcu ba'i rjes// rab byung bco lnga'i nang tshan lcags khyi'i sde'i// 'phel kha shing yos lo nas rgyas pa de// gnyan po brgyad de chab mdor blo bzang mtshan// smar yul nus ldan mkha' spyod gling pa dang*// re skong ka gsal pradz+nya rasmi rtsal// zla rgyud mi pham 'jam dpal rdo rje dang*// yang gcig kun bzang bde chen rdo rje dang*// 'jigs med mtshan dang chos nyid rgyal mtshan sde// kaḥthog bde ba'i ming du thub bstan mdzad// rdo yi 74) rgyud gzhol grub rigs 'dzin pa'i sde// bstan pa'i nyi ma bzang po'i mtshan 'chang bas// log smon nus mthu gzhom pa'i rten 'brel yod// nyag tu rang grol mtshan dang bsod nams mtshan*// yang gcig nyer bzhad snying po'i sprul pa dang*/

khyad par bdud 'dul sprul pas chu klung bsgyur/ khyod ni pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la sogs// gter ston brgyad kyi smon lam mthu yod pas// 'char ka rnam gnyis kla klo'i gshed du 'beb// dgon sde gcig min kun la dar rgyas na// lo grangs drug cur jag 'dul dmag dpung bzlog /snga 'gyur chos brgyud 'dzin pa thams cad kyis// rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen la tshad du bskyar// 'gong nag ar gtad lo yi spar kha bsgyur// zla ba'i zad mtshams gter ma'i las sbyor bya// bka' srung chos skyong yul lha zo dor brngan/ khyad par sngags kyi bdag mo e ka dza// dbang phyug rnams gnyis mchod 75) gsol rgyun du brtson// rten 'brel snying po 'bum phrag bzhi bskyar te// sa gnas kun la snying gter chen mo dang*// dzam bha lha dang nor rgyun rig byed ma// ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gter bum bzhugs// gsar ma'i dge btsun skye bu thams cad kyis// bde mchog dgyes pa rdo rje gshin rje gshed// dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha dgu'i bsnyen tshad bskyar// gdugs dkar sgom bzlas gnad theng las sbyor bya// sa mig kun tu bcud kyis gsol ba dang*// rigs gsum mgon po'i sku grangs mang du gdab// yul sde kun gyi sid+dhi sgrol ma dang*// skyabs 'gro tshig bdun gsol 'debs dung phyur grangs// ci mang bskyar zhing dmag ga khrims 'jug ste// dge bcu'i chos la 'bad cing sdig las dor// sa gnas re la rnal 'byor rgyal ma dang*// bdud 'dul mchod rten tshad ldan bzhengs grub gnad// dgon gnas kun gyi 'og dang byang du bya/ 76) khyad par lto phur nag mo'i srog 'dren pa'i// mchod rten nag po bang rim stong rtsa bzhengs// dus gnyen kun tu bsnyen gnas cho ga 'bungs// las sgrib sbyangs phyir sbyin sreg 'bum ther dang*// yig brgya'i dung 'khor grangs mang dar du phyar// bod kyi lha gcig 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha// sku bzhengs gsung rten rdo la brko ba dang*// dung phyur brkyang (bskyar ?)zhing rgyun du yi dam brten// tshogs kyi 'khor lor bye ba tshad du longs// ma hā ka la'i dmag bzlog grub gyur na// bde skyid nyi ma gsar du 'char yang srid// de ltar gnad dang ldan par ma gyur na// shel 'phru can gyis rgya yis sna drangs te// chu mig sa gnad klu yi mig 'phrul nas// nyung dkar bre gang 'byung po'i dmag dpung 'gyed// yul sde kun la mtshon gyis char pa 'bebs/

khrag gi mtsho 'khyil sdig pa'i dud sprin 'khrigs// shi tshad 'drer sdang skye 'gro'i 77) shes brgyud brlabs// mi min yul nas ston pa ma shi ka// 'byung ste log pa'i bstan bcos sna tshogs ston// rang gi 'phrul byed gdon bgegs nad rigs tshogs// byin rlabs byas tsam bcad cing bde bar byed// mu ges mnar ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// sa rdo gser dngul zas gos bsgyur byas te// sbyin pa gtong zhing phan pa'i las ka byed// dang po rgyu 'bras lam ston kun yid ches// de mthar log pa'i bstan bcos bam po lnga'i// don 'brel brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa lnga yis// rgyud bslus kun kyang chos lam de ru zhugs// bstan pa mthar rgyas sham bha la'i grong khyer// gangs ri drug cu tshun ched dbang du byas// de dus klu yi yul sa kya yis phud// kya bstan dar zhing sngar bzhin khyab ba'i tshe// kya yul sogs po gser gyi rna ba can// lcags kyi 'khor los kya bstan hor du byed// kya la kla skyabs log bstan bco lnga 78) 'byung*// nam mkha'i mdog kun kha dog sna tshogs 'byung*// rigs ldan rgyal po ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs// mngon par shes pa lnga yis bltas pa yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' ru thug pa mthong*// gtsug lag khang steng gser gyi rnga brdungs te// g.yu yi khri bshams rigs ldan dmag bsdus na// dus kyi 'khor lor rdo rje rnon po dang*// rdo rje grags po la sogs grub chen brgya// rigs ldan 'khor lo re rer sprul pa las// shar lho nub byang 'dus pa'i gral bsgrigs shing*// kun kyang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs// dmag mi re la rdo rje'i go bskon cing*/

sham bha la'i bskor ro/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa'i// sprul pa re re'i 'gro ba'i don byed do// slar yang rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya 'byung*// de nas rim bzhin tshe lo bcu pa'i bar// bstan pa ma (mar ?)'grib byams mgon bstan pa 'byung*// brgyad khri'i bar du gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ khug 79) pa 'di ni bskal pa'i khug pa min// bstan pa'i khug pa yin te skyon de yang*// dam tshig sdom pa ma bsrung cho 'khor 'gyed// dge ba'i las spangs sdig pa'i las byas pa'i// 'bras bu chud mi za ba smin pa yi// de dus mi nag kha nas chos bshad cing*// dge btsun bsngags pa'i tshogs rnams dkor la 'byams// ngan dgu'i las bral dag tu rgyug cing 'tshor// bstan pa'i srung ma bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi// mig 'bras dam sdom nyams pa'i grib kyis bsgrib// dkar phyogs khas zhan nag phyogs kha dar nas// chos la bar gcod dam tshig nang 'gres byed// sdig pa'i las kyi so nam dpal kha bskyod// rang gi las bsags 'bras bu 'byung ba la// yul rkyen gzhan gyi dbang du ma gyer bar// rang rkyen nyon mongs las ngan tshogs sdom te// rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la blo phug gtod// byang chub sems kyi 80) kun nas bslang ba yi// sdom pa gsum gyis rang rgyud mdzes par gyis// rim gnyis lam bsgom tshe bsgrub mnyam pa dang*// dam tshig ngo skog med par rtag tu bsrung*// sdig pa phra mo'i tshogs la'ang 'dzem par gyis// dper na me stag phra mo tsam gyis kyang*// rtsa phung ri rab chen po bsregs la ltos// dge ba chung ngus mi phan brnyas mi bya// chu yis thigs pas bgrang gsog rgya mtshor 'gyur// thos bsam sgom gsum tshul bzhin bslab par gyis// thos pas rang rgyud ma thul ci la phan// sgom pa gnad du ma song 'ching ba'i rgyu// de phyir rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin// yon mchod sde gnyis kun gyis de bzhin mdzod// skyid tshe dkon mchog gsum po rgyab tu dor// sdug tshe 'o dod ra mda' sbran gyur kyang*// ri gzar rbab bzhin las 'bras bzlog tu med// de phyir skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung yang*// dkon mchog gsum la blo

81) phug rtag tu gtod// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir thugs bskyed smad byung zhing*// rgyal kun phrin las gcig 'dus thod phreng rtsal// yengs med dad pas bskul zhing gsol 'debs 'bungs// des ni nam yang bslu ba yod ma yin// ces pa sogs dang de'i mjug tu/ bod 'bangs las ldan skyes bu thams cad kyis// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal lung ma bsgrub na// mtha' mi'i dmag dpung 'bod pa rang gis byed// de phyir pad 'byung mtsho rgyal bka' bzhin du// rang byas bdud kyi dbang du mi gtong bar// dus rnams kun tu gu ru sid+dhi dang// 'jigs sgrol 'phags pa'i gsol 'debs snying por brtson// mi dge'i sems bor dkar po'i las la 'bungs// pad 'byung byin rlabs nam yang rgyun chad med// bslu med rdo rje'i tshig gis a tham brgya// zhes gsung nas phyag g.yas rje nyid kyi dbu la bzhag nas pha dam pa'i smon lam sum cu pa gsungs nas/ 82) khyod kyi de de bzhin du 'grub par shog cig gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ de nas rim bzhin rang yul phyogs la phebs nas yab rje bla ma dang mjal 'phrad mdzad nas rje nyid kyi phyag tu 'byor ba'i rgyu rdzas dngos po thams cad yab rje bla mar mjal rten du phul/ bla ma rin po ches kyang thugs mnyes par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo bcu dgu'i lor zur bab brda byang mkha' 'gro kun gsal mas gdams pa/ ye yeḥ nub dbu bdud rtse dgu'i nye cha na// mi bsod nams ldan pa rat+na'i ming*// de'i lag las brag gi spre'u rtse// ma dbyings kyi sprul pa ta re'i ming*// rigs dbang por ldan zhing gsal byed legs// lha dmar po'i las kyi mthus bskul nas// dus re zhig nye rgyus dpal la spyod// gnas ma nges nas 'ong ba a ti'i ming*// gdong sme ba rdo rje'i ri mo yod// dpal de la bla ma'i ( dkon mchog spyi 'dus ) sgrub gtor gtod// dpal ye shes sprul pa grol gyi ming*/

83) khyo'i zab pa'i chos dang 'phrad pa'i tshe// blo gnyis 'dzin gyisalas la ma zhen na// sgom byung gi shes rab nang nas rnyed// rten phyi la khyod kyi sras su skyes// zab gter la spyod pa'i skal dang ldan// rgya chen po sa yis gter la dbang*// chos gdul bya bstan pa dbus nas dar// kun gsal gyi rta bdun dbang po khong*// shes rab kyi rtsal shugs stobs ldan kyang*// lha dma' ru rtse yi 'phrul med na// khyod ngam nag brag gi spre'us 'joms// chab srid dang bstan pa nyams yang srid// mi'i lus la bdud kyi blo sems can// las gang byas bstan pa'i bdud du bab// blo rigs pa'i thabs kyis ma spangs na// las bya ba nag po bdud dbang shor// nub sprel ljongs mkha' 'gro gsang phug tu// ri glang chen 'gying 'dra'i g.yas zur na// brag srin mo gnam du 'phyo 'dra yod/ 84) /gnas de ru mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i chos// rigs mi 'dra'i sgrom bu la yang yod// dus rten 'brel gsang thabs tshul du longs// gnas chu gsum 'dus pa'i nye log na// ri bum pa 'dra ba'i lto ba ru// pha mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku dang ni// gnam lcags kyi sdig pa ra dgu yod// de thabs dang rigs pa'i gnad ldan tshe// dus mi ring rang gter lag tu lon// ma 'ongs kyi 'byung 'gyur dus su smra// brda go'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// zhes zer nas yal/ de nas rje'i thugs dgongs la lan grangs mang por mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yod kyang cha mi chod pas/ yab rje bla ma'i drung du byon dgos snyam nas sa gter gyi kha byang dang gter rdzas rnams phyag bsnams mdzad nas bla ma'i sku mdun du phebs/ phyag phul nas bla ma'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas sku mdun du bzhugs te gter rdzas dang kha byang rnams phyag tu phul/ zur 85) bab lung bstan gyi lo rgyus dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal gzigs tshul gyi rnam grangs thams cad sbas gsang med par zhus tshe/

bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyi tshe rabs kyi gzungs ma dang*/ sa gter gyis gnas dang*/ gdul bya'i zhing sa rnams rten 'brel rab dang ldan na stod dbus gtsang phyogs la yod kyang*/ sngon gyi las dbang gis ngas bstan pa la phan thog yod par 'dug pas/ bdud dbang du ma shor na rten 'brel 'bring tsam 'ong thang gsung*/ rje'i zhal nas da lan gyi lung zin ma 'di bdag gi tshe rabs kyi gzungs ma yin nam zhus pas/ khyod gnas skabs re dbang ba ma gtogs tshe rabs kyi las ldan pa dka' mo red gsungs/ rje'i thugs dgongs la gzungs ma dang rten 'brel mi ldan pa e yin/ rten 'brel ldan na nga mi dbang ci la srid dgongs pas/ yab rje bla ma'i zhal nas khyod bsam mno mi dgos dang 86) da lan gyi rten 'brel nga rang gis chos skyong la phrin bcol na ldan gi ta/ lha zab sar bdud zab zer ba'i dpe bzhin dka' mo red gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas bdag gi tshe rabs kyi grogs dang*/ sa gter gyi zab chos rnams lon thabs la ci dgos bla ma rin po che'i gsung du gsol zhus tshe/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas khyod lha sa la 'gro thub na de thams cad kyi stabs 'grigs thang gsungs nas rje de nyid dbus la byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas bla ma'i gsung ltar mi dbang gi sras mo pā shaṃ ta re zhes pa mkha' 'gro'i rigs can zhig yod pa de rgyur bzhes/ dgung lo nyi shu'i lor yab rje bla ma'i bka' bzhin lugs gnyis kyi bya bas bla ma'i bstan zhabs ci 'grub mdzad/ khyad par yab rje'i gsung chos rnams kyi 'chad spel mtha' yas su mdzad/ pad+ma lung rtogs rgya mtsho rje de nyid kyi chos kyi bdag 87) po yin pas zab chos sna 'ga' re gtad/ de nas yab rje'i gter gsar gyi rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pas mtshams dam rgyar bzhugs skabs mnal lam la/ yul skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba me tog sna tshogs rgyas shing*/ bya rigs mi 'dra ba mang pos gu ru ha ri ni sa dbyangs su gyer zhing yod pa/

de'i dbus na 'ja' 'od sna lnga las grub pa'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i khri steng na/ dpa' bo dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing stag lpags kyi smad sham dang dar sna lngas rgyan pa/ dbu skra thor cog tu bcings shing lhag ma sku rgyab khrol ba/ phyag na kā pa la bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa zhig dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i dbus na lham mer bzhugs 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la 'di rnams su yin mjal du 'gro dgos 88) dgongs nas 'byon pa'i tshe na/ mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad nas rje de nyid bsu ba la ma byon (byon ?)nas 'di skad zer/ dpa' bo chen po dri ma med// las skal ldan pa rigs kyi bu// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs gral du// rje khyed byon pa ngo mtshar che// zhes zer nas rje'i phyag la 'jus nas gdan 'dren mdzad de gur khang gi nang na za ber nyis brtsegs kyi khri zhig yod pa de'i steng na rje de nyid bzhugs gsol zhus/ de nas rje'i zhal nas yul 'di gang lags/ 'di na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo 'di su red gsungs pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas yul 'di kañce ka yi gnas red/ dpa' bo 'di rig 'dzin bi ma mi tra red zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas da lan gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ci yin/ bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa i red gsungs/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas bi mi'i bdud rtsi sman bsgrub da dung dus la ma bab/ nam zhig na ne gro rdo rje gsang rdzogs su (rdzong du ?)bsgrub dgos 89) pa yin/ da lan dkyil 'khor rnams kyis thugs sgrub skor gsum gyi nang nas byin rlabs che ba gdam ngag mi 'chug pa brgyud pa'i bab nye ba kun 'dus rin chen snying po gu ru'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bka' babs kyi las ldan la gtad rgya smon lam mdzad nas rgyal tshab tu mnga' dbang gsol dgos zer/

de nas tshogs gral nas mkha' 'gro gnyis byon te rje la khrus gsol mdzad cing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas gsol nas 'di skad do/ ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mchog la// rang 'byung lhun grub brgyan chas gsol// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don kun 'grub// thabs shes gnyis med sangs rgyas shog /ces gsungs nas rje de nyid bi ma mi tra'i mdun du byon nas phyag phul te 'di skad gsol/ skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// bdag ni mtshan dpe ldan pa'i lus 90) thob ste// rdo rje theg pa'i yang zab chos 'phrad nas// gtad rgya smon lam bzang po dus su smin// gu ru yab yum thugs bzhed bsgrub nus shog /'di nas tshe 'phos lus rjes gyur ma thag /dpal ri pad ma 'od kyi pho brang du// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdun bsus nas// bdag dang 'brel thog zhing 'dir skye bar shog /slar yang gdul bya'i mos ngor chu zla bzhin// gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro khams bde la bkod// khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprug nus pa'i// phrin las dam pa'i dpal du bdag 'gyur shog /ces gsol bas/ bi ma mi tra'i zhal 'dzum par mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/ rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig bsdus pad 'byung gis// smon lam las 'khrungs rigs kyi bu mchog khyod// sems dpa' bdag gi thugs dang gnyis su med// rin chen gter gyi las dang skal ba ldan// brtse chen dbang phyug 'gro 91) mgon khyod min nam// zhing 'dir byon pa ngo mtshar rmad po che// zhes gsungs nas/ gu ru bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes te dbang dang gdams pa thams cad pha phog tu gnang tshe/ rje de nyid kyi me tog nub tu babs pas pad+ma gsung gi bka' babs su mnga' gsol zhing de kar nyin zhag bdun phrag gcig la bzhugs/ de nas dbang dang gdams pa rnams zin skabs bi ma mi tra'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung*/ ngas rgya chos bod du ma 'gyur ba thams cad kyi snying po bcud du dril ba/

thugs sgrub che ba snying thig ya bzhi/ 'bring po kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal/ chung ngu gu ru'i thugs kyi sgrub pa rnams yin pas/ da lan khyod la gu ru'i thugs sgrub kyi gter kha dbang ba yin pas/ de la bla sgrub gu ru spyi 'dus sgrub la/ rdzogs chen dri med zang thal/ thugs sgrub byin rlabs gter mdzod/ bka' dgongs phur gsum la sogs pa drag sngags 92) phrin las dang bcas pa chu bo bzhi ldan gyi tshul du 'chug med du thob nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che 'byung bar gdon mi za'o gsungs nas/ gter gnas rig ma chos bdag dang bcas pa'i lung byang gnang nas thams cad kyis tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol/ de nas grogs mkha' 'gro zhig gi 'di skad zer/ da dpa' bo chen po khyod sbas gnas rnams la ltad mo la i 'gro zer/ rje'i zhal nas dpa' bo chen po la zhu dang*/ nga rang gi 'gro dgos mi dgos cha mi chod gsungs pas/ bi ma mi tra'i zhal nas byon na chog gi ltad mo legs po yod/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dus kyi 'pho 'gyur rnams gsal 'ong gsungs/ de nas rje de nyid grogs mkha' 'gro rnams dang bcas sbas gnas chags tshul dang dus kyi mtha' mi 'byung tshul rnams legs par gzigs mthar mnal las sad do/ de nas mtshams khang gang nyin dngos grub len skabs dkyil 'khor 93) nang du gtor ma bdud rtsis zhu ba dang*/ dri bzang 'thul ba sogs rtags mtshan khyad par can 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par yi dam lha'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad pa du mar snang*/ de nas mtshams grol nyin rje de nyid yab rje bla ma'i drung du byon nas phyag phul te mdun du bzhugs tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyis mtshams mthar phyin pa bzang*/ yi dam lhas dngos grub ci ster gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas yi dam gyi zhal gzigs nas 'og min chos dbyings me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams red zer ba gcig la thon snang 'char lags zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas zhing gi bkod pa ji ltar snang smros shig gsungs tshe/ rje de nyid kyi zhal nas zhing bkod ni yul 'jigs su rung ba mi ro dang rta ro gcal du bkram pa keng rus kyi lcags ri sum rim du yod pa'i dbus su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo 94) dang rdo rje rgya gram nyis brtsegs kyi steng du pho brang chen po dmar po zla gam bang rim gyi tshul du yod pa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi la dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bkod pa thams cad rab tu rdzogs pa/ thod pa rkam rlon rnyid gsum gyi rtsigs pa byas shing*/ lha chen po brgyad dang*/ klu chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pas ka ba dang gdung ma grab gshams byas la/ gza' brgyad dang nyi zla'i skar khung*/ sbrul rigs kyi thag pa la thod pa'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ rta babs rnams kyang thod pa dang mi rta la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga dang sgal tshigs dang*/ lha chen po'i thod pa sbubs pa'i mda' yab dang rgya phub/ de'i steng tsit+ti'i tog dang zhing lpags kyi rgyal mtshan dang 'phen bla bre sogs byas pa/ phyi dang bar thams cad me dpung 'khrigs ger gnas 'dug pa'i/ rje'i zhal nas mkha' 'gro ma zhig la 'di'i zhing khams 'di 'og min chos dbyings me ri 'bar 95) ba'i gnas min nam/ yul 'jigs su rung ba 'di ci red gsungs pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas 'di gdul bya kha drangs ba'i phyir dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas red/ 'og min chos dbyings me ri 'bar ba'i gnas 'di'i steng na yod zer/ rje'i zhal nas nga rang zhing de mjal du 'gro dgos zhus pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas khyod skye sngon rigs ldan gra ma lnga'i nang nas srin po blo gros thabs ldan yin dus gsang sngags bla na med pa'i chos kyi skal ba ldan pa yin pas zhing khams mjal du 'gro mi dgos/ 'di nas mi gnas 'das 'og na/ bzang ngan 'brel tshad thams cad zhing 'dir bgrod pa la the tshom dang som nyi ma byed cig

de dus bdag gis kyang khyod bsu mar 'ong zer nas/ ḍāk+ki de 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas zhing bkod la thim snang 'char tshe mnal las sad do 96) zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas rje la khyed gzhal yas khang gi nang du i song gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas nang du 'gro snyam tshe thun grol ran pa la rkyen byas nas gnyid sad byung zhus tshe/ yab rje bla ma'i zhal nas khyod blo gros thabs ldan yin na shes rab la dbang thob pa yin pas/ thos bsam gyi lam la 'bad rtsol mi dgos par rang byung du shes 'ong gsung*/ da khyod kyi mtshams skra zhog la nga yi rjes su 'jug dang*/ bstan 'gro'i don shugs la 'byung 'ong gi/ da dus ngan gyi mi 'di tsho'i bya spyod la ltos dang*/ khyod kyi tshe mtha' bdud dbang du mi shor ba gal che gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas bla ma rin po che lags/ bdag gi tshe mtha' bdud dbang du mi 'gro thabs ci dgos/ bla ma rin po che khyod kyis bdag la lung bstan du gsol zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas gnas dus kyi 'gro ba rnams log lta che zhing bsod nams zhan pa 97) dang*/ dus kyi dmag 'khrug nad yams mu ge sogs mang ba'i rkyen dang*/ khyad par rgan mo (po ?)nga rang 'chi tshe mtha' yi rgya hor gyi 'jigs pa nye 'ong nges pa yin pas/ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur sogs cing 'ong ci cha ci la yod/ de'i skabs su 'gro ba rnams kyi shes rgyud bdud kyis brlabs nas rang gzhan phung la sbyor ba dang*/ mtha' mi kla klo'i kha dar nas bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad phrin thams cad rkyen dbang du 'gro ba mang bas de la bya thabs dka' mo red/ de'i phyir na khyod kyang bstan 'gro'i gsos su sman pa'i skyes bu zhig 'dug pas gnas dus kyi bsgyur bas bdud dbang la gzab dgos/ nga rang yong tshe khyed rkyen dbang ngan pa'i mi tshugs/ phyi'i nga (da ?)phan khyod kyi legs nyes thams cad ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ltar sgrubs dang rang gzhan gyi don chen po 'byung 'ong gsung*/
