98) de nas rje nyid kyis bla ma'i bka' gnang bzhin mtshams skra 'jog par mdzad/ bla mas skra dbang gsung skabs bla ma'i zhal nas nga rnal 'byor pa snang bar dbang thob kyi skyes bu yin pas/ da lan khyod la spros med don gyi gsang dbang bskur ba yin gsung nas/ gsang chab bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis skra dbang yongs rdzogs bskur te dpa' bo yab yum rten bzhugs skabs/ rje de nyid kyi sku lus 'phar ba dang g.yo ba 'khras ('khrab ?)pa sogs rang dbang me par mdzad/ gnas khang phyi nang kun dri bzang gi ngad 'thul ba dang*/ gling bu dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra sgrogs pa sogs rtags mtshan can du ma byung*/ de'i nub mnal lam la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon du byon nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang po dang chabs gcig tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po mdzad tshe/ kun gyi nged cag rnams kyis dga' ston byed kyin yod 99) zair nas/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad kyis glu bro gar la sogs pa mdzad tshe/ rje'i thugs dgongs la 'di rnams dga' spro de tsam byed pa ci yin dgongs/ mo zhig gis na re nga dpa' bo mkha' 'gros dga' spro glu gar los byed/ khyed dpa' bo yongs 'dus kyi ngo bo bdag cag ḍāk+ki rnams kyi tshogs rje tshogs dpon ma bcos bzhi ldan gyi rnal 'byor dam par mnga' gsol ba yin pas/ dga' ston glu gar gyi mchod pa byed pa des yin zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas ma bcos bzhi ldan gyi rnal 'byor ldan lugs ji ltar yin gsungs pas/ yang ḍāk+ki'i sku'i gar bsgyur te gling bu'i sgra la drangs nas 'di skad zer/ ha ho haṃ/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis// las 'phro ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la// tshig la brten nas don dbang bskur// rtsal dbang yongs rdzogs lhun gyis grub// gsum ldan 100) rdo rje 'dzin pa che// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su bsngags// ma bcos rang byung lcang lor ldan// ma brgyud mkha' 'gro'i brtse bas bskyangs// rnam rtog dri bral gnag snum mdzes// rigs kun yongs 'dus spyi bor bcings// bla med don gyi rnal 'byor pa'i// ral pa ma bcos lcang lor ldan// gang snang ye shes grogs su shar// ma bcos gos dkar mthing (mthang ?)sham dkris// nyon mongs skyon gyi dri ma bral// sems nyid ma bcos gnyug mar gnas// sku gsum mnyam nyid dbyings su chub// rgyan cha ma bcos rus rgyan gsol// tshogs drug ma spangs longs su spyod// mnga' ldan zhing la mnga' dbang bsgyur// mkha' 'gro sems kyi chos 'phrul te// dpa' bo khyod kyi grogs su spyod// ces zer nas tshogs kyi mchod pa tshim pa drug ldan du longs spyod pa'i snang ba 'char tshe mnal las sad do/

de nas dgung lo nyer 101) gcig lor rdo lung ri zab nang du sgar bzhugs tshe mnal lam la mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha yin skad pa zhig gis 'di skad zer/ e eḥ bsil ldan ri 'ong 'od ldan// chu 'dzin nag pos bsgrib nas// mi ring dpyid kyi rgyal mo// lho la chas pa i nam// nam mkha'i nor bu'i 'od zer// nub kyi rma byas bskul nas// dbyar rnga'i gtsug tu i nam// skyib ser dbang zhug (zhu ?)'phrad tshe// nus ldan me (med ?)gshog bskul na// skom sel sman du e nam/ kī la ya yi dbal kha// 'dre mo'i snying la phog na// rgya stag 'dzom drug 'od ldan// lho nas 'ong ba i nam// nam zla'i rgya mo'i skad snyan// lto 'gro'i lto bar bgrang tshe// ma nges gnas gsum 'grim na// nyes sel gegs las grol nges// sap+ta'i dbang du song na// mi ring sgyu ma'i ltad mo// dbang po'i yul du shar 'ong*// sa ga zla ba'i 'dzum mdangs// ngam nag sprin gyis bsus nas// mi 'dod sna 'ga' 'byung srid/ 102) /byang smad bdud kyi byad zor// bzlog thabs gnad la rem dgos// de sogs rigs pas dpyod dang*// legs nyes sna kha gsal nges// zhes zer yal/ rje'i thugs dgongs la ci yin sgar ba la mi bde ba zhig 'ong bar 'dug dgongs nas/ yab rje bla ma'i drung du byon te mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gyi rigs rnams zhib par zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas da lo rkyen ngan 'tshubs ma re 'ong thang gi/ lung bstan gang la bltas kyang legs po zhig mi 'ong ba 'dra gsungs/ yang rjes nga yi ma yum nad gzhi ngan pas de 'chi 'gro ba i yin snyam zhus pas/ bla mas sangs mtsho lo bar cha shes la mi skyon gi ta/ ka sgron 'di la 'khrug ni red gsung*// de nas lo khyim de ka'i nang du mi 'dod pa 'ga' re 'byung yang yi ge mang bar dogs nas ma bris so/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis lor yab rje bla ma'i zhal nas

103) da khyod shar phyogs sprel rdzong brag dkar gyi gter rnams len pa'i dus la bab 'dug pas 'gro grabs gyis la song gsungs/ de nas rje'i zhal nas nga ji ltar byas nas 'gro dgos/ bla ma rin po che khyed kyis gsung du gsol zhus tshe/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas grwa 'khor mang po byas nas sgar gzhis mi dgos mod/ bya bral gyi tshul du gnyen khrod 'grim zhor la song gsung*/ rje de nyid kyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin nye gnas 'od 'bar dang*/ bla ma'i dngos slob rnal 'byor dam pa sgo spa'i zab gsang zhes pa de gnyis phyag phyir khrid de gro khal ci yang med par zhabs thang la gnyen khrod brgya rtsar byon grabs byas te/ bla ma'i mdun du sku khams bde mor bzhugs/ zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas rang gi spyod lam pa byed gsung te/ gzim khang gi rwa ba'i nang du bla ma byon nas 'di skad gsung*/ da chos thams cad 104) rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pas/ pha rjes bu yis zin pa'i phyir du nga rang gi gzan dkar dung rna mthang sham la sogs pa thams cad bu khyod la gtad pa yin pas/ nga'i dgongs rgyud kyi byin rlabs dang tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang gzi brjid thams cad khyod la thob par shog cig zab gter gyi pha phog thob nas gu ru pad ma'i thugs bzhed ma lus pa rdzogs shing gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i gsos su sman par shog cig rje btsun mi la lta bu mthong thos kyi 'gro ba rnams thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'god nus par shog cig tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung zhing rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po gdan thog cig tu 'grub par shog cig gter srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi bdag gi bu 'di la kha 'dzin dang sdong grogs mdzod cig dgra 'dre gdon gsum gyi snying srog chod la rjes med du thongs shig phyi nang gi 105)bar chad thams cad sel zhing mgon skyabs grogs ldan gyi phrin las mdzod cig gsungs te/

phyag g.yas rje'i dbu la bzhag nas cung zad dgongs pa mdzad/ de nas chang kā pa la gang rje la gnang nas 'di gna' mi'i srol red/ mar pa lo tsas mi la ras pa brag dkar rto po la phebs dus skyel chang gnang ba bzhin/ ngas kyang khyod sprel rdzong brag dkar la byon skyem du blud pa yin pas lhag med du 'thung dang byin rlabs kyi sna kha re thob 'ong gsung nas chang de rje la gnang bas lhag med du gsol/ de nas rje de nyid bla ma dang 'bral ma thub par bla ma'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas smon lam mdzad de yun ring la bzhugs pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas da khyod grogs po rnams dang bcas de song*/ nga rang na so lon pas de phan thag ring por skyel mi thub gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas bla ma rin po che khyed kyis bdag skye 106) ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma khyed dang 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad pa bka' drin mi chung ba khyed mkhyen gsung*/ bla ma'i phyag la 'jus nas yab sras bral ma spobs par bshum par mdzad pas/ bla mas kyang rje de nyid thugs la shin tu brtse bas thugs chung bar mdzad tshe/ der 'dus kyi bu slob thams cad kyang bla ma yab sras gnyis ka thugs 'dun che ba la smon nas thams cad kyi sems dga' skyo 'dres par song nas gtad med du 'dug de nas bla mas kyang gzim khang gi phyi rol du bskyel thung mdzad/ gzhan bu slob chos bdag rnams kyis rgyang ring po ru skyel ma mdzad/ de nas rje bu slob rnams la chos dang gdams pa'i zhal ta mdzad nas bu slob thams cad kyi thugs skyo skyo mdzad ngang rang yul la log rje dpon g.yog gsum po dben khrod la rim bzhin byon pas smar gyi log na 107) lung zhes pa'i mdar phebs tshe/ bla ma dpon g.yog gnyis dang mjal bas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la a lco 'di gnyis ngo shos zhig yin par 'dug dgongs nas yar yar phebs tshe ngo mi shes pa zhig snang bas/

rje'i ci yang ma gsung par byon pas/ a lco na re 'di skad zer/ a lags sang sku'i khams bzang lags/ gang nas yin/ da lan gang du phebs zer bas/ rje'i zhal nas nga sprang po zhig yin/ gnas bskor la 'gro ba yin gsungs/ kho na re khyed kyis nga ma dgongs sam zer/ rjes kyang khyod mi shes pa 'dra gsungs/ yang kho na re/ ngas sngar khyed ku ku ras pa yin skabs/ mi tri pa'i slob ma ko'u mi tri yin/ 'u cag gnyis smon lam las 'phro ldan pas skye phreng du mar lhan du 'brel yod kyang khyed kyis mi dgongs sam zer/ 108) yang rje'i zhal nas sngar gyi ku ku mi tri dang ko'u rnams kyis lo rgyus dang (nga ?)rang gis shes kyang*/ da ris skye ba 'di'i ko'u mi tri'i sprul pa su red gsung pas/ yang kho na re lag rten la 'jus nas 'di skad zer/ rnal 'byor ko'u mi tri dang*// skye ba med pa 'od gsal sku// 'gags pa med pa 'khor 'das gsal// snang srid gsal ba'i me long yod/ khyed ku ku nas bzung da bar du// bstan 'gro ba'i dpal du shar ba rnams// ngas 'chug med brda yi ris su btab// dus smon lam 'dzom na gtad rgya khrol// nga rgyal khams 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor ngas// ku ku dang ko'u'i lo rgyus dang*// 'byung 'gyur gyi gtam rnams zur tsam bshad// khyod g.yo rgyu rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// rtogs pa phul phyin mkhas shing grub pa brnyes// zab chos gsang ba man ngag sde gsum gyis/ 109) /chos mdzod gdams pa'i gter sgo du ma phyes// de dus ko'u mi tri'i sprul pa ni// chos kyi bdag po 'od zer go cha yin// zab chos bstan pa'i gsos su sman par 'gyur// rnol mo sgang du pad+ma gling par bzhengs// kun bzang dgongs pa'i chos mdzod du ma dang*// zab gter bdun la dbang zhing 'gro ba 'dren// de dus ko'u mi tri'i sprul pa ni// chos kyi bdag po skyes bu pad+ma rtsal// yi ge'i 'du byed zab gter phrin las rgyas// yol mo gzhung du khyod ni bsam gtan gling*// mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i snying thig chos la dbang*// de dus ko'u mi tri'i sprul pa ni// chos bdag skyes bu bsod nams bstan 'dzin 'byung*// zab gter gnyis kyis 'dzin skyong mtha' rgyas mdzad// de dag che long tsam zhig brjod pa yin// slar yang khyod ni be ro nam snying dang*// kun bzang mtsho skyes

110) rdo rje g.yu sgra yi// sprul pa gter ston gsang sngags gling pa zhes// spro thung rig pa hur zhing chos nyid mthong*// zab gter gsum 'dom gdul bya thabs kyis 'dren// de dus ko'u mi tri'i sprul pa ni// chos bdag skyes bu sna tshogs rang grol 'byung*// de nas mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og na/ khyod ni gter ston pad+ma klongs yangs dang*// o rgyan bzhad pa rtsal zhes grub brnyes pa// mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i snying thig chos la dbang*/ khyad par sa gter bdun gyis bstan 'gror sman// de dus ko'u mi tra'i sprul pa ni// rigs kyi myu gu 'am ni chos kyi bdag /gter ston khrag 'thung gar gyi dbang phyug 'byung*/ khyod kyi gter gnas gang yin zhes pa na// rma chen spom ra pad+ma ri mtho dang*// sprel rdzong brag dkar g.yu mtsho brag dkar dang*/ 111) /seng ge rdzong gsum sgrags mda' ri bo che// ngang pa lha ri sdong ra brag dkar dang*// dril zhon lha rtse shing lo yig drug ma// seng ge sgong mchong nam gro la sogs nas// gnas chen gter chen gnas phran gter phran 'don// zab gter du mas chos sgo gsar du 'byed// rdzas gter sku tshab rin chen gzi sgrom dang*/ 'chong sgrom shel sgrom g.yu sgrom me yi sgrom// gnam lcags phur pa thugs rten rdo rje dang*// gter rigs mi 'dra brgya dang rtsa brgyad yod// re 'ga' chos gter phal cher rdzas gter 'don// de dag log lam sab+ta'i ma bsgyur zhing*// tshul bzhin len pa'i rten 'brel dus 'dzoms na// mtha' mis kla klo'i 'phel kha lo brgyar bzlog /gter gyi grogs dang chos bdag gang zhe na// mi min lha yi rigs can u tra lnga*// rigs dang nye gnas 112) smon lam dbang gis 'dzom// de rnams khyod sngon gter rigs 'dzin pa'i dus// gzugs med lha 'dre gdul byar gzigs nas ni// gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'gro khams bde la bkod// de dus de rnams smon lam rnam dag po'i// zung 'jug rten 'brel 'byung ba de ltar lags// dbyings kyi sprul pa dbyings snang mkha' 'gro lnga// stag yos 'brug sbrul glang ngam khyi lo pa// de dag rtsa ba'i gzungs ma ḍāk+ki lnga// phral phral dngos grub gter dang gdul bya rgyas// dbang thang spel dang rigs brgyud 'dzin pa yi// cha gsum ya bzhi gter gyi grogs su mngag(bsngags/?)

/de dag rtsa ba'i gzungs dang grogs rnams ni// rang rang brda byang ji bzhin ma nor bar// skabs rer gter la phan pa'i nye rgyu dang*// rdzas sogs rten 'brel dus las mi yol ba'i// thabs mkhas shes rab mig gis 'byed pa mdzod// tshe rabs mang 'brel mchog gi gzugs ma ni/ 113) /nub phyogs sprin dkar khur ba'i sgra brgyar 'dzin/ (gnas ?) /zhing rkyes zab mo gter la dbang*// pad+ma'i rigs can spyi mgrin snying ga ru// baṃ dang ha ri ni sa'i ri mo yod// spro thung rig pa hur zhing spyod lam mdzes// dkar dmar rme ba'i lus kun rgyan ris bkra// mchan dang mkhal khung dga' 'khyil g.yung drung mdzes// gnod sbyin chen por phrin las bcol ba dang*// 'gugs byed lcags kyu'i sbyor bas las brtsams na// sngon smon rten 'brel dus su sad par nges// de dus nag po bdud dbang ma shor na// sku tshe'i 'phel kha bdun bcur 'tsho bar 'gyur// chos kyi bka' bab skyes bu'i rim pa ni// ko'u mi tri 'brog ma'i sprul pa ni// lha yi gdung rigs mi ring nye ba'i sar// sgra brgya'i lo khur rang grol ming mtha' can// smon lam ldan pa bi ma'i rnam sprul ni// bi tra'i ming 'dzin rlung sems chos la dbang*// pad 'byung sprul pa su kha badz+ra dang*/ 114) /mdo gsum 'dus pa'i nye char dus su 'dzom// yi ge'i 'du byed chos bdag skyes bu ni// mi ring rang gnas shar stod phyogs na yod// badz+ra ming can smon lam dbang gis 'phrad// yang cig a tsar sprul pa bir yā'i (bid+ya'i ?)ming*// pur ṇ+ya'i (pudz+ye'i ?)ming dang sang gha bi ma'i ming*// de wa kirta'i ka ra shin+taṃ ming*// a yu gu ṇa karmā dharma'i ming*// rat+na badz+ra la sogs rim gyis 'byung*// rang rang dbang skal gdams pa nyams blang nas// tshe 'di don gnyis 'grub pa sha stag 'byung*// de dag khyed kyi gdul bya zur tsam yin//

yang gcig gson dang rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ khyod ni bstan dang 'gro ba'i don las med// chos brgyad blos thongs dben rir btsan sa zung*// 'tsho ba yo byed slong mo'i zas la brten/ (/rtsa na ?)sum srung ma gsang na thabs tshul du bsgrub// zag med ye shes bde chen pho nyar brten// longs spyod mchog de 'phags nor gces spras mdzod/ 115) /bya byed thams cad 'gro ba'i don la btson// pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang dri bral ltar/ khyod kyang 'khor ba'i dri ma kun spangs nas// gcig pur dben rir sgrub pa pha mthar 'khyol// ko'u mi tri gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor pa// skal ldan bu la snying tshig gdams pa 'di// yal bar ma dor tsit+ta'i ga'ur sbos// brda don go'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// rigs pas dpyod dang dus su gsal bar nges/ a tham/ zhes zer nas gar song med par yal/ de nas mgon lung mda' ru phebs nas gsol phog mdzad tshe/ rje'i zhal nas grwa pa gnyis la da nangs mgron po gnyis de khyod gnyis kyi i rig gsung pas/ nye gnas 'od 'bar gyis mgron po mi rta can zhig ma gtogs ma mthong*/ zab gsang gis byi ba gnyis 'dzing gyin yod pa de mthong*/ de min rnal 'byor pa gnyis po gcig gis kyang ma rig par 'dug pas/ 116) rjes kyang gsang bar mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin byon pa'i lam khar mgron po rnams kyis su yin dris tshe bya bral ba zhig yin gsungs nas/ rje yin par gsang rgya mdzad/ de nas mkho mdar phebs nas grwa ba gnyis pos gsol ja skol tshe/ rje de nyid skya bsang la thon tshul mdzad nas/ sngar a khu khro thung gi gdan sa'i shul yod pa der phebs ste/ khro thung la lha rta mgrin dmar pos gnang ba'i ral gri btab pa len (lan ?)med dam stong gsum g.yul bzlog gter du sbas yod pa de rje nyid kyi gter skal min kyang*/ sngar gling gi dus su che rgyud kyi chung brgyud la sdug gtad pa'i rim pa rnams thugs la shar tshe/

de la rkyen byas te ral gri de gter nas bzhes pas/ rgyu gnam lcags li khra las byas pa/ ri brag gang du gzir kyang rang dbang med par shig shig yom yom byas shing 'gul ba/ tshad ni gzhu 'dom gnyis 117) tsam yod pa zhig 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la 'di sbas gsang ni dka' 'dug grwa pa gnyis po kha ngan pa'i i 'dzings dgongs nas phar bzhag yang gter rdzas yin pas skyon med/ a mtshar tsam du grwa pa gnyis po la bstan dgos dgongs te phyag bsnams mdzad nas byon tshe/ brag ngos lam dog mo zhig yin pas/ rjes ga ler mdzad de byon 'ong ba'i lam kha de la mi lus po thams cad mig gis gang ba mdog nag la sngo mdangs chags pa zhig 'ong nas bsdad 'dug rje'i zhal nas khyod phar song nga 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ kho na re khyod gshogs pa yod na gnam la 'phur/ sder mo yod na sa la 'dzus ('ardzul?)/ grub thob yin na zang thal du song*/ nga 'dug sa 'di yin pas mi 'gro zer/ yang rje'ithugs la 'di ci yin/ gter bdag i yin/ slong tshad 118) i yin dgongs nas cung zad dgongs par bzhugs pas gter bdag yin par dgongs/ yang rjes khyod song gsungs kyang mi 'gro bar 'dug kho na re khyod kyis nga'i nor khyer song bas de sbyin na nga 'gro min na mi 'gro zer/ rjes ngas grwa pa gnyis la lta ru bcug nas yang phyir sprad 'ong gsungs pas/ kho na re nga rang gi nor phyir mi bskur zer/ yang rje'i zhal nas khyod kyi nor 'di'i bdag po su red gsungs pas/ rdzogs chen dpon slob zhes pa de red/ da lan stabs i ldan mi shes zer/ stabs mi ldan pa ci red gsungs tshe/ kho 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin zer skad/ rang sems gyong po ma 'dul na 'dul ba zer kyang don sgo chung zer/ rje'i zhal nas da khyod kyi nor 'di khyer la song gsungs nas kho yi lag tu gnang tshe/ kho sbrul zhig tu gyur nas ral gri kha nang du bzung ste khyer song ba'i rjes su gzigs tshe/

119) ral gri chung du ma song sbrul che ru ya song bar gter sgo'i nang du song bas/ de ma thag par brag nyil nas gter sgo mi snang bar gyur/ de nas phyir thab khar byon nas ja gsol bar mdzad/ yang rim bzhin byon te nyi ma tis le can zhes pa'i lung mdar nub mo bzhugs gnas mdzad tshe/ tho rangs khar mnal lam la bud med dmar mo 'jigs su rung ba shin tu khros pa'i nyams can mi lpags kyi stod g.yog dang smad dkris byas pa/ ral pa dmar ser thur du 'phyang ba/ nu ma gnyis phrag pa g.yas g.yon du khur ba/ mche ba gangs ri ltar dkar sang sang byed pa/ mig gnyis 'bru tshugs su blta zhing 'di skad zer/ khyod rnal 'byor pa yin na 'dir 'dug pas ci byed/ rgyal khams la 'gro don los yod/ 'dir ma 'dug zer/ rje'i zhal nas nga rnal 'byor pa yin/ gnas bskor la 'gro ba yin gsung 120) pas/ mo na re khyod kyis rdzun ma lab/ nged kyi 'khor thams cad khyod kyi chos sgor btsud song bas 'u cag gnyis la gyod yod zer nas/ ral gri zhig 'dug pa de rje la 'phang tshad byed 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la 'di lha 'dre'i slong tshad zhig red dgongs nas gcod dmigs kyi drwa bar bcings pas/ mo yang je ngan du song nas nyam thag pa zhig tu gyur nas 'di skad zer/ 'jig rten 'gro ba'i mgon gcig po// thugs rje chen po bdag la dgongs// srog gi snying po gdan du 'bul// nyes can btson las thar bar mdzod// ces zer zhing ngu skad tsir tsir byed 'dug pas/ rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ kun mkhyen pad 'byung gro bo lod// dbyer med bdud 'joms he ru ka /'bral med bde chen 'khor lor rol// tshur nyon dang 'khrul snang yid gzugs 'chang*// nga 'khrul snang zhig pa'i rnal 'byor 121) la// slong dang cho 'phrul rgyan du shar// pha rtogs ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// chos 'dzin pa rang grol gyi gdams pa yod// nga bden med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// lha 'dre gnyis 'dzin gyi spros pa zhi// pha bla ma'i thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis// re dwogs ro snyoms kyi gdams pa yod// nga 'khor 'das gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor la// yid gzugs 'dre gdon la ya mi nga*// snang tshad chos nyid kyi grogs su gyur// gnyis med ye shes kyi gdams pa yod// phyi snang ba'i yul la nga mi 'jigs// gnyan sa lam lhong gi gdams pa yod/

nang phung po'i zhen pa dbyings su yal// gces 'dzin rang grol gyi gdams pa bdog /gsang skyon nyon mongs 'khu 'khrig 'di// rtsal ldan ye shes lngar rgyas btab nas// sku gsum mnyam rdzogs kyi gdams pa bdog /da snying rje'i yul du gyur pa khyod// nga pad 'byung sprul pa'i bka' la nyon// gdug sems gnod pa las 122) thongs la// sems can rnams la phan 'dod pa'i// don rnams gang dag khyed kyis sgrubs// gnas mgron dam tshig gnyan po yi// rdo rje'i bka' la ma 'da' zhig /zhes gsungs pas/ mo na re nga yi srog snying khyed la 'bul zer nas bh+yo yig dmar nag zhig tu gyur nas mi snang bar song*/ nangs snga mo skyo tsha gsol dus pha ri brag dmar po gnam du gzeng ba lta bu zhig 'dug pa'i/ de kar gzigs tshe nub mo gzim lam la byung ba'i mi mo de 'dra zhig gis rjes gsungs pa'i don rnams rjes zlos byed cing mo rang gis grogs mo rnams la zer 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs la sman mo yin par dgongs nas ting nge 'dzin gyi drwa bar bcun par mdzad/ de nas ngan 'bu lung du bum pa ri zer ba de'i ri ngor skyo bsang la dpon g.yog gnyis phebs nas bzhugs yod tshe/ pad+ma ri mtho'i phyogs zhig gzigs pas/ rje'i zhal nas pha gi gnas khyad par ba zhig 123) yin 'dug pas/ 'brel ba re bzhag na bzang snyam gsungs/ sgo bla'i zhal nas pha gi 'u cag yod pa'i phar ngos red/ tshur lam byon na chog gi zer/ rjes gter gnas su dgongs nas da 'u cag gis pha gi la dmigs nas lab rtse zhig 'jog dgos gsung nas/ dpon g.yog gnyis kas rdo dkar nag mang po bsdus te lab rtse 'jog skabs/ sgo bla'i khyed de byis pa na so chung zhad kyi 'o mi rgyal gi ta/ nga rang rgas pa'i mtshan nyid kyis dka' 'ong gi zer nas rdo yung de'i zur du bsdad 'dug rje'i zhal nas khyod sdod dang rdo ngas rnyed 'ong gsungs nas lung pa'i phar ngos sar byon pa'i lam kha la me tog yid du 'ong ba'i nang na sbrang bu zhig gi 'phur lding g.yo zhing skad snyan pa'i 'di skad zer/

waṃ waṃ waṃḥ rang yul phyogs nas 'ong bas// mdzes ldan bung ba gzhon nu// pha 124) gcig bdud 'joms rdo rjes/ khyed la ngag gsal bskur yod// sgra 'dzin dbang po ma yeng*// dal gcig nga la gson dang*// ye grol so ma'i gnas lugs// rtsol bcas bcos ma'i ma bslad// sbas brag pad+ma rdzong la// snying thig skor rnams sbas yod// 'brug zla'i tshes bcur dus yin// rten dang 'brel 'byung ma 'dzol// stabs ka gzab pa gnad yin// grogs la mthun mkhon ma bro// rang byung brtul zhugs spyod pas// rkyen snang dbyings su bsgral dgos// dmar po lha gnyis gsol mchod// grangs ldan myur du bsgrub nas// dgra jag ar la gtad dgos// da ni mi ring myur du// spre'u rdzong du byon nas// don gnyis nor bu len ran// dus rnam 'du 'bral med par// pha la gsol ba thob dang*// bsam don bar chad med par// de 'bras myur du 'grub nges/ 125) /zhes zer nas 'phur ldingagi tshul du mi snang bar gyur/ de la rkyen byas nas rje de nyid kyis yab rje bla ma shin tu dran nas smre sngags kyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ kyai hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'bral med bde chen 'khor lo'i brgyan du bzhugs// bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyi rlobs// gter chen bla ma'i gter zhabs dkyil 'khor la// yang yang bu ngas skal ldan mjal ba'i dus// gang 'dod smin grol gdams pa'i chos mdzod gnang*/ khyad par snying rje'i (snying po'i ?)gdams pa rdzogs pa'i tshe// thabs mang dka' ba med pa'i man ngag mchog /nyams len dmar khrid gces nor tshul du gnang*// rang byung ye shes mngon gyur rang ngo sprad// ma bcos khyab brdal rig pa byang chub sems// sku dang ye shes yon tan rang chas rdzogs// srid zhi gnyis

126)med mnyam nyid chos sku'i dbyings// ma bcos lta ba'i mtshan nyid legs par rtogs// tha mal shes pa zang thal bcos bsgyur bral// gza' gtad kun bral blo 'das 'od gsal dang*// rgya yan ma bcos cog bzhag bzhi ldan ngang*// rang bab mngon gyur sgom pa'i rang sa rnyed// gang shar spang blangs mtshan 'dzin rnam par dag /snang ba thug 'phrad shes pa rang sar klod// shar grol gnyis med ye shes rjen par grol// rang byung ma bcos spyod pa grogs su shar// ngo bo ye stong 'od gsal chos kyi sku// gsal mdangs ma 'gags rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje kun khyab phyogs med sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum mngon gyur 'bras bu bzhin du grol// de ltar rim par mi ltos myur ba'i lam// pha gcig bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed pa yin// yon tan sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs na yang*// bka' drin sangs rgyas kun las khyad par 'phags// bdag ni tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du/ 127) /yab rje bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// zab gter rgya mtsho'i chos la longs spyod nas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas rdo dkar nag 'ga' phyag bsnams mdzad de sgo bla'i zur du byon pas/ kho na re khyod kyis rdo 'di gter nas drangs ba i yin/ nga rang 'dug tshod med pa lta bur 'byung zer/ rje'i zhal nas gter min nga rang gi rkang pa rdo gris bcad pa'i khrag ma chod pa yin gsung*/ de nas dpon g.yog gnyis kas lab rtse'i 'grub thab khar gsol sar byon pas/ 'od 'bar gyis khyed dpon g.yog go chod zer/ rje'i zhal nas rtsed mtshar gyi tshul du gter 'don pa'i lo rgyus re gsungs tshe rten 'brel btang snyoms la song*/ de nas bla ma'i lung bstan pa bzhin myur bar byon pas rtsang skong nang du phebs nas/ rtsang ba sku chung gi nu bo bso stan zer ba'i mi skya zhig yod pa des rje de nyid yin par thos nas gro kha dang lam rgyag sogs mthun rkyen zhabs zhu legs par byas/

de nas rim bzhin byon pas sma spom ra'i g.yas lung 'brong sde sdang ro zer ba'i thang dkyil chen po zhig tu bzhugs yod pas/ sgo bla 'bud shing thu bar song tshe rgyang mi ring ba'i mtshams su to nyag zhig yod pa de ka nas skya mi mang pos so ba byed kyin 'dug pa mthong nas/ myur bar tshur 'ong nas lo rgyus rnams bshad pas/ rjes bla mas lung bstan 'ong ba'i don 'di red dgongs nas gsol kha gsungs tshe/ drang srong gi cho 'phrul mngon sum du bstan pa'i/ jag mi rnams kyi blo kha log nas rang gnas la song*/ rje dpon g.yog kyang lam dgra med par byon/ yang hang ra'i khog zer ba der thon song bas/ rgya grong gi gnas khang du ma yod pa'i nang nas dud tshang che ba zhig gi rwa 129) ba'i nang du gnas tshangs g.yar nas zhag bzhugs mdzad tshe/ de'i nub mnal lam la mi lwa ba sngon po gyon pa skra dang sma ra dmar ser du song zhing yan lag gi sen mo thams cad lcags las grub pa/ kha sna nas khrag rnag 'dzag cing ham pa dang tul ba'i dri ngan 'thul ba/ dpung du mi skya pho mo byis pa chung ngu mang po khrid pa zhig 'ong nas rje dpon g.yog la gnod pa brtsams tshe rjes dgongs nas thugs snying rje chen pos de dag las snang sdug bsngal las grol bar mdzad tshe/ gdon rnams na re 'u cag chos lugs mi mthun pas/ khyod kyis de rnams la phan par mi 'gyur ba gnod par 'dug da dung nged rnams la dpung mang po yod pas khyod la nged kyis dmag byed nas 'ong zer/ rje'i zhal nas snying rje/ khyed rnams 'khrul snang rang brgyud du gol nas gnod sems dang gdug sems ldan kyang*/ nga chos nyid don gyi rnal 'byor la glags mi nus kyang khong khro ma byed/ 130) byang chub kyi sems dang ldan na 'khor ba dong nas sprug nus pa'i mthu yod de chos lugs la mi stos gsungs/ de nas gdon rnams kyi ci yang mi smra ba phar lta tshur lta byas nas bud song*/

de nas rje'i thugs la rgya 'dre yin par 'dug kyang gnod pa byed ma nus 'dra dgongs pa'i/ rgan mo zhig thon byung ba'i de la rjes da ris kyi mi 'di rnams ci red gsungs pas/ mo na re mi de tsho rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon the'u rang nang dem la sogs pa'i rgya 'dre 'gong po'i dmag dpung red zer/ yang rjes da lan 'di rnams gang du 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ mo na re gter chen bdud 'joms rdo rje dpal ri la byon ran 'dugs pas/ de byon na khong rnams de'i yul phyogs su 'gro dgos zer/ da lan khyod la gnod pa byed du 'ong ba yin yang stabs lags ma 'grigs pa'i tsa tsa tha tha zer 'dug pas/ tsa tsa tha tha ni khyod kyi 'khor dang yon bdag skyabs 'og pa rnams la zer/ khyod 131) rang la gnod pa mi thub kyang de rnams la gnod pa byed 'dug pas/ gang snang thams cad gcod dmigs dang gnyan gtad byas pa sogs gces 'dzin blos bor ba'i spyod pa skyongs la/ sku gsum mnyam nyid kyi dbyings su chos kun ye shes chen por 'gags sdom shig zer nas yal/ rje'i mnal sad pa dang thugs mi bde bar lta bu song 'dug kyang ci yang ma gsungs/ nangs snga skyo tsha gsol nas lam du bzhud tshe sgo bla dang lhan du sku mal gsos nas bzhugs skabs/ rje'i zhal nas 'u cag rnams pha yul du myur bar thon song na bzang gi/ yab rje bla ma'i sku tshe yun ring brtan mi go gi gsungs/ sgo bla'i bla ma rin po che nas sku tshe los brtan dkar lha'i legs so byas yod zer skad/ yang rje'i zhal nas rtsa ba'irig ma lnga rdzogs tshar/ sku tshe'i gegs sel gyi gzungs ma zhig yod kyang da ris stabs ma ldan/ dkar lha bu slob rnams kyis zhal bkod red bla ma'i (mas ?)gsung 'dug pa'i (pas?)dka' mo 132) yin gsungs/ sgo blas 'u cag phar ma thon pa zhig gis tshur pha yul la myur du mi thon a/ khyed kyi 'byung med ma bshad zer nas lam du song*/

rje de nyid kyang rjes nas byon song ba'i bar skabs zhig la brag dkar sprel rjong rig 'ong ba'i grogs rnams kyis dga' ba bsgom/ de nas rim bzhin gnas nang la byon nas bzhugs pas/ de'i nub mo mnal lam la rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i bud med yid du 'ong ba zhig gis/ rin po che'i sder ma pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug gis bskor ba'i nang du/ me long dar sna lngas dkris pa zhig dang*/ man shel red zer ba 'od lnga'i thig le zlum por yod pa zhig bzhag nas 'di skad zer/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rang la rdzogs pa'i ye shes ni// rten 'brel 'dzom pas gsal bar byed// ma yengs brda don 'di la dgongs// rgyu rkyen las 'das rin chen 'di// rang byung ye shes snying po'i brda// pad+ma'i ril bu gsal 133) ba 'di// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos brda// bcu drug grangs su yod pa 'di// dga' ba bcu drug nyams blangs na// rtsa rlung thig le dag smin rdzogs// grub 'bras mngon du gyur pa'i brda// g.ya' bral me long zlum 'khyil 'di// stong gsal 'gags med 'od gsal ba// thig le nyag gcig spros dang bral// phyogs lhung med par khyab pa'i brda// lnga ldan dar gyis dkris pa 'di// 'gro ba'i khams dbang dang mthun pa'i// chos mdzod sna tshogs 'byung ba'i brda// man shel 'od lnga 'khyil ba 'di// rjes 'jug skal ldan bu slob kun// zab gter chos la longs spyod na// ka dag lhun grub mthar phyin nas// 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba'i brda// thams cad lhan du yod pa 'di// chos dbyings gcig gis chings ba'i brda/ khyod pad+ma'i rgyal tshab gter ston pa// rten dang 'brel 'byung kho nar rag 134) /brda dang brda len ma nor ba// tshig 'di tsit+ta'i ga'ur sbos// ces zer nas sang nyin mkha' 'gro dus chen yin/ ga ṇa tsakra la btson dang dngos grub yod zer nas kha byang gi brda zhig gtad nas mi snang bar yal/

nangs snga skyo tsha gsol rjes tshogs mchod kyi sta gon mdzad/ gnas bskor ba rnams kyis su yin zer tshe/ bya bral ba sprang po zhig yin gsungs nas/ rje de nyid yin par zhal ma gnang nas gsang thabs mdzad/ de nas tshogs 'khor gyi dus su gnas nang la dri bzang 'thul zhing nam mkha' 'ja' yis gang*/ rnga dang rol mo gling bu sogs kyi sgra rang byung sgrog pa kun gyi mthong thos su gyur tshe thams cad kyis yid tshom nas/ a lags 'di bla ma hra tha zer zhing kun gyis yid smon par byed do/ tshogs kyi spyan 'dren skabs su rje de nyid thugs snang gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis ku lus 'phar ba dang g.yo ba 'khrab pa'i nyams shar 135) zhing*/ gnas 'di rigs gsum mgon po'i zhing khams su gzigs te/ rang gter gyi gnas dus sa rtags thams cad thugs la chub par byas so/ de nas rjes chog sogs legs par grub rjes tshogs kyi yo byad phud lhag bsags pa thams cad phug pa'i g.yas log gi ngos la pha bong che ba zhig yod pa de'i steng na spung nas/ bya rigs mang po 'dus byung ba'i nang nas gnas bdag red bsam pa'i bya dkar po zangs kyi mchu can zhig gis 'di skad zer/ gnas bzang mkha' 'gro'i 'du rar// phebs pa'i nam mkha'i nor bu// chu 'dzin rkyen dang bral ba// bdag cag dpal du shar ba'i// pha yis gdams pa'i nor skal// da bar nga yis gnyer byas// las smon rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i// rang skal gter la spyod gcig /zer nas rdo sgrom la sgrom bse sgrom gsum gtad de tshogs la rol nas 'phur song*/ de nas rje de nyid mtshams dam rgya la bzhugs nas zhag 136) 'ga' 'gro skabs/ mi dmar rta nag rting dkar la chibs pa zhig 'ong nas/ a lags sku khams bzang 'o ma rgyal lam zer/ rje'i zhal nas nga mtshams dam po zhig yin pas khyod 'dir 'ong mi nyan gsungs pas/ kho na re nga shing chag tho zhig gi mi khog khyod kyis nga mi shes sam zer/

rjes mi shes gsungs tshe/ yang kho na re sngar khyod spun zla thams cad kaḥthog dgon du grwa par byon zhor la nged kyi zur la khyod byon pa i gsal zer/ rjes kaḥthog dgon du 'ong dus mi pham gyis mdun la song ba de dran/ de min brjed pa'i yul du song 'dug gsungs pas/ kho na re de skabs su khyed kyi sku nus mkhyen brtse'i sprul sku dang*/ che yos sprul sku lhan rgyas byon dus/ rje mi pham pas dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi khyod cag rnams la gnang dus/ khyed la zab gter gyis las 'phro yod pa'i skal ldan du dgongs 137) nas/ gshin rje 'char kha nag po yang gter du gtad pa 'di da lan ngas rtsar yod pas khyed la 'bul/ nga 'ong rabs gzhan pa'i mi la ma gsungs zer nas/ sdig sgrom zhig gtad nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas zab gter gyi chos sgo du ma gtan phab mdzad nas chos kyi bdag po dang skal ldan 'ga' la spel/ de'i skabs mtsho rnying (snying ?)rgyal mo yin zer ba'i mi mo sbrul gyi gdong kha can can zhig 'ong nas khyed nged cag gi yul du ltad mo la i byon zer/ rje'i zhal nas ngas lta ba'i ltad mo sems la bltas/ 'khor 'das chos kun rigs par rtogs/ 'khrul snang yul la 'dzin pa zad/ khyod cag yul du 'gro snyam/ don chen yod na khyod kyis smros/ gsungs pas/ mo na re khyod kyis 'khor 'das rig par mthong yang 'di 'dra mthong med zair nas/ 138) mo rang gi sor mo lnga'i rtse la rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad bkra lam mer gsal 'dug pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ de las lhag par i yod/ 'di nga rang gi rig pa'i chom 'phrul ye shes lnga'i gdangs der/ nga'i rdo rje'i phung po na de bas mang ba dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang rten dang brten pa du ma yod gsungs/ mo na re mkha' 'gro lnga la ma brten pa'i khyod la dkyil 'khor grub pa med/ rgyu dang lam la ma ltos pa'i dkyil 'khor ci la yod zer/

rje'i zhal nas/ snang ba bde chen he ru ka /stong nyid shes rab rdo rje btsun// zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin// rtsol bral don gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs// lam 'bras rim par ltos ma ltos// snang rtogs lha sku'i phyag rgyar smin// gdan gsum tshangs pa'i rnal 'byor nga*// a 'thas zer gzugs dgos pa chung*// zhes gsungs/ yang mo na re/ e ma rigs ldan dpa' bo dgongs// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med pa'i/ 139) /rigs stong 'od gsal lha sku ni// thabs shes rgyu rkyen 'brel las 'byung*// dbyings phyug sra ba gnyen pa'i dbyings// drod bskyod dbyings kyi phugs la bskyod// gnas bdag rigs lnga yab yum ni// gsal stong zung 'jug phyag rgya che// dag pa rab 'byams bde ba che// rje khyed rten 'brel thabs mkhas na// thabs shes don gyi rig sku thob// rang rgyud 'dzin pa'i lha gzugs kyi// gnyis 'dzin ru tra'i rgyu ru 'gro// da la 'ur nged cag gnas la phog zer nas thal/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin sprel rdzong sogs dben gnas rnams la zab lam gyi sgrub pa mdzad cing*/ dngos can mi dang dngos med lha 'dre'i 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de'i skabs su gnas chen gnas phran kun nas zab gter du ma spyan drangs*/ sku mtshams la bzhugs skabs rdo rje phag mo'i zhal gzigs nas 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan rnams kyi bsgros gleng thams cad mi dang mi lab pa 140) bzhin du mdzad nas/ khyad par phyag 'thil du rje de nyid bzhag nas gzigs pas/ rgya gar bya rgod phung po'i ri dang*/ li yul gshong gi bkod pa thams cad gzigs shing*/ piṇ+ya rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yod par gsal ba sogs 'byung*/ der gter kha rgya chos bod du ma bsgyur ba du ma yod kyang*/ sgrub thabs zab mo 'ga' zhig las ma bzhes pas/ gnod sbyin chen po bhan+dha zhig la brdzus nas gter gyi grogs byas pa'i tshul du yod pa'i lag na yi ge bam po zhig bzung 'dug pas/

rje'i zhal nas yi ge 'di ci red gsungs pas/ kho na re 'di nga la g.yu sgron mas gdams pa yin/ khyed las 'brel ba'i 'og tu longs sku'i zhing nyul bar mdzad skabs/ lha mo dbyangs can mas gces nor gnang ba de red zer nas rje'i phyag tu phul byung bas/ rje nyid kyi gzigs par mdzad tshe dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs 141)zhig tu snang ba'i/ de ma thag tu rdo rje phag mo'i gri khug gis yi ge bam po la reg pa'i tshul mdzad tshe/ yi ge 'od dkar zhig tu gyur bas phag mo'i thugs kar thim/ phag mo rje'i mgrin par thim pas ting nge 'dzin la drod rtags thob pas shes so byas chos thams cad la thogs pa med par mkhyen par gyur to/ yang mnal lam la rig 'dzin ku ma ra dza dang zhal mjal nas dbang dang gdams khrid mang po gsan/ khyad par du rig 'dzin chen po'i zhal nas khyod nga'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yin pas/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams nyams su longs la zas gos kyis bka' spyad la sems mi zhum par nges med kyi gnas su nyams len gcig dril du mdzod dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po rang snang las phyogs ris med pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas nga'i gdams zab kyi gtad rgya thob te rgyal tshab su mnga' dbang thob par nges so gsung nas mnal 142)las sad do/ nangs snga mo skyo tsha bzhes dus rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza'i sgrub thabs zhig phab te gter sgrub mdzad tshe/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal mas zhal gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs/ ho hoḥ gdod ma'i gshis lug ma bcos rtsal// lhun grub snang ba dpal du shar// nga sgyu ma lta bu'i 'phrul mo che// 'ja' mtshon lta bu'i skur bzhengs nas// brda khrom zab gnad sgo brgyad 'byed/ ya yaḥ lnga skyes thig le bkra ba'i gnas// gtsug phud 'dzin pa lha'i sras// pad+ma'i pho nya brtul zhugs 'chang*// dbyar rnga'i gtsug gi nor la dbang*// rgyud mang lta bur phyogs kun snyan// lho nas rma bya'i gdugs gur phub// gser ldan ngang pa'i khyu tshogs 'dus// byang smad bdud kyi sab+ta yis// lha lam kun gsal smag la khrid// rmongs long blo chung skyes bu 'ga'// rang bzo'i chos kyis bslus la bltos/

khyod ni pad+ma'i pho nya ste// rten 143)dang 'brel 'byung kho nar rag /bslu bdud mi yi ngo bsrung bor// ma bcos smyon spyod 'chang ba gnad// las ldan skyes bu dam gtsang rnams// pad+ma'i dus nas smon lam 'dzom// rje 'bangs rig 'dzin sprul pa yin// phan bde'i 'od kyis snang ba khyab// de phyir ston 'khor thams cad kyis// ki la ya dang gro bo lod// yi dam mchog tu chags (chag?)med gam(sgoms?)// 'gab 'dre bdud sprul cho 'phrul ni// g.yo med ting 'dzin zhags pas bcings// srung ma gnyan po bran du khol// rten bsgrub gsol mchod gnad la rem// phan bde'i legs smon bsam sbyor 'grub// nya mo chab la ma zhen par// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin// gter gnyis 'dzin skyong pho nya mdzod// dug khrod rdzas la mi gyes par// steng 'og sbyor ba'i rlung la slob// spros med ting 'dzin zas la spyod// pha pad+mas bzhag pa'i nor gyi 144) skal// brag glang chen 'gying 'dra'i ri mo can// ma nga yis sgrub thabs kun gyis bcud// zhing chen ngor gser gyi brda ris bkod// g.yu sgrom gyi gud bcug gter rgyas btab// de rten 'brel log par ma gyur na// stag khra bo'i 'dzum zer g.yo ba'i dus// dbyings bi mi'i sprul pa chos bdag bu// las smon yod pa 'phrad par nges// gang 'brel kun pad+ma 'od du 'dren// khyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor las 'brel rtsal// mu to yi khyu na mi mdza' bas// seng dkar po gangs rir gnas na legs// mgon pad+ma'i bu rgyud rig pa 'dzin// dug khrod kyi 'dam du mi bde ba'i// phyogs nges med 'grims na don gnyis 'grub// ces gsung nas/'od gsal phyi nang gsang bskor/ sems sde ma bu bco brgyad kyi shan 'byed/ klong dkar nag phra gsum gyi bsdus don rnams kyi brda mthing shog ngos la 145) gser ris su yod pa zhig gnang nas 'di gsol dang*/

mtshon byed rtags kyi brda dbang dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gtad rgyas btab pa yin gsungs nas dbyings snang la thim mo/ yang sgrub pa chen po zhugs skabs mtsho nang nas sprin rlangs lta bu zhig byung*/ rje de nyid bzhugs pa'i mtshams khang gi sgo thad de kar 'greng nger bsdad 'dug pas/ rje'i lhar snang dang ma 'bral ba'i ngang nas gzigs pas/ de'i nang na lha'i bu mo 'dra ba yid du 'ong ba zhig gis gser gyi zo ba'i nang du dkar mngar bdud rtsis bkang ba thod pa g.yon na 'dzin cing*/ g.yas pas rin po che'i skyogs thogs nas/ rje de nyid kyi phyogs su mchong stabs byas te 'di skad zer/ e ma ngo mtshar che ba'i mchog /mkha' ltar rnam dag dri med chos kyi sku// thugs rje 'od zer gdul bya'i dpal du shar// bsod nams tshogs kyi zhing sa legs pa der// yon tan sna tshogs bcud 146) ldan bdud rtsi 'bul// bdag cag skye dgu yongs kyi tshogs rdzogs nas// dpa' bo chen po'i gdul byar 'gyur bar shog /dam tshig shel gyi bum pa ma bstan nas// mos gus dad pa brtson 'grus lhod med kyis// zab lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dri bzang la// bsnyen bsgrub yan lag ldan pa'i bdud rtsir bsgyur/ sgo gsum sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par// rdo rje gsum du byin gyi brlab tu gsol// zhes zer nas lan gsum du bdud rtsi gtor te je dma' la song nas mtsho nang du thim song*/ de nas mtshams grol nyin nangs pa dngos grub blang ba'i skabs/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs nas sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i zhing dang rigs lnga'i zhing khams thams cad legs par mjal nas rjes 'jug rnams kyi don du zhing gi bkod pa thams cad gtan la phab pas ngo mtshar gyi gnas su mthong*/ de nas rim bzhin sbas gnas kyi gnas sgo phye ba dang*/ rang byon gyi sku gsung 147) thugs rten rnams bstan nas skyes dgu yongs kyi bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sar legs par bstan pa da lta'i bar la'ang mthong chos su yod par yongs grags su gsal/

gnas der 'dus pa'i skal ldan gyi skyes bu dang mi skya pho mo thams cad kyis kyang*/ rje de nyid mjal tshe dad pa dang mos gus shugs la skyes nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs la 'bad nas 'khor ba la nges 'byung skye ba sogs byung nas byang chub kyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ de nas zla ba cha shas tsam song tshe rje de nyid gnas kyi nye 'dabs mtsho kha na pha bong zhig yod pa de'i steng la bzhugs nas/ myur lam thod rgal gyi dgongs pa la gnas tshe dbyings kyi thig le chung tsam gyi nang du/ zangs mdog dpal ri red zer ba'i ri bo zhig rgya mtsho chen po'i lto bar yod pa/ rtsa ba klu yul na gnas pa/ rked pa lus med mkha' 'gro'i 'dur byas shing*/ rtse mo dag pa mkha' spyod 148) kyi zhing du slebs/ rtsa ba grong khyer chen po bco brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i phyogs bzhir 'dod 'byung lhun po bzhi'i dbus su/ klu chen po brgyad kyi grong khyer ra ba dang bcas par gnas shing*/ 'dabs bskor du brag ri mtshon cha gnam du gzings 'dras gang ba/ de'i bar mtshams 'khor yug rnams su sprul pa'i sku yi zhing khams yid du 'ong ba bkod legs pa/ bdud rtsi chu mig dang sman gyi spang ri la dri bzang gi ngad pa phyogs kun tu 'thul ba/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i pad+ma'i tshal rgyas shing*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa/ gnas de mthong ba tsam gyis snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes shugs las skyes pa dang*/ rked par dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing gi nags tshal rgyas shing*/ 'ja' dang 'od phung gi zer gyis mig mang ris su mdzes shing*/ dril g.yer dang bya rigs sna tshogs kyis chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ dpa' bo dang 149) mkha' 'gro mang pos glu gar 'khrab cing snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshogs dkrol ba/ phyogs thams cad kha dog sna tshogs kyi 'ja' 'od khrigs khrigs su yod pa/ gnas de mthong ba tsam gyis gsal stong gi ye shes chen po mngon du gyur par byed pa'o/

rtse mo na dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams 'od kyi sa gzhi rgya che la bkod legs pa bde 'jam yid du 'ong ba mnar na nem zhing btegs na spar bar byed pa'i dbus su/ pho brang chen po'i phyogs bzhi gser dang baiḍūr+ya pad+ma rā ga in+d+ra ni la las grub pa/ sman gyi spangs ri la me tog sna tshogs 'khrungs shing*/ bya rigs mang po dang mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi chos sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog par gnas so/ bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba ye shes lnga'i ngo bor shar ba la/ rnam pa rin po che sna lnga las grub cing*/ spangs rtogs kyi lam mthar phyin pa'i brdar rtsigs pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab dang*/ 150) rin chen mig mang ris la sogs pas legs par bkra zhing gsal la 'tsher ba/ pho brang chen po'i gru bzhi rta babs brgyad dang ldan pa/ ri dwags chos 'khor gdugs tog sogs mdzes tshon gyi rgyan thams cad rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang yongs su rdzogs par gnas shing*/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde chen stong pa'i ye shes rang byung la skyes par byed do/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri'i steng du skyon gyis ma gos pa'i pad+ma/ skyon thams cad dang bral ba'i thabs kyi cha zla ba mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ shes rab kyi cha nyi ma'i gdan la/ rnam 'dren sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sprul sku o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje chen po dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro zhing dri bzang gi ngad pa 'thul ba/ nyag gcig zhal gyis dkyil 'khor mdzes shing*/ mkhyen 151) gnyis spyan zung 'bru tshugs su gzigs pa/ don gnyis sman gyi pad+mo rgyas shing*/ bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug phyir shangs bug har ba/ dga' ba bcu drug ye shes dang ldan pa'i tshems phreng mdzes pa/

longs sku 'gags pa med pa'i ljags pad srab pa/ snang stong sma ra dang smin ma mdzes shing*/ gdod nas ma 'khrul ba'i brdar dbu skra thor cog dang*/ rgyud 'dzin rjes su bzung phyir lhag ma sil bur 'khrol zhing*/ thabs shes phyag gnyis g.yas sku lnga mtshon phyir gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa la gzer zhing*/ g.yon pas bde stong bhan+dha 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pa lte bar 'dzin cing*/ srid zhi gnyis med zhabs rol stabs su bzhugs pa/ theg gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i na bza' gsol zhing*/ dbu la pad ma mthong grol rgod sgro dar snas brgyan pa gsol zhing*/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa 152) 'od dang 'od phung gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon mdun ngos su/ lha lcam dang*/ mtsho rgyal/ ka la sid+dhi/ bkra shis tsho 'dren/ shākya de wa sogs gu ru'i thugs su byon nas mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gu ru la gus btud kyi tshul du bzhengs stabs su bzhugs nas mchod pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa mang po 'bul 'dug pa dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi gral du nyid las mi gzhan pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad dang mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs grub rigs mang por bkra lam mer bzhugs yod pa gzigs pa'i/ rje de nyid kyis phyag phul nas gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ e ma ho/ lho nub rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i gling mchog na// lhun grub bkod pa rab rdzogs pho brang dbus// rje btsun mtsho skyes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// sku yis 'od kyis sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab// gsung gi gang 'dul gsang sngags chos sgra 153) sgrog// thugs kyi dgongs pa'i skal ldan smin grol mdzad// mthong ba don ldan khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// thugs su byon pa'i ye shes ḍak+ki dang*// rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// lnga brgya'i tha ma lnga bdo'i dus 'di ru// pad 'byung rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje yis// rgyal bstan nyams pa dogs pa'i dpal du yang*// bdag gyur 'gro don dpag med 'grub par shog

/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rim gnyis lam// gong 'phel zab lam snying po mthar phyin nas// bskyed dang bsgom pa'i lam la mi ltos par// tshe 'dir 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thugs rje dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus// bdag dang bzang ngan 'brel thog sems can kun// skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru/ 154) /dag pa'i zhing mchog 'di ru skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu gu ru'i zhal mthong nas// gsung thos dbugs dbyung smin grol chos thob ste// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// ces gsungs pas/ gu ru'i thugs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis lung bstan dbugs dbyung dbang bskur sogs mtshon byed brda shog gi gtad rgya smon lam legs par mdzad pa'i/ thabs mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang*/ shes rab rnam kun mchog ldan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i don rgyud la skyes so/ de nas 'khor gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen bshams nas thams cad tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol bas/ dkyil 'khor ba thams cad rig pa rang byung gi ye shes dang*/ stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su ro gcig par gyur/ de nas 155) ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi zhing 'di ma brjed par yid la zungs shig 'di dpa' bo bdud 'joms rdo rjai'i gzhugs gnas red gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas bdag gi yab rje bla ma rin po che de la sku gegs i yod lags/ rim gro ci bsgrub dgos sogs khyed kyis lung bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas gter chen bdud 'joms rdo rje'i sku tshe rten thabs khong mtha' slob chos bdag rnams dang*/ khyad par gzungs ma 'khor 'bangs rnams la rag las yod pas/

snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba bsod nams zhan pas sku tshe i brtan gter ston kho rang la thug 'dug 1$0000300da khyed lo gsum gyi gong thog nas nged mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bu sdug bzhin du gces spras su bskyangs nas/ ḍāk+ki'i thugs bcud yang zab kyi chos skor thams cad gces nor du sprad de yun ring du bskyang ba yin pas/ da ni pha shul bus bzung ste gter gnyis kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la blo rgya mi chung bar mdzod dang*/ khyed kyi rig ma mchog dang chos bdag rnams kyi mthun rkyen de mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byed 'ong gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas dman pa bdag lta bus gter gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong byed pa lta zhog yab rje bla ma dang las ldan gyi skyes bu 'ga' ma gtogs nga rang bla mar mthong bar dka' 'dug gleng mo dang brnyas bcos byed pa la sogs bya ba gang thad nas mi bzang bar 'dug gsung nas rje'i thugs chung mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro rnams thugs sun pa'i tshul du gyur nas yang 'di ltar gsungs/ dpa' bo chen po khyed la thugs khag med/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi blo kha bdud kyis bsgyur ba yin pas/ las ci byas thams cad 'khor ba ngan song gi snon pa byed pa ma gtogs thar pa byang chub kyi don gnyer 157) byed mkhan nyin par gyi skar ma dang 'dra mtshungs 'dug kyang*/ da khyod kyis gdul bya'i 'gro ba rnams thabs mkhas thugs rje chen pos smin grol gyi lam la bkod nas gu ru pad+ma'i thugs bzhed bsgrub par mdzod dang*/ khyod phal ba'i mi dang mi 'dra ba yin pas/ 'gro ba'i log lam la gnod par snang yang*/ don la dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu ji bzhin du gzugs can gzugs med kyi 'gro ba rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung ba la the tshom med do gsungs/ yang mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal mas chang kā pā la gang gnang nas 'di zag med kyi bdud rtsi red gsung nas/

rje de nyid kyis gsol ma thag tu rnam thar gsum ldan gyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur nas snang ba bzhi'i rtags tshad rtsol med du rdzogs shing skyon bral 'pho chen dwangs ma'i sku ru grol bar gyur to/ yang mkha' 'gro kun gsal 158) ma dang zhi ba rdo rje mtsho gnyis kyis dbyangs gcig dang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs/ e e/ dbyings mi 'gyur chos sku'i mkha' klong nas// gdangs ma nges sna tshogs 'phrul du ngom// las smon lam dag pa'i dpal shar ba// dpal he ru ka dpal khyod nyid ni// gnas lha ldan yer pa bsam yas su// zab gter gyi chos sgo du ma yod// lo gcig gi gnyis las ma 'gyang bar// mig 'phrul bzhin 'byin pa'i dus la bab// bdud sab+ta'i log lam la bsgyur na// mgon pad 'byung gi phrin las zab gter rnams// rten 'brel gyi mthun rkyen nged tshos byed// lha rig byed dmar mos sde kha bsgyur// gter gsum gyi rang nor lag tu rnyed// sku tshe dang mdzad phrin nam mkhar mnyam// brda go 'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// da ma 'gyang myur bar yul du byon// phas bu la bzhag pa'i zab chos rnams// dag ther dang gab 'khrul gsal mi dgos// bri 159) spel gyi bgo skal khyod la dbang*// las ma 'gyang rang nor tshags su mdzod// khong nus ldan 'od zer rta bdun 'di// dbyings ye shes sgyu 'phrul bkod pa las// skal ldan rnams yang dag lam la bkod// tshom bu ni 'bum bcas gnas 'di ru// ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi 1$1000300rje bor 'god// yun ring por 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang*// dus ngan pa'i mi yi go bar dka'// de phyir dang 'gro don zhing du lhag /brda go 'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// sngon bsam yas su gu ru pad+ma'i drung*// 'u cag rnams rten 'brel lhan du 'dzom// ngas thugs bskyed dang smon lam rgya che ba'i// dus da bar khyod kyi grogs su shar// yul rgya bod kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sel// pad 'byung dang mtsho rgyal thugs bzhed 'grub// ma dbyings yum mtsho rgyal sgyu 'phrul gar// ngas thugs kyi 'od zer mi mo ni// gter gsum gyi sgo 'char grogs su shar// ma

160) mkha' 'gro phrin las zab mo'i mthus/ khyed thabs shes 'bral med 'dzom pa na// bdud kla klo'i 'phel kha lo brgyar bzlog /gnas nges med 'grims pa'i don ldan na// bstan 'gro ba'i don chen rim gyis 'byung*// gnas gcig tu bsdad nas sa bzung na// blo rigs pa'i thabs la ma rmongs pa// phyi nang gi 'brel ba spang na dge// nor bu dang chang (mching ?)bu'i tshul nor nas// dam grib kyi smag dang 'phrad nyin mo// ma ḍāk+ki'i brda byang ji bzhin du// las gang byed 'gro ba'i don la dgongs// brda go 'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// nga'i tshig 'di ma brjed tsit+tar chongs*// legs nyes kyi 'byung 'gyur dus su smra// zhes gsung ma thag tu thig le de nyid thugs kar thim snang shar tshe gnyid las sad do/ de nas rje de nyid sgrub khang du byon nas zhag cha shas la zab gter gyi gter sgrub mdzad cing*/ khyad par 161) rma rgyal nas gdan drangs pa'i zab shog rnams gtan phab mdzad de gsal khyab tu spel nas skal ldan rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ de nas yul de phyogs kyi gnas chen gnas phran rnams la/ las ldan rnams kyis bsod nams bsags pa dang dwangs ba 'dren phyir gnas yig phab pa dang*/ rje de nyid kyis kyang phyag zhabs kyi rjes 'bur du yod pa rigs su gsal ba sogs grub rtags ngo mtshar can du mas 'gro blo chos la bkod par mdzad do/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum lor rang yul la phebs pa'i lta gon mdzad tshe/ der phyogs kyi bu slob yon bdag rnams kyis bla ma mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog bsgrub cing rang rang dang mdzes pa'i gdams pa dang lung bstan sogs gang 'dod kyi dngos grub thams cad yid tshim par zhus/ rje nyid kyis kyang khong rnams kyi mos pa dang mthun pa'i man ngag gi gdams khrid dang*/ lugs gnyis 162) kyi zhal ta mdzad nas rim gyis rang yul la phebs skabs lam gyi yon bdag rnams kyis rje de nyid yin par shes nas/

rgyu ci 'byor gyi dngos po mang du phul bas/ de dag yab rje bla ma mjal rten tu bzung nas yab yum (yul ?)du phebs pas/ bu slob 'khor 'bangs thams cad kyi dga' ba bsgom/ de nas rim gyis bla ma'i drung du byon nas phyag phul/ rgyu nor dngos so thams cad mjal dar gyi rten du phul te/ bla ma rin po che sku khams bzang zhus pas/ bla ma'i thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad nas de phyogs kyi gnas kyi lo rgyus rnams zhib par dri ba mdzad pas/ rje de nyid kyis kyang yul gyi lo rgyus gnas kyi yon tan zab gter bzhes tshul rnams legs par zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas de min khyod la zhal gzigs lung bstan ci 'dra 'byung gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas bdag la 'khrul snang re 'dug kyang yid tshom pa zhig 'dra zhus 163) tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas de'i lo rgyus da lta zhib rgyas su bshad pa chog gi/ da ris khyod thon tshod bzang gsungs te chos dang gdams pa'i bsgro gleng mang po mdzad nas 'bul ba sogs kyi bla ma ci mnyes su bsgrub par mdzad pas sras rnams kyi dam par gyur to/ de nas rje de nyid kyis bla mas mdun g.yog mdzad cing bzhugs pas/ nyin gcig bla ma'i zhal nas khyod po ṭa la'i ri ngogs pha gi na lha gza' shan gsum gyi mtshams dam po zhig tu sdod gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas nga rang gi nyams dang rmi lam gang la brtag kyang*/ khyed kyi sku tshe de ci 'gyur mi shes pa 'dra na/ nyid kyi gter gsar dbang lung gi khrid kha ma thob pa rnams bdag la gsung dgos zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas gdam khrid man ngag thams cad dpe dang tshig la ma ltos pa tsha tsha rkos phor bzhin du dgongs brgyud kyi pha phog khyod la gtad yod pas/ 164) de las lhag pa'i gdams khrid nga la sbyin rgyu med/ nga'i bka' bsgrub na khyod mtshams la sdod gsung*/ rje'i zhal nas bdag bla ma'i bka' bzhin mtshams la los 'dug kyang*/ da nyin bzhin bla ma rin po che khyed kyi sku mdun tu yong chog pa'i bka' gnang bstsal du gsol zhus tshe/

bla ma'i zhal nas brgya zhag gcig la yong mi nyan/ de phan chad 'ong na chog gsungs pas/ rje de nyid bla ma dang bral 'dod gtan nas med kyang bka' bcag ma phod nas mtshams dam rgya la bzhugs/ zla ba gnyis tsam song rjes mkha' 'gro ral gri 'bar ma yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ e eḥ sprin bral nam mkha' yangs pa de// snod bcud kun gyi gzhi ru snang*// rgya mtsho tha gru yangs ba de// nor bu kun gyi gnas su snang*// shes rab gsum ldan mda' mo de// blo ldan kun gyi grogs su mchi (mchis ?)// nus ldan sprul pa'i dpa' bo 'di// ma dang 165) mkha' 'gro'i dbus na 'dza'// 'gro ba'i mun sel rta bdun de// sprin bral nam mkha'i dbyings la mdzes// de sogs brda tsam brjod pa la// khyod shes rab ldan pas legs par spyod(dpyod?)// ces smras pas/ rje de nyid thugs ma bde ba byung yang mtshams nas bzhengs ma phod/ de nas rim bzhin mtshams kha gang nas bla ma'i sku mdun la phebs nas bka' srung bran du khol ba'i rtags mtshan legs par zhus tshe bla ma'i thugs dgyes par mdzad/ de'i skabs char bab rgyu byas te bla ma'i gzim khang gi thog thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' nas 'brug sgra zhig sgrogs pas/ bla ma'i zhabs nas da lo drug bcu re dgu ma thon par du nga'i mgo thog nas 'brug grags ma myong nas/ da lan 'brug grags pa 'di nga rang 'gro ran zer ba yin pa'i rtags red gsungs/ rje'i thugs la nga rang gi bstan btsub (lung bstan 'tshub?)lugs dang*/ bla mas gsung tshul gang la bltas kyang mi bzhugs pa 'dra dgongs nas/ phyag phul 166)te bshums par mdzad nas bla ma rin po che khyed da dung bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du mya ngan las mi mda' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par nga rang gi skyabs dang mgon sogs 'di dang phyi ma'i re ltos bca' ba bla ma khyed las med pas/ da dung mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba yang yang btab/

de skabs bla mas nga rang 'chi bar red mi bsam/ pad+ma bkod du 'gro dgos pa'i dus la bab 'dug par 'dra gsung nas/ 'khor bu slob rnams la'ang de ka'i sta gon bsgrig dgos gsungs te/ thams cad kyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin du nor dngos rdzas thams cad ci mkho rnams tshags su byas/ gzhan dngos po thams cad btsong ba dang thebs bzhag byas pa sogs bsgrub/ de nas rje de nyid bla ma'i bka' bzhin du mtshams la bzhugs te/ dgung mo'i dus su bla ma'i sku mdun la phebs chog pa'i bka' gnang thob pas nyin re bzhin du de kar 167) phebs te/ rjes phyag phul nas bla ma rin po che khyod kyi mdzad spyod gang la brtags kyang yid mi ches zhig 'dug pas/ bdag gi bya ba las mtha' thams cad ci 'gyur gyi lung bstan gsal po zhig gnang du gsol zhes yang yang zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas khyed la da snga yan bshad pa thams cad lung bstan yin pas de'i mi chog pa med gsungs/ rjes yang yang zhus pas 'di skad gsung*/ mkha' 'gro bde chen ye shes mas// zla ba lta bu'i zhal ngom shing*// 'od zer lta bu'i skur bzhengs nas// rgyud mang lta bu'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ kyaiḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// nga yid la bya ba ci'i phyir min// dbyings nam mkha' mdzod kyi klong yang nas// nga sgyu ma lta bu'i 'phrul 'gyed mkhan// de rig dang ma rig cho 'phrul gyis// sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis ka 'phrul// yod pa dang med pa kun gyi gzhi// brda go 'am zer ba'i dris lan du// ngas 168) 'di skad dbyangs kyis tshig 'di brjod/ kyai/ a lcam rgyal mo bzhin legs ma/ khyod skye ba med la skye bar ston// byung sa med pa'i dbyings rum nas// gnas med nam mkha'i 'khor yug de// 'gro med chu yi zla gzugs ltar// yid la byas pa'i snang ngor 'khor// nga sgyu ma'i bu chung dri ma med// dus gsum gyi 'byung 'gyur ldog pa'i tshul// don ma 'khrul tshul bzhin bstan du gsol// ces zhus pa'i lan du 'di skad zer/

kyai/ sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor chen po nyon// klong chen po lha lam yangs pa nas// mdangs gsal ba'i 'od brgya zer mdangs can// shar rdo rje can gyi yul nas chas// las nyon mongs rtsub rags dang bral zhing*// dbyings mi 'gyur lhums su khyab cing brdal// rab mtho ba gangs dkar lhun po'i rtse// zil gnon gyi rgyal po gdong la 169) pa// steng dbyar rnga yi dpal (dpa'?)rtsal bskong (bkod?)nus na// stobs 'jigs pa'i nga ro su yis 'gog /brda go 'am sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor lags// thabs bde chen rig pa'i gzhon nu de'i// yul stong nyid shes rab dpal 'bar mkhar// tshul gnyis med rol pa'i gdengs ldan na// don dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong*// mdangs lnga ldan gnyis skyes bzhin bzang gis// myos byed kyi ha la zas phyed bzhin// las ji ltar byas kyang de ltar do(ro?)// rkyen bar chad sel phyir ku mā ra// gzhan rgol ba 'joms pa'i drang srong tsho(che?)// rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir lus sbyin dang*// dam nyams la dogs pa'i tshogs bkang dang*// bdud pha rol bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad// bstan 'gro ba'i dpal mgon du smon thobs// grogs mchog gyur gnod sbyin dmar nag dang*// gza' khyab 'jug chen po bran du khol// lha dbang phyug chen pos gzhan 170) snang bsgyur// chos srid kyi mnga' thang rgyas pa'i phyir// nor longs spyod bsgrub pa'i thabs la 'bad// tshe 'phel rgyas phyir na tshe yi gzungs// lha yid la byas na nyer gcig re// dus rtag par rgyun du bsgom bzlas bya// gzhi khregs chod lta ba gtan dbab ste// dbyings lhun grub rol pa'i myur lam du// tshul 'phyugs med bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor na// tshe 'di ru mi 'jigs gdeng thob srid// yul 'brel tshad thar pa'i sa bon theb// tshe 'di phyi gnyis la rang dbang bsgyur// dgra 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad byung tshe// rkyen ngan pa grogs su khyer ba dang*// ma mkha' 'gro'i la rten ming gnad zungs// sngags gzhan gyis mi thub go khrab bgo// gnad tshul bzhin bstan pas don gnyis 'grub// yul nges med 'grims pa'i stobs ldan na// ma 'gro ba'i don chen nges pa 'grub// sa gcig tu bzung

171) nas bsgom bsgrub na// lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gros 'tsho ba sbyor// grogs chos skyong srung mas mthun rkyen bsgrub// sngon sbyangs ba'i las 'phro deng 'dir sad// brda ji ltar shes bzhin lag len thob// yul ngan pa'i gnas su mgo ma 'khor// grogs ngan pa'i ngag gis blo ma bsgyur// blo brtan po'i rang sa 'dzin pa gsal(gal?)// ces zer zhing slar smras pa/ a aḥ nga ma mo dbyings kyi yul (yum?)chen// da chos nyid mkha' ru deng 'gro// don dbyings rig dbyer med chen po nas// don ngang tshul mthong ba'i dus su// ngas gling bzhi yud kyis bskor nas// shar gsal byed dang 'grogs bsleb yong*// dbyings lhun grub bde ba chen por// yul ma dag snang ba 'phos nas// ma mthong bas mthong chen phyes nas// yul gnyis 'dzin dwangs ma'i dbyings su// go 'phos nas 'phel tshad rdzogs tshe// nga lnga ldan zhing nas bsleb 'ong*// sems ma rig rig par 'phos nas/ 172) /sku zhing khams mngon du gyur te// sprul bsgyur la rang dbang thob pa'i// ma chen nga nub nas chas 'ong*// zag med pa'i bde chen ster nas// dbyings dag mnyam rol par 'dren 'gro// tshe 'di snang gi chos can snang ba// dbyings chos nyid mnyam brdal gyi klong du// mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng chen thob tshe// nga las rab zhing nas bsleb 'ong*// sgrib gnyis kyis shun pa phral nas// gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min// mngon gyur du ma nges 'grogs 'gro// gnas stug po bkod pa de ka// ma mkha' 'gro nga yi klong mdzod// de mngon du bsgyur 'ong e ma// ces glu rigs de ltar blangs nas 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yal ba ltar mi snang bar gyur to// zhes gsungs nas de ltar gyis ngang da dung lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya thams cad ngas khyod la smras dang chog gi gsung nas/ rje de nyid sgrub khang du byon nas bzhugs skabs bla ma yab sras gyi bar la rdzun dbyen zhig byung bas/

rje de bla ma'i drung du byon pas/ bla ma'i zhal 173) nas khyod gza' tshang rnams la chags nas nga'i bka' mi bsgrub par yig cha dngos rdzas gang bzang tshags su byas nas sdod grabs byas cing yod pas/ nga rang gi khyod la dgos med pa 'dra gsungs nas phyag 'bebs gnang bas/ rjes phyag phul nas bla ma rin po che khyod kyi bka' dang 'gal ba mi bsgrub nges pa yin pas/ nga rang gis mdzod bdun dang ya bzhi'i dpe cha re ma gtogs dngos rdzas du ma dngul srang gang gi rgyu rtsa bzung med nges pa 'di phyi thub pa yin pas/ 'u cag yab sras kyi bar la rdzun dbyen byed mkhan de gang yin bdag la gsung du gsol zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o da khyod sngar tshig ltar dbus la 'gro grabs byed pa bden na nga'i bka' la 'gal ba min/ pha bu'i 'dun pa yod gsungs te rdzun dbyen byed mkhan gyi mi'i ming gsung nas khyod kyis sems la gzung mi nyan gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas 174) nga rang gi dpe cha thams cad med par byed i red lags zhus tshe/ ji ltar byas kyang chog gsungs/ gzhan sku nus che ba mkhyen sprul 'dzam gling dbang rgyal sogs bu slob rnams kyis pad+ma bkod du byon pa'i lam lha sku rim du 'tshogs skabs/ bla ma'i zab gter zhing skyong gi sgrub pa gtan phab mdzad nas lam lhar 'don dgongs gsung bzhin/ bu slob rnams kyis de ltar legs par sta gon mdzad tshe/ glo bur bla ma'i sku khams mi bde ba lta bu byung 'dug pas/ rje'i zhal nas ji ltar byas kyang khyod mi bzhugs nges par 'dra na/ bdag la lugs gnyis kyi bya ba thams cad kyi bslab bya gang 'dod du rtsal gsung pa de lan gnang du gsol zhus nas phyag phul bas/ bla mas kyang gter gyi khrom sdom bu slob skyong tshul dbus phyogs la byon na zab gter gyi chos sgo dbang tshul sogs kyi zhal ta thams cad lhag lus med par gsung tshe/ rje de nyid thugs shin tu skyo nas bshum

175)par mdzad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas khyod la 'khor 'das rang snang du thag bcad nas rang rig bla mar ngo sprad de bde sdug thams cad ro snyoms su rtogs pa'i gdams pa gtad pa 'di la gdengs thob par mdzod dang*/ nga dang nam yang 'du 'bral med par rjes su gzung 'ong gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas da bla ma khyed dang dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba nam yod zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas da bskal pa khyi'i lo la 'phrad 'ong gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas bla ma rin po che khyed pad+ma bkod du byon dgos gsung pa de la dgongs pa'i gzhi ji ltar yin/ nga rang la sbas gsang med par gsung du gsol zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas nga rang gi mtha' mi kla klo 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa yin pas de'i don gyi yin/ bskal pa 'brug gi lor gsal 'ong thang*/ da mkhyen sprul la sogs pa'i bkod chen pa rnams de'i dus su spyan 'brug rdo rje phag mo 176) gnas su ma 'gor bar bkod chen la myur du thon thabs ldan rten 'brel legs dang*/ lam 'phrang sogs bar chad kyi dbang du song na bya ba lam du i 'gro mi shes/ khyod la sngar smras bzhin dbus phyogs dang gangs ri thod dkar rnams su mi ring bar song dang 'phrad 'ong*/ nga dang ma 'phrad kyi bar du o rgyan za hor pad+ma 'di gter rdzas kun gyi bcud lta bu yin pas/ nga'i mtshams su khyod la sbyin pa yin pas gzhan gcig la 'di mi dbang bas sbyin mi dgos gsungs te thugs gtad smon lam mdzad nas gnang*/ khyad par du gter rdzas rnams dang g.yang thod sogs bla ma la sku chas ci yod thams cad gces nor du rje la gnang nas/ da snying gtam tshig gcig yod pas sang nyin shog dang bshad gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i sku khams je 'khrugs yin pas/ rje de nyid bla ma dang bral ma thub par lan rgyangs mang por phyir bla ma'i mdun la byon tshe/ nga rang gi lugs gnyis 177) kyi bslab bya thams cad khyed la smras tshar/ da mtshan mun nag 'di'i nang du yang yang khyod phyir ci la 'ong pa yin/

phar gnas mal la song nas nyol sdod/ nangs snga mo shog gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas bdag bla ma khyed dang bral mi thub pas sems 'di la sdug bsngal chen po zhig 'dug ste gnas mal la 'gro snyams mi skyes lags/ nga rang nyid kyi gzim rten du nyal i chog zhus pas/ bla mas chog gsungs tshe/ yum gyis khyed pha bu gnyis la nyin mtshan kha sbyar nas bshad kyang tshig la zad mtha' med na/ do nub kyi gtam gyi mjug rdzogs mi thub pas/ mo gnyid du mi 'jug gi/ sang nyin bshad na nam los langs zer nas/ rje de nyid la seg sdang byed 'dug pas/ yang bla mas da nangs snga shog gsungs nas rje'i dbu la phyag byil dang zhal btugs pa sogs thugs bco bco (brtse brtse?) 178) mdzad nas rjes bla ma la phyag phul te gnas mal du byon no/ lo ngogs de'i dus 'dzin chu yos lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nangs snga mo bla ma'i bka' bzhin rje de nyid mdun du phebs grabs byed kyin yod tshe/ grwa pa zhig thon byung nas khyed mkhyen sprul sang gi mdun du da nas byon shog zhing skyong gi mchod dpon byed dgos gsung gi zer/ rje'i zhal nas bla ma rin po che'i sku mdun du cung 'gro zhig dgos dgos pas/ de rjes 'ong na chog gi gsungs pas/ khyod kyis mchod dpon ma byas na sku rim 'don rgyu mi 'ong bas da nas shog gsung gi zer bas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la da bla ma'i mdun du 'gro dgos kyang*/ mkhyen sprul sku nus che ba yin pas thugs rtag btsan pas ma zhus na mi snyam dgongs te/ mkhyen sprul gyi sku mdun du phebs nas/ rjes dang bla ma rin po ches shog gsungs yod pas de gar 179) cung 'gro zhig byas nas 'ong na i chog zhus tshe/ da mal 'u cag 'gor song bas nyi ma shar 'ong gi/ da lta ja skabs la song na los chog gsungs nas nangs snga byon rgyu bka'i ma gnang*/ rje de nyid thugs shin tu gcong yang mchod dpon mdzad nas bzhugs/

de'i bar skabs mgon bla shes rab dang gcig gnyis zhig 'ong ba'i bla ma'i bsnyun ci 'dra red dris tshe/ yar dengs nas gsol ba red mdzad 'dug zer/ der 'dus kyi bu slob thams cad kyis dga' spro byed 'dug mi de rnams phar song ma thag tu mdun g.yog pa zhig gis mkhyen sprul gyi snyan du lkog shug byas te 'dug pas/ mkhyen sprul gyi gsungs grol te 'don pa'i mtshams skyur nas har gyis bzhengs te/ dgon nang du bla ma'i gzim khang du phebs song*/ der 'dus kyis bu slob gzhan thams cad kyis cho nge dir gyis song nas dran pa nyams pa byung*/ de nas 180) rje'i thugs la bla ma zhing du byon song nges pa red dgongs nas bla ma'i gzims khang du byon grab byas pas/ bla ser thams cad kyis khyod kyis mchod cha yi ge la sogs pa rnams tshags su tshud par gyis zer nas thams cad dgon thogs du song*/ rje de nyid kyi yo byed thams cad tshags su mdzad nas rim gyis dgon nang la phebs te/ bla ma'i gzims khang gi sgo bar nas gzigs pas su gcig kyang mi 'dug pa'i/ gzim sgo ga ler phyes nas nang du byon te/ bla ma'i zhabs spyi bor blangs te gsol 'debs dang smon lam mdzad tshe/ thugs shin tu skyo bas dran med du 'gro la khad byung bas/ de'i thad du bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od dkar po zhig byung nas rje de nyid kyi thugs kar thim song snang 'char tshe/ zhag gsum gyi bar du bde ba chen po'i 'od gsal dang ma bral bar gnas pas/ 'das rjes kyis chos bskor mtha' yas pa'i 181) dgongs brgyud kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur to/ de nas thams cad kyis gdung chos bya dgos pa sogs kyi gros byas tshe/ mkhyen sprul gyi dbus su slob 'khor 'bangs thams cad kyis rjes su rje de nyid bla ma'i thugs kyis zin pa dang*/ 'gal ba spu tsam med pa nges par yin 'dug pas/ de kas gdung chos byed dgos zer ba kha 'chams nas rje la de bzhin du lo rgyus zhus tshe/

rjes 'khor 'bangs thams cad kyi nang nas nga rang gi ngan med pa'i/ khyed bu slob che ba rnams kyis bla ma'i gdung gi thugs khur bzhes par mdzod gsungs nas gros ma 'ong bas/ bu slob rnams kyis mkhyen sprul la zhu dang de'i bka' mi bcag zer nas bzhud/ de'i thabs cig gi mkhyen sprul rin po ches rje'i nyid mdun du shog gsungs te/ sngar bzhin du bla ma'i gdung gi thugs khur khyod kyis legs gsungs/ bka' ma chog par gdung chos sogs legs par mdzad/ de nas thugs shin tu skyo nas bla ma la 182) 'o dod 'bod nas gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ kyi hud kyi hud kye ma kyi hud// rgyal kun 'dus zhal bla ma rje// mtsho skyes rje dang dbyer med pa// bdag cag 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon// bdud 'joms rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// bdag brgyud byin gyis rlabs du gsol// phyogs gnas gang du bsdad kyang rung*// drin chen bla ma yang yang dran// nyin mtshan bar med 'khyud 'khor du// gsal byed chu rgyun rgyun chad med// shar ri mtho'i dkyil nas nyi dkyil shar// pha bla ma'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dran// sems gdungs bas skyo nas 'chi ma shor// bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// nyin gsal ba'i 'od zer kun la khyab// pha rje btsun bla ma kho rang dran// thugs rje phyogs ris med pa yi// skal ldan rnams smin grol lam la bkod// bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// lho sprin dkar mthong nas slar yang yal// pha bla ma dus 183) gsum sangs rgyas de// nga'i mgon gcig myon kyang mya ngan 'das// brda ji ltar mthong ba'i bla ma dran// bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// dbyings nam mkha' mthong tshe bla ma dran// pha chos kyi sku yi dgongs pa la// dus 'pho 'gyur med pa'i byin rlabs zhus// thugs brgyud kyi ye shes yon tan rnams// gces nor du pha phog gtad rgya mdzad// bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// lo bcu gnyis nas bzung da bar du// pha bla mar mjal kyang skad cig 'dra// chos zab gnad ming 'dra mang thos kyang*// pha bzhugs yun thung ba'i yud tsam 'dra// bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// mtshan thos pas dad pas ba spu g.yo// 'khor ba la zhen pa gting nas che// gsung thos pas ma rig gnyid las sad// shes rab dang blo gros spobs pa thob// zhal mthong ba tsam gyis bag chags dag

/rtsol med kyi rtogs 184) pa mngon du gyur// bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// da 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// pha khyod kyi dgongs spyod ci 'dra yang*// bu bdag kyang de ltar gyur nas kyang*// tshe 'di ru don gnyis dpal thob nas// zhing mi 'gyur bde chen pho brang du// pha bla ma khyed kyis 'dren du gsol// gsung nas phyag mang du phul te bzhugs yod pa'i skabs/ rang gnas kyi khang pa'i steng na 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa de'i nang nas mkha' 'gro gnyis dang bla ma rin po che bcas bzhugs yod pas/ rje'i thugs la ci yin dgongs tshe mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis 'di skad zer/ e ma gson dang skal ldan rigs can lags// pha gcig mtsho skyes rdo rje bdud 'joms pas// ji ltar bstan pa'i rang rig chos sku yi// ji bzhin ngang du ma nor nyams su long*// zab mo'i gdams pa thugs kyi chos mdzod rnams// gang 'dod khyod la pha phog tshul du 185) 'ong*// bla ma yul du 'dzin na ngal ba'i rgyu// rang rig ngo bo mi 'gyur chos sku 'di// don gyi bla ma yin phyir mchog tu zab// thugs ngal ma mdzad gnas lugs rang sa zungs// blo 'das 'od gsal klong du 'dul 'bral med// zhes gsungs pas/ yang rje'i zhal nas bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams la gdung dbyangs kyi tshig mang du gsungs mthar 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang je mthor song nas lho nub kyi phyogs su mi snang bar yal/ de nas rje de nyid kyi bla ma'i thugs dam rnams gsungs nas gdung mdun la bzhugs pas/ zhag bdun tsam 'gro skabs zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs/ rigs kyi bu khyod la bdag gis phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa'i bka' dbang rnams bskur ba'i dus la bab 'dug pas/ khyod kyi lus longs spyod dang bcas pa nga yi phyogs su phul zhig gsungs pas/ rje de nyid thugs dga' skyo 'dres mar song nas yun gcig la ci yang smra ma nus pa dran med du yengs bas/

186) bla ma'i byin rlabs mdzad tshe dran pa rnyed nas phyag phul te 'di skad gsung*/ lung dbang ri rab gling bzhi yan lag lnga// sems nyid bde ba chen po 'khor 'das gzhi// dbyings snang lhun grub yon tan bkod pa rdzogs// rang bzhin rnam dag maṇ+ḍal rgya mtsho 'di// sku gsum rigs 'dus bla ma khyod la 'bul// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs phyir// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol// zhes gsung nas phyag mang du phul bas/ bla ma'i sku'i gar bsgyur te he ru ka pa rdo rje dang phur pa gdengs pa zhig tu gyur nas khro bo'i gad rgyang hūm̐ ring gi dbyangs kyi sgra la bskul nas 'di skad gsung*/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥ e ma skal ldan las 'phro can// rigs pa'i bu chung dri ma med// mkhyen gnyis 'od zer dpal dang ldan// ma bcos sgo gsum gcig dril du// mos gus yod la shes pa gtod// snang srid thams cad dag pa che// phyi nang gzhan gsum lha'i rnam rol// yongs grub 187) chen por lam khyer ba// bla ma phyi ltar grub pa yin// rang lus lha yi phyag rgyar rab gsal nas// spyi bor mgrin pa snying gar bla ma bsgom// dbang len thugs yid bsre zhing ngal gso ba// bla ma nang ltar sgrub pa'i lag len yin// rang nyid bla ma'i phyag rgyar bsgom nas kyang*// rig pa mi 'gyur bde chen 'dus ma byas// blo 'das gnyug ma 'od gsal chos kyi sku// ye bab rang sems bla ma'i thugs gnyis ka// dbyer med gcig 'dres mnyam nyid chos sku'i klong*// ma bcos ma bsgyur rang babs ngang gnas pa// bla ma gsang ba ltar du bsgrubs thabs yin// mdor na snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// gzhir bzhengs 'od gsal phyag rgyar mnyam sbyor ba'i// ma dag bskyed rim snod bcud lha ru dag /rdzogs rim rtsa rlung thig le bcud du smin// rdzogs pa chen po srid zhi mnyam rdzogs klong*// bdud 'joms rdo rje sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las la sogs mnyam rdzogs rigs pa'i dbyings/

188) /yongs grub bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rang byung 'grub// 'di don ma brjed snying gi dkyil du zungs// dus rnams kun tu nyams len gnad de dang*// mi 'bral bsgrub pa 'di dag brtson nus na// nga dang nam yang 'du 'bral yod ma yin// thugs brgyud dgongs pa'i zab don khyod la sbyin// gsungs te sku'i gar bsgyur te sngar gyi sku bzhugs pa'i skabs ltar mdzad nas shog dril gsum gnang ste/ 'di nga rang gi sku rgyud nyi ma'i snying po/ gsung brgyud mun sel sgron me/ thugs brgyud byin rlabs sprin phung rnams kyi brda shog yin pas/ khyod la klong brda len med kyi dgongs rgya btab pa yin pas/ dus la babs tshe skal ldan las 'phro can rnams la rim gyis spel la sprod gcig gsungs nas thugs brtse brtse mdzad pa'i tshul gyis mi snang bar gyur pas/ rje de nyid thugs skyo ba'i bzhugs mi thub pa ltar byung yang bya thabs dang bral/ 'khor bu slob nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mang bas gdung mchod 189) sogs mchod pa grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rang gi dngos po ci yod thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su phul nas zhag grangs yun ring po bar du gdung mchod 'bul bar mdzad/ de nas bla ma'i sku gdung mchod ran song ba'i skabs 'khor bu chen thams cad mya ngan gyis shin tu gdung*/ rje de nyid kyang thugs chung mdzad nas gdung 'bod dang gsol 'debs drag po mdzad pa'i skabs/ gdung dud kyi nang nas sku mi snang bar gsung gi gdangs las rje'i thugs gsos kyi zhal ta dang 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang du gsungs nas/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig dngos su gnang ba dad ldan 'ga'i mthong chos su gyur pa sogs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i snang ba mtha' yas pa mdzad do/ de nas dgung lo nyer bzhi'i lor sku mched che ba mkhyen sprul rin po che dang*/ rje de nyid kyi ma yum la sogs pa thams cad pad+ma bkod du byon grabs mdzad nas/

dngos rdzas kyi lhag 190) mo rnams dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten thams cad zhib cha mdzad skabs/ rje de nyid la sngar yab rje bla mas gnang ba'i g.yang thod gter rdzas kyi sgrom bu rnams dang*/ khyad par gu ru za hor ma dang bcas pa bu slob che ba rnams kyis rje'i phyag nas blang ste/ mkhyen sprul sang la gtad dgos sogs kyis gros 'chams nas/ rje la yang de ltar lo rgyus zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas dgos a phas byas na 'gyod do zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ nga rang la yab rje bla ma'i khong dang ma 'phrad bar du sku tshab du gnang nas gzhan gcig la 'di rnams sprad mi dgos gsungs pas/ ngas khyed rnams la mi sbyin nges pa yin gsungs/ bu slob rnams kyis khyed kyis bla ma'i gdung 'tshab mi 'ong*/ mkhyen sprul rin po ches bla mas bstan pa la zhabs zhu dang rgyal tshab yong nges pa yin/ khong la bla ma'i sku chas dang gter rdzas rnams sprad dgos yang yang zer kyang*// 191) rjes nga rang gi bla ma'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong 'ong bsam pa min/ bla ma dngos su bzhugs skabs nga la gtad pa yin pas da ci nas kyang mi sbyin gsungs/ bu slob rnams khong khro'i tshul mdzad nas/ da khyod kyis mkhyen sprul kyi bka' la mi nyan par rang blo rgod chod byed 'dug zer nas/ thams cad phyir mkhyen sprul mdun la bud song*/ rje'i thugs la da nga bla ma bka' drin can yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur de ni med/ rang yul la bsdad kyang kun gyi mig la gzan 'dug pas/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin dbus phyogs la byon dgos dgongs/ khyad par da lan bu slob rnams kyis gsung de bden na mkhyen sprul bla mar gyur pa yin pas thugs la mi bab pa mi nyan dgongs te/ g.yang thod dang gter rdzas la sogs pa thams cad phyag bsnams mdzad nas mkhyen sprul gyi mdun la phebs song ba'i lam la ma yum tshur byon 'dug pa dang 192) 'phrad pas/ ma'i zhal nas khyod kyi gter rdzas dang sku chas rnams bzung nas gang du 'gro ba yin gsungs pas/

rje'i thugs skyo yod pas bshums par mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs// nga mkhyen sprul gyi sku mdun du 'gro ba yin/ sngar nga rang la yab rje bla ma'i gnang ba'i gter rdzas nab gzan mthang sham glegs bam snyan rgyan sku srung sor gdub la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par gter byon gu ru bcas mkhyen sprul gyi khong la dbang ba yin pas khyer shog gsung*/ bu slob 'ga' re la gsung gsal bskur 'dug kyang de skabs ni nga rang la bla ma'i gnang ba yin pas mi bskur smras nas ma sbyin/ da ni mkhyen sprul bla ma yin pas thugs la gnod na mi nyan bsam nas 'di rnams gtad du 'gro ba yin gsung pas/ ma yum gyi 'di rnams khyer mi dgos pa 'dra/ mkhyen sprul kho rang gis de ltar dgos mi zer bas/ khyod bu spun 193) sems ring mi nyan/ da 'u cag gnyis ka phar 'gro zer nas phyir byon/ yang rjes mkhyen sprul sang gis ji ltar gsung zhus pas/ ma yum gyis mkhyen sprul la bu slob rnams kyis khyed kyi bla ma'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong thub nges pa yin/ bla ma'i sku chas dang gter rdzas rnams khyed kyi lag nas long dang*/ nged rnams kyis ni mi lon nges pa red zer kyang*/ mkhyen sprul gyis nga rang yin kyang lon thabs mi 'ong*/ kho rang la bla ma'i sku dngos su bzhugs par nged bu spun brgyad kyi nang nas ya gyal du mdzad nas gces nor du gnang ba yin pas zer thabs dka'/ de min gyi bya ba ci yin rung nga'i bka' kho rang gi mi bcag zer zhing*/ khyed kyi lag nas gter rdzas dang sku chas rnams blang 'dod med dngos yin zer/ rjes nga ma song na sprul sku thugs la mi gnod nges pa i red gsung pas/ ma yum gyis da khyod kyis bden par 194)ma bzung na da lta dgung mo khyod mkhyen sprul yod sar song dang go 'ong zer/ de nas rje de nyid ma yum gyi gsung ltar/ da lta nub ja gsol skabs mkhyen sprul sang gi sku mdun la phebs pas/
