mkhyen sprul gyi zhal nas khyod kyis da nangs gter rdzas la sogs pa thams cad nga'i sar la bskur ba de ci yin gsungs pas/ rjes nga rang gi dang po ni bla mas gnang ba yin pa'i mi bskur bsam/ rjes nas chas ka rnams khyer 'ong gyin yod skabs ma yum gyis khyer mi dgos pa'i lo rgyus rnams gsungs pa yin pas da lan ni bzung med/ khyod kyis nges par yo byed rnams dgos gsungs pa yin na/ khyod bla ma yin pas bka' dang 'gal ba mi byed/ de min nga rang la 'di phyi'i re ltos bca' ba'i bla ma ni med/ bu slob che ba la las ni khyod rang gi bla ma'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong phar zhog rang mgo thon na rab yin zer nas mar zhabs su bcad/ de'i khar khyed dang 'gal 195) song na dgos ci yang mi 'dug pas/ khyed kyi thugs la ci bas kyang de ka nga rang nas bsgrub nges pa yin gsungs nas thugs chung mdzad nas/ mkhyen sprul sang gi thugs kyis ma bzod nas khyed kyis de ltar ma byed dang*/ nged bu spun nang na 'gal ba 'gro don ci la yod/ gter rdzas rnams bla ma rin po che khyod la gtad pa kun la gsal ba yin pas/ de su gang gis kyang blang thag mi chod nges pa yin pas/ khyod rang gi gter sgrub sogs bla ma'i zhal dkor ltar gyis/ mchod cha yi ge rgyu rdzas la sogs pa thams cad slob chen rnams kyis nga rang la gtad 'dug kyang*/ 'u cag rnams gros mthun byed na chog gsung nas thugs gsos kyi zhal ta mang du mdzad/ rje'i zhal nas rgyu rdzas kyi skal ba yod na rab med kyang zhu phod min pas/ nga rang da lo bkod chen la 'gro thabs mi 'ongs ba 'dra na/ nyid kyi nga la bla ma rin po che'i gdung rus kyi skal ba zhig gnang ba bka' drin 196)ma chung*/ nga rang gi mchod sdong zhig i 'grub snyam pa yin zhus pas/ mkhyen sprul sang gi gdung rus rta shul khag gsum dang*/ bso sprul la sogs bu slob thams cad la bgo dgos/ khyed kyi rten i bzhengs mi shes kyang gdung rus los sbyin gsungs/

de nas rim bzhin rgyu rdzas gang bzang spus ldan thams cad mkhyen sprul dang ma yum sku nus rnams kyis phyag bsnams mdzad nas bkod chen la byon grabs byas te/ rjai de nyid dang sku mched chung ba gnyis la sogs pa rnams la rgyu rdzas cung zad re bzhag par mdzad cing lugs gnyis kyi bya ba gang 'os thams cad mtha' rgyas su bsgrub/ de nas ma yum dang mkhyen sprul dpon g.yog la sogs pa chibs skyel la rje de nyid byon pas/ ma yum gyi zhal nas da khyod kyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin rten 'brel gzhan dbang la ma gtongs bar dbus phyogs la sang phod phan la ma 'gyangs bar song*/ nga rang dang 197) i thug mi shes kyang 'gyod pa med gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas da lo nga cag thams cad wa shul dpon nas 'gro mi nyan pa'i gtam sna tshogs bshad 'dug pa dang*/ yin kyang nga rang la rgyu rdzas ci yod thams cad kyis bla ma rin po che'i sku gdung zhig i 'grub snyams pas/ de lugs byas te sang phod nga rang 'chi la song na gzhan spun zla sogs ma byon rung nga rang 'gro nges pa zhig las/ de dus 'u cag ma bu 'phrad los 'ong gsung nas skyel ma mdzad do/ gnam lo de kar rje de nyid dgung lo nyi shu tsa bzhir pheb pa yin/ de nas rje de nyid kyis bla ma'i sku gdung bzhengs par dgongs nas/ kaḥthog si tu sprul sku'i mdun du bang mi gnyis la gsung shog dang*/ bla ma'i 'das rdzong gi rten du rje'i phyag bris bzang po zhig yod pa de ka bskur te/ sku gdung gi gzungs 'jug dang rten 'dus dam rdzas sogs kyis bka' drin zhu tshe/ mi 'gyang bar myur du rten 198) dam rdzas rnams phyag tu 'byor/ de nas bla ma rin po che'i dngos slob mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa bla ma dge legs dpal bzang gi sku mdun du rje de nyid phebs nas bla ma'i sku gdung bzhengs dgos pas/ nyid nas gzungs 'jug 'jog rgyu'i thugs khur mdzad pa dgos gsung tshe/

bla ma de nyid kyis gzungs 'jug sogs zhabs zhu ci 'grub byed/ nga rang la'ang dngul dang rgyu rdzas re yod pa de khyed la 'bul/ gzhan rgyu rdzas bza' bca' sogs kyi snga phyi brjes (rjes?)nas mthun rkyen byed gsungs te thugs dgyes par mdzad/ de nas rjes bla brang la sku gdung bzhengs dgos gsung kyang*/ khur thang ba rnams kyis mi 'grub pa'i rgyus bshad nas mthun rkyen byed pa phar zhog sngar gyi dgos skal gyi dngos rdzas thams cad rje la mi dbang zer/ de nas rjes bla ma dge dpal la de ltar zer 'dug pas ci dgos/ gsung tshe/ bla mas da khyod kyis gdul bya lon pa rnams cha 199) gcig bla brang la sprod/ cha gcig 'u cag gis sku gdung gi mthun rkyen byed gsung nas/ rjes kyang bla mas dge dpal gyi gsungs ltar mdzad de/ rje de nyid sku chas yo byed chibs rta sga stan la sogs pa gang yod thams cad kyi bla ma'i sku gdung gi cha rkyen mdzad nas gser dang g.yu byur sogs phra thams cad kyang legs par mtha' rgyas su 'grub ste/ gzungs 'jug kyang kaḥthog si tus gnang ba'i shog chags lnga bcu yan gyi gtso bo'i rten gsum gang 'os thams cad dang*/ bla ma'i sku chas yo byed nang nas sor gdub gsol dkar sku bsrung gter la ral gri me 1$00003001$1000300'bar la sogs pa dang*/ rje de nyid kyis gter byon g.yu sgrom gcig gu ru'i sku dang shog ser chos kyi ring bsrel gsum/ sngar rje la thang stong gis gnang ba'i ta li'i lo ma la gser gyi 'bur du bris pa'i sgrol ljang gi sku gzugs/ mtsho rgyal dbu ljon 'ja' zug ma dang*/ bram ze'i sku sha/ myong grol 'byung lnga'i 200) bcud bsdus ril bu/ smar gyi 'brog phug tu nye gnas chos gsal bcas byon skabs/ gnyan po g.yu rtse'i sras mo gnyan mong 'brug zer ba des phul ba'i rgyal ba 'od srung gi tshems las byung ba'i ring bsrel cha bdun la sogs pa'i rten khyad par can du ma gzungs 'jug tu phul nas/

bla ma'i sku gdung tshad dang ldan pa mda' gang tshad tsam zhig bzhengs nas rab gnas sogs rje de nyid bla ma dge dpal bcas dpon g.yog 'gas zhag bdun du bsgrubs pas me tog gi char babs pa dang dri bzang 'thul ba sogs rtags mtshan khyad par can byung ngo*/ de'i nub gzim lam la bla ma rin po che dang zhal mjal nas bla mas da khyod kyis grogs dag yul mi rnams kyi rkyen dbang du ma shor bas/ dbus ri lha ldan gyi phyogs su 'gro don gyi dus la bab pa ma 'gyang bar myur du 'gro grabs kyis dang rten dang 'brel 'byung 'dzom 'ong gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas bla ma rin po che lags/ bdag 201) rang gi ma dang sku mched 'khor slob thams cad pad+ma bkod du byon yod pas/ lam la chom rkun sogs kyi gnod 'tshe i 'byung dang*/ sku tshe la bar chad yod med ji ltar red zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas lam 'phrang dang chom rkun sogs kyi gnod 'tshe cher ma 'byung yang*/ phran bu tsam la rkyen nas dus tshig gi thog tu thon ma thub kyang da lo thon yod/ khyed myur bar song na ma dang shi ngo thug thang*/ de min ci 'gyur dka' mo red gsung ma thag mnal las sad do/ de nas dgung lo nyer lnga'i lor bso sprul rin po che dbus la byon pa dang lhan du byon dgongs nas sku mched rnams dang gzungs ma 'khor slob yul mi sogs la bkod chen du byon dgos pa'i lo rgyus gsung tshe thams cad kyis bshol ma byas kyang*/ rje'i bkas ma gnang nas lo gsum phan chad mi 'byang bar byon thabs skabs bstun gyi gsung mdzad gnang*/ de nas sku mched chung ba rdzogs chen 202) dpal dge'i rnam sprul nam mkha' 'jigs med dang*/ rje'i dngos slob rnal 'byor dam pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ nye gnas 'od 'bar la sogs pa dang bcas pa'i gtso'i wa shul gser thal rta shul gong 'gab bar gsum sogs nas dbus phyogs dang bkod chen la 'gro mi mang po 'dus nas/

de dag gi mgo 'dren rje nyid nas mdzad do/ bso sprul rin po che'i sgar gzhi dang bcas lhan rgyas su rim gyis lam la zhugs nas byon pa'i skabs/ mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha yin skad pa'i 'di skad zer/ e eḥ dbyings mi 'gyur gsal ba'i 'od po che// mdangs lnga ldan rang byung ye nas shar// rmug 'dzin gyis shugs kyis rang grol nas// g.yu 'brug gi nor bu lon la nye// seng dkar gyi g.yu ral lha la bab// rgya stag gi ri mo bkrag mdangs 'bar// rma bya yi rgyu rtsal mi ring ngom// don pha nor gter la dbang ba'i dus// las rten 'brel thabs mkhas gal 203) po che// mgon mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam rol gar/ khong sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin// sa man+ta su kha badz+ra ming*/ khyo'i zab chos gdams pa'i bdag po mchog /las rten 'brel le lor ma bskur bar// gter ston dang chos bdag dpal 'dzom na// gsang gter gyi lde mig rim 'phrad nas// lho brag tu gter sgo mang por 'byed// des gdul bya ther 'bum dpal rir 'dren// rgya bod kun chos 'dir khyab par nges// gser ser po skyon bral kun la gsal// ra gan gyi 'dren pa'i dus byung na// lha dmar po gsum gyi las bskul na/ kho'i srog snying brda ru bstan nas 'ong*// de rdo rje'i go rar dam rgyas bcings// 'da' med kyi bka' rtags phyag rgyas mnan// bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal bar nges// brda go 'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// zhes zer nas lho nub kyi phyogs su 'ja' sprin gyi rnam par mi snang bar song*/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i brda byang 204) bzhin/ rim gyis rdza rgyal dgon du phebs pas/ dgon pas kyang sprul sku rnams gsum la zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi bya ba mtha' yas par mdzad/ mtshams sprul rin po che kyang lugs gnyis kyi zhabs tog bsgrub cing khyad par klong chen pa'i sprul pa 'khrul med du 'dug pas/

khyed kyi gter kha mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa zab gnad khyad par can yod pa bdag gis rmis pas rten 'brel legs gsung nas gter gyi bsgro gleng mang du mdzad/ rje de nyid kyis kyang chos dang gdams pa mang du zhus nas thun mongs ma yin pa'i bla mar gyur nas phan tshun thugs rgyud gcig pa lta bus rjes gcod kyi gsung sgros mang du mdzad/ de nas dgon sde lha mis kun gyis skyel ma lam bstan sogs zhabs tog ci rigs pa bsgrubs nas rim gyis byon pa'i tshe/ rdza rgyal 'phan phyug gi nye log gcos thang zer ba'i sar phebs nub rje de nyid kyi thugs dam gsungs nas 205) bzhugs yod skabs/ mi mo mdzes ma zhig thon byung nas 'di skad zer/ a bu sang sku khams bzang 'o ma rgyal lam gsungs/ rje'i gsungs ma grol nas ngag gtam gyi lam nas 'o ma rgyal gsungs tshe/ mo na re khyed kyi nga la gtam smras pas ci la gnod/ khyod kyis sang nyin gter chen kha cha shas bzhes dgos pa 'dra na/ chos kyi bdag po ni yod mod/ gzungs ma med pas gter gyi grogs ldan byed/ rten 'brel gzhan dbang du song tshe mi 'dod pa'i rkyen kha sdang yong*/ nga tsho ring bas min zer ma thag mi snang bar yal/ de nas rje'i gsang gter gyi sgrom bu gnyis de skabs bzhes/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje dang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku zhig yod pa de nangs snga mo bzhes dgos dgongs pas/ dbus sgar ba shin tu mang ba'i brda la 'phrod pa'i lam du zhugs/ de nas rim bzhin 'bri chu khar 206) phebs tshe mi 'dod pa sna 'ga' byung bas/ rjes gter srung gi gsol mchod mdzad nas bka' dam la bzhag pas re zhig bde bar gnas/ dpal thang lung mo che zer ba pad+ma bkod kyi gnas kyi sgo srung phyi ma'i phyi ma bslu bdud bag tse dmar nag zer ba'i nye 'dab la thon skabs/ rje de nyid kyi zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po lung zin mchog gyur wa shul bso sprul sna tshogs rang grol dpon g.yog thams cad dbus la byon rgyu yin pa dang*/

rje 'khor bcas thog mar bkod chen la phebs dgos pas/ bla slob gnyis ka bral ma thub par zhag cha shas su de kar bzhugs skabs/ sngar gyis mi mo de gzims lam la 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ khyod las 'phro dag pa'i gter la dbang*// shes rab kyi mig ldan blo gros gsal// bstan 'gro ba'i mun sel 'od po che// dus rten 'brel sna kha rim pas dpyod/ khong lha 207) lung dpal gyi rnam rol gang*// las smon lam 'dzom pas khyod la 'phrad// rten 'brel la 'byung blo kha ma bsgyur na// chos 'khor 'dzin gyi bu la rang skal sprod/ khyod rigs rus ngan pa'i mi dbang shor// zab gter gyi dus tshigs btang snyoms lus/ khong sab+da'i khyu mchog dbu 'phangs mtho// las dkar nag 'dres mas 'gro blo bsgyur// gser ldan gyi ngang pa ma gtogs kun// de'i ngag la drangs nas khyed la 'tshe// lha dmar po las bskul drag po yin// 'byung po'i tshogs rlung gi spu grir 'dren// brda go 'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// zhes dang*/ yang da ni khyod bla slob gnyis 'bral mi thub pa ma byed par myur du mi 'gyang ba lam du bzhud na bzang gi/ yun ring de kar bsdad na khyed kyis gter ma bzhes pa'i rkyen gyis mi 'dod pa 'ong rab yod zer nas mi snang bar yal/ yang mi nag rta nag can zhig 'ong nas a bu lags 208) sku khams bzang 'o ma rgyal lam zer/ rje'i zhal nas dka' ma tha khyod su yin gsungs pas/ kho na re yul 'di'i srung ma mthu rtsal can yin pas 'on kyang nga gu ru pad+ma'i bka' dam la gnas yod pa zhig yin te/ khyed gter ston nges pa pad+ma'i rgyal tshab su 'dug pas mjal du 'ong ba yin zer nas phyag phul te mdun du 'khod pas/ yang rje de nyid kyi zhal nas khyod gzugs med yid lus tsam gyis nga gter ston i yin cis phyir shes/ nga sprang po 'khyar po zhig yin ma gtogs gter ston pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs min gsung nas/

kho na re nga yid lus yang mngon shes phra mo yod pas na nangs nas rje khyod byon par 'dug snyam nas lta gon byas pa yin/ nga la khyod gter ston yin min gsungs mi dgos/ sngar khyod pad+ma gling pa'i dus kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal mkha' khyab rang grol gyi chos skor phran 209) re'i gter srung nga rang yin pas/ de dus kyi smon lam las 'phro da lta'i bar du ldan pas/ khyod kyis nga la gsol mchod re mdzod dang dngos grub re ster 'ong zer ba dang mnal sad do/ de nas nangs snga mo skyo tsha gsol skabs rje'i thugs dgongs la/ da bso sprul 'di'i thugs chung shin tu mdzad 'dug pas lhan du dbus phyogs la byon na ci yin dgongs pas/ de ma thag par gzim gur gyi steng na byi'u yid du 'ong ba lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa zhig byung nas 'di skad zer/ ting ting rnal 'byor dri med 'od zer// sbas gnas pad+ma bkod nas 'ong ba'i// 'phrul bya 'od mdangs mos pa nga rang*// ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i pho nya yin pas/ khyod la dus tshigs brda rgyu bstan 'ong*// ma gcig kun bzang rdo rje gling pa'i// gsang gtam shog dril snying la gab bzhin// da la 'ur la 'ur rigs pas dpyod la// dbus ri lha ldan dus su ma bab// sbas yul phyogs su byon 210) na legs bsam// mtho mtho rgyal pos ngag la ma gzhol// seng dkar rang sa zin pa gal che// rta yi brdzu bag 'brug la ngom dus// drag rtsal chos skyong las la bskul mdzod// sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul 'gyed nas/ kha char bu yug mi 'dod ston tshe// rlung lha'i rgyal po phyogs nas g.yo ba'i// mi 'gyang la yog ltad mo mngon nges// chos kyi bdag po karma'i ming 'dzin// smon lam dbang gis rten 'brel 'dzom na// shes rab mig gi rang skal nor rnyed// bde sdug sna tshogs ri mo shar yang*// thams cad ro snyoms brtul zhugs skyong mdzod// gang bder ma dang mkha' 'gros grogs byed// 'di snang sgyu ma'i yul la ma chags// dus gsum lam du zhugs na legs pa'i// brda don khyod kyi go 'am dpa' bo// bde bde skyid skyid mkha' 'gro'i gling na// ting ting byi'u 'phur sding g.yo zhing*// nges nges mkha' 'gro'i zhing du nga 'gro// zer nas gar song cha med du

211)'phur song*/ de nas rje de nyid mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin sbas gnas su byon par dgongs nas dbus phyogs la byon pa'i bu slob rnams la gang mkho'i gsung chos bri spel dang*/ nyams len gyi zhal ta rang rang 'tshams pa'i ci dgos thams cad kyis blo yid tshim par mdzad/ khyad par bso sprul rin po che la lugs gnyis kyi zhal ta sogs gnang nas thugs yid dril gyis thugs brtse mdzad nas/ rje de nyid mi 'gyang bar rang yul la phebs par zhal gyis bzhes nas bso sprul dpon g.yog dbus la byon/ rje 'khor bcas sbas gnas phyogs su byon pas/ de'i dgung mo sgar pa'i mi thams cad kyis sems skyid pa'i rtse dga' byed cing bzhad gad glu len sogs byed 'dug rje de nyid ni bso sprul byon song ba la thugs chung mdzad nas cog po'i nang du thugs dam la bzhugs nas mdzad tshe/ bso sprul rin po che dang de'i nye gnas mdun g.yog kun bzang bstan 'dzin zhes pa dpon g.yog gnyis po sgar 212) gzhi'i rjes nas byon tshe/ bso sprul gyis rje de nyid dran zhing bshum par mdzad de byon 'gro ba dgongs pas/ rjes kyang slob ma dam ldan du dgongs nas bla ma lha la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// rigs brgya'i spyi dpal bdud 'joms he ru ka /ye shes mtsho rgyal gnas su mkha' 'gro dang*// 'jigs 'das dam can gter srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs bar chad sol// sngon smon gtad rgya bzang po mthu btsan pas// skye phreng du ma dbyer med lhan du 'tshogs// zab gter chos kyi bdag po rig pa 'dzin// dam ldan slob bu snying gi bu gcig pu// lhag bsam dag pa'i don gnyis bsgrub pa la// lam 'phrang chom rkun gcan zan 'jigs pa sogs// tshe chos bsod nams nor la bar gcod pa'i// 'gab 'dre'i rigs gyur gzugs can gzugs med kyis// bsam ngan gdug rtsub gnod 'tshe ma lus pa// mthu stobs nus pas

213) zhi bzlog gzhom pa dang*/ kha 'dzin sdong grogs lam bston srung bskyobs mdzod// bsam don re ba ma lus kun 'grub nas// phyogs dus gnas skabs mthar thug bde legs shog /ces gsungs te lam lhar gsol kha phrin bcol thugs gtad sogs rgyun gyis mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin byon pa'i zhag 'ga' 'gro skabs su/ rje ma mkha' 'gro'i gsung gter gyi brda sprad kyang gzhan rkyen la brten nas btang snyoms su song ba'i gter srung gi 'khu sdog byas nas gter ston chos bdag gnyis kyi sgar gzhi la chom rkun sogs mi 'dod pa re byung tshe/ rje de nyid kyis sngar mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin zab gter gyi srung ma las la bskul ba'i rtags mtshan mngon sum du 'byung bas nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar byed do/ de nas lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pas mthong thos kyi 'gro blo chos la bsgyur nas rim gyis chab mdor phebs/ de ka'i sde dpon kun gyis zhabs tog bsgrub nas skabs rer 214)bzhugs dgos pa'i gsol btab kyang*/ rje de nyid kyis mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin du 'dug par dgongs nas bzhugs par zhal gyis ma bzhes te/ rims bzhin khams ri bo cher phebs te gnas skabs de kar sgar btab nas bzhugs/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la yab rjes bla ma'i 'das mchod 'tshogs mdzad skabs spyan 'dren dus 'ja' 'od kyi klong nas yab rje bla ma mngon sum du mjal te 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan dang*/ rang gter gyi chos bka' 'das rjes skor gsum gyi brda' shog dang*/ dgongs rgyud rtogs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad gces nor du gnang nas mi snang bar gyur to/ de nas rje de nyid dgung lo nyer drug lor ma yum zhi bar gshegs pa dang*/ sku nus mkhyen sprul rin chen dbus phyogs la byon dgos pa sogs legs nyes kyi bya ba mang du gsan nas sbas gnas la byon stabs med pa'i mthong thag chod do/

phar tshur 215)la bang mi bka' shog brgyud cing gang dgos kyi bya ba thams cad bsgrubs par mdzad/ de skabs chab mdo'i dpon nas sde srung gi sku rim gyi yo byad 'bul ba sogs bkur nas bang mi dka' shog thon byung ba'i/ khong rnams kyi 'dod don bsgrub nas blo yid tshim par mdzad/ de skabs yul de kar lugs gnyis kyi dpon du gtogs pa'i dge btsun karmā bsam 'phel zhes pa zhig byung nas rje la mthun rkyen zhabs tog legs par bsgrubs nas gter chos kyi yi ge pa byas/ rjes kyang mkha' 'gro'i lung du gsal ba'i skyes bur dgongs nas bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi nang nas bla sgrub gu ru spyi 'dus kyi chos skor dbang dang bskyed rdzogs rgyab chos dang bcas pa shog ser las zhal bsgyur te bri spel mdzad nas chos bdag skyes bu rnams la gtad/ khyad par yab rje bla ma'i zab gter rnams yang gter du gter nas drangs te gsal khyab tu spel ba dang*/ rang gter gyi bka' brgyad dang*/ yab rjes 216) zab gter gyi bka' brgya rnams kyi kha byang lung byang thams cad gsar phab mdzad pa sogs zab gter gyi sgo 'phar mtha' yas pa gsar du phyes te 'gro don rgya chen po 'dus sde skal ldan rnams kyi mthong chos su mdzad/ ban gyi sde rnams la rang lugs dang mthun pa'i chos kyi dbang lung sogs gnang*/ bon rnams la a khrid thig le'i chos skor gyi khrid lung mdzad nas khong rnams yid kyi re ba ma lus pa bskang ste/ ban bon thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu 'chang nas zhabs tog du ma ci mnyes su bsgrub par byas te/ skyel ma sogs la zhabs zhu ci 'grub byed par khas blangs nas rang rang gis lam skyel gyi sta gon byas/ de nas rim gyis rje de nyid dgung lo nyer bdun lor dbus phyogs la phebs te/ byon lam gyi gnas rnams la 'brel 'jog dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'i gter kha du ma bzhes pa sogs don gnyis kyi mdzad pa 'gran bral du mdzad cing rim gyis lha sar phebs/

ser 217) dga' 'bras gsum la lha mjal dang*/ jo shag rnam gsum la gser chab gsol ba sogs mdzad/ khyad par jo bo'i mdun du mar me mchod pa sogs ci 'byor bsags/ rje de nyid dang dge slong bzhi sde res nyin zhag 'gar mchod pa 'bul pa mdzad skabs/ rje'i thugs snang la jo bo'i mdzod spu las 'od zer dkar po zhig byung nas rje'i thugs dkar thim par snang ba'i/ de ma thag tu thugs snang 'gyur nas rdzu 'phrul la dbang thob te/ dag pa'i zhing lngar byon nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang skur lung bstan dbugs dbyung ba la sogs pa mdzad cing sangs rgyas kyi yon tan nyer lnga'i dbang phyug dam par gyur nas/ mar gnas drug gi 'gro ba rnams la mdzad pa gang 'dul gyi sgo nas ngan song gi rgyu bag chags dang bcas pa lhag med du bcom te/ thams cad bde 'gro mtho ris kyi gnas su 'dren stobs mdzad nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa sogs 'byung bas/ zhing lnga'i bkod pa thams cad rjes 'jug gi don du yi ger phab nas 218) nyung bsdus smon lam gsung tshe/ nyon mongs bdud kyi sde tshogs bcom// bsod nams ye shes phung por ldan// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las 'das// shākya'i tog la gsol ba 'debs// 'jigs brgyad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// slar yang lhag pa'i lus thob nas// 'gro rnams sdug bsngal las grol ba'i// dad dpon mchog tu bdag 'gyur shog /gsungs ma thag tu zhing snang thams cad 'od dkar la thim/ 'od zer jo bo'i smin mtshams la thim mo/ de nas nyin gcig yang jo mjal la byon skabs bla brang gser khang steng na stag lung ma hā rin po ches zhi khro khrom dkrung gi dbang mo che gsung nas 'dus pa stong sde tsam 'tshogs pa'i mdun sar rje de nyid mjal du byon pas/ ma hā rin po che'i thugs dgyes zhus par mdzad nas mdo sngags chos kyi bgro gleng mang po yar zhu phyir gsung mdzad pas/

stag lung rin po che'i zhal nas khyed don dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor 219)ral pa can zhig yin par 'dug gsungs nas thugs brtse brtse mtshad cing dngul dang dngos rdzas mang po gnang dang thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad/ gzhan 'dus pa 'khor du gtogs pa 'gas sngags pa ral nag can ham pa chen po khyed mar song*/ rin po che la chos cod byed 'dug zer nas de 'dus thams cad ha las par byed do/ de nas bka' blon lha klu sang gi zhabs tog bsgrub nas pho brang du gdan drangs zhus nas/ snying thig gi dbang lung dang sku rim sogs mdzad nas sbyin bdag gi gtso bor gyur nas mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ de nas sngar mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*/ bla ma'i zhal gsung dang mthun pa'i zab gter gyis grogs su mngag (bsngags?)pa'i mi ro (mo?)red snyam pa'i 'brug lo pa (m)zhig rigs rus mtho ba sog po dbang du gtogs pa'i dpon tshang zhing du 'dug pas/ rje de nyid kyi dngos slob dam pa mgon bla shes rab zhes pa lugs gnyis gang thad nas blo rno ba zhig yod pa de la/ rjes zab 220)gter gyi grogs su 'dug pas lon thabs ci dgos gsungs pas/ shes rab kyi 'u cag yul nag phyogs sa dma' ba bsod nams dbul ba yin pas/ skabs kyi rten 'brel gyi mtshon tsam ma gtogs yun ring por gzungs mar mi sbyin nges pa 'dra na/ nyid kyi chos skyong la phrin bcol mdzad na rgyal dbang pad+ma'i smon lam la bslu ba med pa yin pas rim gyis stabs legs los 'ong zhus pas/ rjes kyang de ltar mdzad/ de nas bod sde pa gzhung nas gter ston tshad ldan du 'dug pas bod spyi'i dbu blar bkod dgos zer nas thams cad kyi gros 'chams kyang gsang thabs su byas/ rje de nyid kyi da bla ma'i lung bstan du gsungs pa ltar/ lho gnas rnams su byon pa'i lam khar sku mched mkhyen sprul rin po che tshe ring ljongs nas zhi bar gshegs pa sngar nas gsan kyang*/

yul de ka spyan lam la mngon tshe thugs shin tu skyo ba'i 'o dod 'bod nas mang du bshums par mdzad tshe/ 221) nam mkha' nas sprin 'ja' ris kyi rnam par shar byung ba'i de la gzigs pa'i nang na 'od 'khyil gyi klong du mkhyen sprul rin po che'i sku dngos su bzhugs pa rang mjal bas/ rje'i zhal nas yab rje gter chen rin po che snyigs dus kyi bsod nams dman pa'i dbang gis zhing du byon/ khyod kyis nged rnams thugs kyis bor nas zhing du byon pa'i dgos pa ci lags/ khyad par bdag pha ma med pa'i dwa phrug kha nyams zhan pa'i khyed mi (min?)re sa med pa dgongs bzhin/ nga rang thugs nas dor ba cis phyir yin gsungs te bshum par mdzad tshe/ mkhyen sprul rin po ches kyang thugs brtse brtse mdzad nas lugs gnyis kyi gsungs mdzad mang po gnang ba dang*/ khyad par mi 'gyang bar myur du mjal du mjal 'ong gsung pas/ rje de nyid kyi zhal nas 'u cag mi 'gyang bar mjal thabs ci 'dra lags gsung tshe/ mkhyen sprul rin po che'i zhal nas bso sprul gyis nga la chos (ches?)dam gyis bcings nas khyod rang yul phyogs la 'ong dgos gsung 222) nas skad dang yi ge mang po bzhag 'dug pas/ bskal pa lcags khyi'i lor ser dgon du byon dgos/ de dus 'u cag gnyis mjal 'ong gi gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas bdag rang yul la 'gro snyam med pas ji ltar dgos zhus pas/ mkhyen sprul gyi zhal nas da ci dgos khyod la mkha' 'gro'i zhal gzigs lung bstan re los 'ong gsung nas mi snang bar yal/ de nas rim gyis byon nas sngar klong chen pa'i gnas yul grogs (grong?)mo tshor phebs pas/ rje de nyid sngar klong chen pa yin dus kyi gnas tshul thugs la gsal bas mtshar re che gsungs tshe/ gnas tshang gi rgan bu na re rin po che lags khyod ci la mtshar ba yin zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas nga sngar klong chen pa yin dus gnas khang 'di'i bkod pa dang*/

bya ba rnams gsal por dran par 'dug pas de la mtshar ba yin gsung nas sngon gyi rgyus thams cad zhib par gsungs tshe/ khong rnams yid ches shing zhabs tog kyang 'gran 223) bral zhu bar byas/ de nas rim gyis lho gnas rnams su byon nas khyad par gangs ri thod dkar du phebs nas bla sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi sku mtshams la bzhugs skabs/ thog mar gnas srung rnams kyis gzugs bstan nas phrin las gang 'dod du bsgrub pa dang*/ gnas chen rnams kyi gter thams cad gter srung dngos su 'ong nas gter rdzas rnams lhag lus med par phul ba sogs rtags mtshan du ma byung ba dang*/ khyad par kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal dngos su gzigs pas dbu mgrin gyi rtsa mdud thams cad grol nas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med cing mdo sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs grub mtha' thams cad thugs su chud par byung ngo*/ de'i skabs su gnas srung rnams kyis yon tan thams cad rjes 'jug gi don du gtan phab kyi brdas bskul nas gnas kyi yon tan phyi nang gsang gsum gyi tshul du bri spel mdzad/ tshe ring ma byon nas rje de nyid phyag mthil du bzhag nas yul nyer bzhi/ gnas so gnyis/ 224) he ru ka'i gnas bcu la sogs thams cad du byon pas/ rje'i zhal nas yul de dag ci las byung*/ gnas 'di dag gang las grub gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas gnas yul 'di rnams gdul bya rtags 'dzin can rnams kha drangs ba'i phyir du gsungs pas don du 'di ltar re ltos shig gsungs te/ thugs kar sdig mdzub gtad nas rang snang ye shes kyi zhing khams sprul pa gzhan na med do gsung nas lto ba har gyis phyes te/ gnas yul dur khrod kyi zhing gi bkod pa thams cad rdo rje'i phung po'i grong du ngo bstan te/ 'di khyod kyi mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol ba'i rtags su shar ba yin gsung nas/ mi snang bar yal/ 'di skabs su mthong snang gi bkod pa dang*/

lung bstan skor du ma yod kyang gter gzhung du gsal bas 'dir ma bris so/ sku mtshams grol nas gter kha cha shas re bzhes/ de skabs su dbus rogs dang slob ma rnams kyis rang cag da ni pha yul du byon dgos zer ba la/ rjes da 225)dung lo shes re khong mi byon gsungs kyang dbus rogs rnams kyis bzhugs su ma ster/ de dus yab rje bla ma'i zhal gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs/ bu nyon dang dri ma med pa'i dpal// byang sprin dkar gseb gyi g.yu 'brug gi// gtsug nor bu 'od ldan snying po 'di// lha gnod sbyin chen po las bcol na// sngon smon lam las 'phro dus 'dzoms na// lcags chu gnyis 'gro ba'i gsos su sman// gnas 'di ru nyams len gnad rem na// ma 'gro ba'i don chen nges par 'grub// chos zab pa gter gnyis sgo 'phar nas// yul rgya bod kun bde skyid nyi ma 'char// bshad sgrub kyi bstan gzhi byang nas dar// las shugs kyis drangs nas yul phyogs su// mi lce gnyis ldan pa'i blo stobs kyis/ khyod rgyu ma'i yul la ltad mor mthong*// gnas de ru dbang med bgrod gyur na// blo rtse gcig pha la gsol ba thob// las bya ba ma dang mkha' 'gror dris/ 226) /nga'i bstan pa khyod la rag las pas// zab gter gyi 'dzin skyong thabs mkhas dgos// mgon pad+ma'i sprul pa'i skyes bu la// sab+ta'i bar chad 'tshubs ma sdang*// gdul byed kyi dpa' gdeng go bgos la// seng dkar mo'i rang sa zin gal che// rgya mtsho dang nor bu lhan 'dzoms na// gter gnyis kyi bstan pa rim bzhin dar// las rten 'brel bdud kyis ma bsgyur na// bdun bcu nas dpal ri'i zhing du yib// bzang ngan gyi 'brel ba thob pa yan// bye ma dang grangs mnyam 'gro ba kun// zhing de ru 'god pa the tshom med// ces gsungs nas/ yang sku mi snang bar gsung gi gdangs las 'di skad gsung*/ bu khyod kyi rtsa ba'i chos gter bsam yas mchims phu ri mo can dang*/

mtsho rgyal bla mtsho'i gter rnams rten 'brel dus tshigs mi yol ba shin tu gal che gsung nas mi mngon par yal/ sprel zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin yang gnas 227)kyi shug pa'i gseb nas gnas srung yin skad pa'i mi mo mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras shing rma bya'i lwa ba g.yang lugs su gsol ba/ chibs su yu mo dang rol du sha ba gser mthur dang g.yu sga rgyan can zhig 'khrid byung nas 'u cag gnyis gzhan don du 'gro zer bas/ rje'i ci yang ma gsung par bzhugs pas/ mo na re/ khyod las skal ldan pa'i gter la dbang*// sngon 'dong chung pad+ma gling pa'i dus// 'u cag tsho'i dam tshig gcig tu mthun// dus da lan rten 'brel 'phrad pa dang*// gter 'don pa'i dus tshigs gnyis 'dzom pas// ngas grogs byed khyed nyid 'byon bsam zhu// zhes zer ba dang*/ rje'i thugs dgongs la sngar nga rang na so chung dus mdo chen lcim lung dgon du 'gro skabs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan zhig 'ong ba de dang 'dra mtshungs bar 'dug dgongs nas da 'gro na chog gsungs pa dang mnyam du/ mo na re khyod sha ba rin chen 228) rgyan ldan la chibs te/ gnas kyi mgul du brag rdo rje gyen 'greng 'dra ba zhig yod pa de kar phebs nas/ zab chos bde chen lam bzang gis chos gter bswe sgrom che ba gcig spyan drangs bas dri bzang gis lung pa gang zhig 'ja' shar ba dang 'brug sgra ldir ba sogs rtags mtshan khyad par can du ma byung bas/ gnas der 'dus kyi mi rnams dad gus chen po'i gsos su gyur nas ngo mtshar du smras/ de nas zhag bdun du gter sgrub mdzad tshe sgrom kha bye ba'i nang du chod lnga yod pa'i dbus su bi ma'i thugs brgyud bcu bdun rgyud kyi yang snying gi chos skor dang*/ shar du gu ru'i sgrub thabs mthong ba don ldan gyi chos skor/ lhor bod kyi bsod nams dang bstan rgyas byed kyi chos skor/

nub tu mkha' 'gro dang yi dam gyi chos bskor/ byang du phrin las grags (drag?)po'i skor gyi shog ser rnams khyad 'phags su bzhugs/ de nas rim bzhin mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar gnas 229)'brel gyi zhor la gter gnas rnams su byon nas gter kha du ma bzhes/ khyad par mchims phu ri mo can nas zab chos rtsa ba'i chos gter sku gzugs kyi bstan dang*/ sgrom rigs lnga sogs cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te spyan drangs/ de nas rim bzhin mtsho rgyal bla mtshor byon te/ de gar zab gter khyad 'phags du ma yod kyang gzhan rkyen gyis stabs la ster (ma ldan?)nas dus las yol ba byung*/ de'i skabs su bka' blon lha klu nas bang mi btang nas phrin yig phul ba la/ rin po che khyod bod sde pa gzhung gi dbur blar mnga' gsol nas dgon pa grwa tshang bzhugs gnas sogs thugs la bab pa bsgrub cing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa gda' bas/ nyid rin po che'i thub bab med tshe de lugs kyi dgongs 'tshal zer ba la/ rje'i thugs la da gangs ri thod dkar la 'dug snyam yod kyang rogs rnams kyis 'dug 230) dbang ma ster nas stabs ma ldan pa'i/ pha yul du byon pas bla ma'i bstan pa la zhabs zhu i 'grub lta dgos dgongs nas de lugs kyi bang yig phul/ de nas rim gyis lho gnas rnams su byon nas mthong thos kyi 'gro ba rnams smin grol rim gnyis kyis bde la bkod nas dbus la tshur phebs ste/ bka' blon lha klu nas rje de nyid spyan drangs nas rgyal btsun blon 'bangs kun la klong chen snying thig gi chos skor dang*/ rje de nyid kyi zab gter rnams kyi dbang lung sogs mdzad/ khyad par rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis la 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams khrid gnang nas mngon gyur gyi dgongs pa lon/ rje de nyid bod du bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang rje'i bzhugs par zhal gyis ma bzhes/

mgon bla shes rab 'di thugs brtse ba'i bu gcig pu dang 'dra yang pha yul 231) la mi 'gro pas/ 'di khyed lcag gi mchod gnas la 'jog dang chog gsungs bas/ khong rnams dga' mgu yi rang bar byas/ de nas rje la mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog bsgrubs nas gang mkho'i gdams pa zhus/ khong gi skyed mo'i tshal du mtsho chen zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ rjes ngo mtshar ba'i gter kha zab mo gcig bzhes/ kun gyi mtshar du smras shing dad pas gsos su gyur/ de nas slob bu shes rab la zhal gdams dang 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan/ gzhan yang lung zin chos bdag gsar rnying ris med mang por rang rang gi khams dang mthun pa'i chos dang gdams pa gsungs nas thams cad kyi blo yid tshim par mdzad pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi 'gro don mtha' yas pa byung ngo*/ de nas dgung lo nyer brgyad lor bka' blon gyi ngag gsung 232) ltar bod bde pa gzhung la gsang nas/ rje dpon g.yog cha shas sngon du byon/ dbus sde 'bangs rnams rjes sor nas 'ong ste rang yul phyogs la phebs/ 'dams shod gang bskor gyi sde dpon kun gyis zhabs tog chen po bsgrub nas khong rnams la gang mkho'i gdams pa dang srung skyobs sogs mdzad/ de skabs 'brong ba bskor ba'i nang du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan bla ma mkhas pa rgya mtsho zhes pa de sngar dbus nas lha gdan du byon pa de rje'i chos bdag tu lung gis zin 'dug pa de la/ zab chos gsang ba snying po'i chos skor gyi rtsa gsum dril bsgrub phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsgrub thabs dbang dang bskyed rdzogs lag len dang bcas pa shog ser ma yig las zhal bshus te/ chos kyi bdag po dang*/ las ldan rnams la 233) yongs khyab tu spel/ khyad par mkhas pa rgya mtsho dang*/ rigs ldan bdun la klong chen mdzod bdun gyi khrid lung gsungs nas khong rnams kyis tshe 'di dor na nges med kyi dben rir sgrub pa pha mthar skyol bar khas blangs nas mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog bsgrub pa sogs byas/

de nas bdud sde gang yod rnams la chos kyis 'brel ba re gnang nas thams cad chos lam la blo bkod par mdzad de zla ba gcig tsam de kar bzhugs/ de skabs bdun phrag gsum du rje de nyid yab rje bla ma'i sgrub thabs kyi sku mtshams la bzhugs skabs mnal lam la/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje mtsho dang*/ ral 234) gri 'bar ma yin skad pa'i bud med gnyis mdun thad de kar mthong nas 'di skad zer/ e eḥ dpa' bo rdo rje gzi brjid// sgra 'dzin dbang po gson dang*// 'og min gnas nas 'ong ba'i// bzhin mdzes ḍāk+ki nged gnyis// pha gcig bdud 'joms rdo rjes/ khyod la ngag gsal sgron yod// sprin dang na bun char pa gsum// shar yang nam mkha'i ngang du 'char// nub kyang nam mkha'i klong du nub// gsal dang dag dang brtan pa gsum// gzhir bzhengs rig pa'i cho 'phrul la// zhing dang gzhal yas lha'i rnam rol// yongs grub dgongs pa'i ngo bor rdzogs// rang sems thig le nyag gcig 'di// chos rnams kun 235) gyi 'byung gnas mchog /gang snang thams cad rig pa'i rgyan// ye shes chen po'i rol pa la// ma bcos sems kyi rtsal du shar// shar yang chos dbyings klong nas shar// bsdu yang chos dbyings ngang du bsdus// 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas bzhi po yang*// chos dbyings ngang las g.yo ba rdul tsam med// thams cad sku yis 'od zer lhun gyis grub// 'byung ba'i rang sgra 'gro drug sgra skad kun// thams cad gsung gi 'od zer gnyis su med// 'khaur 'das kun gyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// sems nyid bde chen thugs dang gnyis su med// gnyis med mnyam pa'i don dang ma bral bar// rtsal snang lam la rtsis gdab med par mdzod// 'di ni rnal 'byor kun gyi spyi chings yin// ces zer nas da 'u 236) cag tshogs gral la i 'gro zer/ rje'i zhal nas bdag gi bla ma rin po che dang mjal na 'gro dang chog gsungs/

yang ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas khyod kyi bla ma rang byung gi ye shes de dang gnyis su med pa yin/ dngos mtshan bden grub kyi bla ma ni mjal don ga la yod/ 'on kyang rang byung ye shes 'phrul mo che 'di'i ji ltar byas kyang chog pas/ dad dang mos gus yod na rang snang dang 'tshams pa'i ston pa los mjal gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas nges bla ma rang rgyud can du yod par mi rigs te/ rang snang ye shes kyi ston pa rang ngor shar ba'i don shes bzhin pa'i ngang nas gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi 'dren ston bla ma yid bzhin nor bu i mjal snyam pa yin ma gtogs/ 237) don la bla ma dang bdag gnyis med yin pa shes bsam gsungs/ yang ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas da khyod phyogs dang zhing du ltad mo la 'gro zer nas sngar gyi 'od li'i steng du bzhag nas byon pas/ yul yangs pa can rgya che ba khyon dpag tshad mang po yod pa zhig tu/ phyi rgya mtsho rlung ri me ri long pas skor ba'i nang du/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ru dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba blta bas mi bzod pa lta bu dang*/ de'i nang du yul ring mo 'dra ba zla gam gru gsum zlum po zur brgyad gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu long pa zhing khams kyi kha dog kyang ma nges shing rang byung sna tshogs su yod pa/ de na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma sogs rang rang gis rig pa dang 'od zer dang bkod pa sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ la la khro zhing gtum pa he ru ka brtul zhugs kyi chas dang ldan pa/ bya dang ri dwags la sogs pas kyang snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi chos sgra sgrogs shing sems snang bag phebs pa/ mtsho dang rdzing bu yan lag brgyad ldan zhing*/ 238) byang chub kyi lo 'bras ldan pa'i shing gi yal ga rnams su lha'i gos pañca li ka sna tshogs 'phyang ba/ 'byung ba bzhi'i sgra skad thams cad gsang sngags kyi chos sgra/ mkha' 'gro'i brda skad/

dpa' bo'i 'gyang klu legs par 'byung zhing*/ mdor na zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa rang byung lhun gyis grub pa/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sa gzhi khod snyoms pa'i shar lho nub byang dbus dang lnga la pho brang chen po dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga dbyibs chos 'byung lta bur gnas pa'i/ shar gyi pho brang nang du rdo rje he ru ka yab yum dang dpa' bo dpa' mo dkar gsal zhi tshul dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang rang gi 'khor la zab mo sku'i rgyud chen sde lnga'i chos kyi 'khor lor skor nas bzhugs pa la/ rje'i zhal nas bdag la chos kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ gsung nas phyag phul bas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas khyod 'jig rten mngal grib kyis dbang gis ngo ma shes pa red ma gtogs/ khyod nga yis thugs kyi sprul pa yin pas gdams skal ma ṇi drug gi gnas su sku rgyud 'od gsal sgron ma'i chos yod pa'i dus bab rten 'brel 239) gyi sna kha brda byang ji bzhin mdzod dang bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po 'byung bar nges so/ mthar nga yi zhing 'dir lhags nas ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro gsungs/ yang lho'i pho brang du phebs pas rat+na he ru ka yab yum dang dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro tshogs kyis rang rang gi 'khor rnams la yon tan gyi rgyud gsum gyis chos 'khor skor nas bzhugs pa la/ rjes gtso bo la phyag phul te gdams pa'i skal ba gnang du gsol zhus tshe/ gtso bo'i zhal nas khyed mi ru 'dzin pa'i grib kyis ngo ma shes pa yin/ khyod nga yi sprul pa yin pas zab mo'i chos kyi skal ba khams dang sa lha re'i gnas su gter du yod pas/ de rten 'brel dus dbang du ma gtong bar gter nas bton te bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub dang mi 'gyang bar nga khyod kyi rigs su 'byung nas 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung bar nges gsungs nas/

'byung 'gyur gyi 240) lung gi brda byang mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa'i 'phrul brda shog dril gsum gnang nas nub phyogs la byon gsungs/ de nas nub kyi pho brang du byon pa'i pad+ma he ru ka yab yum gyis pad+ma dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gsang sngags gsung rgyud bzhi yis chos kyi 'khor lor skor nas bzhugs pa la/ rjes gtso bo la phyag phul nas dbang skal zhus pas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas khyod bod mi gdong dmar gyi rigs su gtogs pa'i grib kyis bsgribs pas ngo ma shes pa yin/ khyod nga yi gsung gi sprul ba yin pa'i gdams skal ngas sbyin gyis yid la chongs shig deng sang snyigs dus 'dir bod gdong dmar rnams nyon mongs pa rag cing log lta che ba chos blo zhan cing shes rab dang brtson 'grus chung ba/ le lo g.yeng ba'i las la nyin mtshan 'da' ba sogs snyigs dus kyi spyod pa rang byung de ston pa'i tshe// dbang dang drag po'i 'dul skal yin pas/ ne gro stag 241) tshang rdo rje phug mo che gnyis pa la dril ba sdong po lta bu'i chos skor rnams gter du yod pas/ de chos bdag grogs bcas rten 'brel ldan na chos 'dis 'dzam gling sum char khyab nas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ mthar bzang ngan 'brel thog thams cad zhing 'dir dgod par the tshom med do gsungs nas/ kla klo 'joms byed kyi man ngag shog dril gnyis gnang nas byang phyogs kyis pho brang du byon gsungs/ yang byang gi pho brang du byon pas karma he ru ka yab yum gyis karma dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshogs la dmod pa phrin las rgyud gnyis kyis chos 'khor skor nas yod pa la/ rjes gtso bo yab yum la phyag phul nas dngos grub gdams skal zhus pas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas khyod nga yi sprul pa yin kyang 'khor ba'i grib kyis ma shes pa yin pas/ nga yis khyod la gdams skal ster 'ong gsungs nas lho

242) nub mtshams su sdigs mdzub gtad nas yul phyogs ya gi na mchod rten bya rung kha shor zer ba 'phrul gyi pho brang chen po'i lte ba'i thad du gru gang gsum gnam lcags las grub pa'i ru sbal gyi sgrom du rta mgrin yang gsang nag po'i chos skor rnams yod pas/ de gter gnas bton la rim gyis brda byang ltar spel dang*/ snyigs dus kyi rgud pa thams cad sel zhing phan bde don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub nas/ mthar thug zhing 'dir ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du sangs rgyas par the tshom med do gsungs/ de nas dbus kyi pho brang du phebs pa'i them skas kyi nang nas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal byon nas a ma'i bu sku khams bde 'gro don 'byung ngam gsungs/ rje de nyid gdul bya la thugs sun shin tu che bas/ mtsho rgyal mjal ma thag tu thugs ngal mdzad de/ nga rang gi 'jig rten du 'gro don 'ong ba lta zhog rang gzhan chos la brten nas sdig pa tshab 243)chen po bsags par byed pa 'dug pas/ da nga rang 'jig rten du 'gro mi dgos pa zhig ci nas kyang mdzad du gsol gsungs nas zhu ba mang du phul/ yang mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod da dung thugs sun mi dgos dang*/ ma nga yi dngos nyams rmi lam thams cad du 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur bstan pa sogs byas te bdag gi bu bzhin bskyang ba yin pas/ da dung bai ro dang g.yu sgra'i smon lam gyi las 'phro ma rdzogs pas khyod 'jig rten du byon dgos gsungs nas/ 'gro don gdul bya'i yul 'dul byed kyi zab gter 'phel rgyas kyi grogs dang*/ smon log gi rkyen log pa thams cad lung bstan shog dril bcas gnang nas smon lam btab/ yang rje'izhal nas/ drin chen a ma mtsho rgyal ma// sprang bdag la thugs rjes dgongs nas kyang*// thugs zhi bar mi gzim gsan du gsol// bu bdag gi gnas tshul 'di ltar lags// chung lo ngo gsum nas pad 'byung mjal// lo

244) bcu nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod rnyed// dus 'di nas bzung da bar thug gi bar// bstan 'gro ba'i don chen kho nar bsam// dka' spyad dang snying rus drag po yis// las bya ba 'gro ba'i don du brtson// dus snyigs ma'i mi rnams rgyud ngan pas// don ji ltar sgrub kyang dug bzhin mthong*// rten 'brel 'byung log lam kho nar gtong*// lha dkon mchog gsum po rgyab tu bskyur// gdon nag phyogs dri za skyabs su bsten// las mi dge bcu la sman bzhin brtsam// chos zab mo rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad// rkun jag dang rngon pa'i bya ba brtson// nub srin po gdong dmar ji bzhin du// nor longs spyod til 'bru tsam la yang*// mi mang po'i srog la bsdo bzhin 'phrog// sdom dam tshig ngo tsha g.yang lugs bud// gnyis phung gi las la rgyun du spyod// da de sogs snyigs ma'i rang rtags ngom// dus mi 'gyur mi rnams shugs kyis 'gyur// phyi 'byung ba'i 245)bcud nyams tshe bsod phra// nad mtshon dang mu ge'i 'jigs pa dar// rang byas kyi las 'bras dus min tshe// lha dkon mchog gsum la leg par lta// dus 'di 'dra'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshe// bu bdag gis bstan 'gror cis phyir sman// lar 'jig rten khams su mi 'gro zhu// zhes gsungs pas/ yang ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod sngar bai ro dang g.yu sgra yin dus bod kha ba can la chos kyi sgron me btsugs nas lcags khams gser du bsgyur te/ bod khams dkar po chos kyi bstan gzhi btsugs shing dus da bar bde ba la bkod/ de'i smon lam stobs kyis da ris zal mo sgang du bdud srin gdug pa 'dul phyir lang gro bai ro g.yu sgra gsum gyi sprul pa bu khyed yin pas/ thugs bsam dang thugs rgya bskyed la bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzod dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na zhing 'dir byon dus ma ngas bsu

246)ba la 'ong gsungs nas zhal ta mang du mdzad/ yang rje'i zhal nas bai ro g.yu sgra gnyis dus mnyam yin pas/ sprul pa gcig gi don cis phyir yin lags zhus pa/ yang mkha' 'gro zhal nas sprul gzhi gcig la sprul pa gsum du 'byung ba yin/ sku sprul shes rab pad+ma gsal/ gsung sprul rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po/ thugs sprul lo chen bai ro yin pa dang*/ ma zad dus gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i sprul pa sum stong tsam yang byon srid pa yin pas/ sprul gzhi dang sprul pa mtha' gcig tu nges pa cha tshod med/ sku phreng rim par brgyud pa rnams 'di ltar du gsal bar ltos gsungs nas shog dril gcig gnang*/ de nas rje'i phyag nas bzung ste pho brang nang du 'gro gsungs te byon pas/ gu ru'i g.yas gral g.yon gral rnams su rje 'bangs grogs lnga dang*/ 247)rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma bzhugs nas/ bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas yod pa la/ rjes phyag phul nas phyir mi ldog par smon lam btab pas/ de ma thag tu gu ru rin po che seng ge sgra sgrogs kyi skur bzhengs nas thugs brtse ba chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ rigs kyi bu da dung khyod bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don ma rdzogs pa yin/ 'dir tshogs gral du bzhugs par dus la ma bab/ nga yi rgyal tshab yin pas da dung 'jig rten du byon la 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig gsungs nas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rgyal thabs spyi blugs su bskur/ de nas gu ru zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs te/ them med zhal gdams shog dril lnga gnang*/ yang rje'i zhal nas phyag phul bzhin 'di skad gsungs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// mthong ba don ldan dongs grub 'byung ba'i gnas// rgyal kun phrin las rang gzugs rdo rje 'chang*/ 248)/pad+ma sam bha khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// bdag ni 'jig rten yul du mi ldog cing*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang*// 'bral med tshom bu gcig tu zhing 'di ru// 'dug par spro bas bka' yi gnang ba stsol// zhes zhus pas/

gu ru'i zhal nas bu khyod nga dang gnyis su med pa yin pas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin rnams kyang nga'i phrin las su shar bas nam yang 'du 'bral med do/ zhing lnga bkod pa dang bcas pa nga yi sprul pa dang yon tan yin pas gzhan na zhing khams dang lha zhes bya ba med do/ rang snang du ngo shes par gyis shig dus la bab tshe zhing 'dir longs spyod rdzogs sku thob par 'gyur ro gsungs/ yang rje'i zhal nas bdag gu ru nyid dang gnyis su med pa nga'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi don du sgrub thabs byin rlabs che la grub thag nye ba tshig nyung la don 'dus pa zhig gnang du gsol zhus tshe/ gu ru'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu ngas rjes 'jug rnams 249) la zhal gdams shog dril gyi nang na lcags khams gser du bsgyur ba'i man ngag nangs bsgom na nang sangs rgyas/ nub bsgom na nub sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa yod do/ 'on kyang gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams kha drang ba'i phyir du thabs zab mo'i gdams skor rnams mdo smad khams kyi rdzong du brag seng ge gnam du 'phyong 'dra'i mgul na zab chos gsang ba snying khrag gi chos skor rnams gter nas bton la bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzod cig chos 'di nyams su len pa'i skal ldan rnams tshe 'phos ma thag tu zhing 'dir skye bar the tshom med do/ gsungs nas thams cad tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol zhing*/ rje 'bangs rnams kyis zhal gdams bslab bya lung bstan re re gnang ba rnams gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang bai ro g.yu sgra rdo rje mtsho mgon skyid la sogs pa'i mched lcam rnams kyis pho brang gi phyi rol du 250)skyel ma mdzad/ khyad par ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gtsug g.yu nor bu 'od 'bar dang gser gab pad+ma stong ldan rnams sku tshab su gnang nas bu khyod nga dang nam yang 'bral ba med pas/ khyod la legs nyes kyi bya ba ji ltar byung yang ma nga la gsol ba thob dang ci dgos kyi lung bstan 'ong gsungs nas pho brang du phebs/

rje de nyid kyang thugs skyo bzhin du sngar kyi ḍāk+ki gnyis dang bcas te byon pas/ rje'i zhal nas sngar gyi yul rigs mi 'dra ba de dag ci red/ zhing khams 'di la ming ci skad zer zhus pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas zhing khams 'di rang snang 'og min pad+ma bde ldan brtsegs pa zhes bya ba dang*/ yul rigs 'di rnams nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul chen/ de dag gi bar mtshams su yod pa thams cad he ru ka'i gnas dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgya la sogs pa yin no/ zhing 'di rnams kyi bkod pa ma brjed par yid la zungs shig gsungs ma thag tu glo bur du mnal las sad do/ 251) de nas sku mtshams grol nas dge btsun mkhas dbang dang dam ldan 'ga' la/ yab rje bla ma'i gsung chos 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi gdams khrid gnang skabs/ dge btsun mkhas dbang rgya mtshos zhus pa/ gter chen rin po che lags mdang sum bdag gi rmi lam la bud med rma bya'i lwa ba gyon pa gcig byung nas skal ldan khyod sang nyin bla ma'i drung du song la/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams kyi man ngag zab mo zhig phab pa'i dus la bab 'dug de bskul zhing gsol ba thob dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar nges so/ zer ba rmis pas bdag cag rnams kyi chos skal zab gter 'beb thub bka' drin mi chung zhu zhes rin po che sna tshogs bcas yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ rje nyid nas kyang dus babs su dgongs nas gsang ba 'phrul yig gi chos skor mtsho rgyal zhu lan gsal ba'i sgo 252)'byed dang*/ zhing bkod kyi mthong snang*/ mtsho rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs dbang dang bskyed rdzogs lag len dang bcas pa gtan la phab nas rim bzhin skal ldan rnams la spel ba sogs mdzad nas khong rnams kyi re ba ma lus pa bskang*/ de nas rim gyis byon nas rdza stod du phebs te/ rtsi dam pa'i sgrub phug nas yang zab snying thig gi chos gter rnams ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te spyan drangs/

de nas rdza rgya dgon du phebs nas sku nus chung ba rdzogs chen dpal dge'i yang sprul nam mkha' 'jigs med gdan sar 'khor cing mtshams sprul rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ de skabs mtshams sprul rin po che'i zhal nas khyod la mtsho rgyal sku 'dra gter byon ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug pas/ de nga rang la gnang dgos/ gter rdzas gzhan pa rnams kyang mjal dgos gsungs/ rje'i thugs 253)la rdzun zhus mi nyan bla ma red/ rdzas gter rnams gzhan gyis ma rig na dga' dgongs nas/ lags nga rang la rdzas gter rtsa ba can ngo mtshar ba cang med gsungs/ yang mtshams sprul rin po ches nga rang la mdangs sngags srung mas zer ba yin pas khyod la yod nges pa red/ da nas song la khyer shog gsungs/ de nas rje bla ma'i bka' bzhin gter rdzas rnams ma lus par phyag bsnams mdzad de mdun du byon/ rten sgam bla ma'i phyag tu phul bas/ gter rdzas rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pas de dag gi rgyu grub tshul gyi rten 'brel thol byung du gsungs nas ming re re btags/ rtsa ba sdong po yal ga stag ma 'bru'i gter kha thams cad lung du bstan/ khyad par mchims phu'i gter byon mtsho rgyal sku tshab dang gtsug g.yu las grub pa'i sgrol ljang gi sku gzi sgrom bcas mtshams sprul rin po che la phul bas thugs dgyes pa chen por mdzad/ da dung khyod kyi 254) gter sgo na mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar shin tu rgyas pa zhig phab rgyu 'dug pas de bdag la phab dgos gsungs te/ rin po che dang po dang gsang sngags kyi rdzas mchog rdo rje dril bu bcas gnang nas yang yang bskul/ rje de nyid kyis kyang rjes sor nas zab chos 'beb rgyu zhal gyis bzhes nas phar tshur kun thugs mthun rjes brtse ba chen pos gdams khrid sogs kyi bgro gleng mang po mdzad cing thugs su chub par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis rang yul la phebs nas nye bar thon tshe yab rje bla ma dang sngar gyi bkod pa rnams dran cing thugs chung shin tu mdzad nas bla mar gsol ba btab tshe/

de nub mnal lam la bla ma rin po che'i zhal gzigs nas rje de nyid la thugs gsos kyi zhal ta dang lung bstan du ma gsungs/ de nas rim gyis byon pa'i sku nus chung ba rdo rje dgra 'dul dang*/ a skyabs sprul sku sogs yul mi kun gyis bsu ba la thon byung nas thams cad gshin gson 'phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro 255)chen po byas/ de skabs su rje'i zhal nas bso sprul sku khams bde mo yin nam/ da ris 'di kar mi byon pa ci yin gsungs tshe/ khong rnams kyis ci yin ma go zer ba la/ dgung mo a skyabs sde btsan gyis smras pa/ nga rang gi yul phyogs pa re la thug pas/ bso sprul sang gyod kha cu zad la rkyen nas bswo thog gam rdzong gnas su byon yod zer 'dug pas sku khams bde nges red zer/ de nas gdan sar phebs nas lugs gnyis gang thad nas bla ma'i gdan tshab 'ong ngas byas te chos srid kyi bstan pa bskyangs/ dgun zla ba bcu gcig gi nang du bso sprul gyi gnas gdan sa ser dgon du rje de nyid byon nas zla ba cha shas re de kar bzhugs shing zab gter gsar phab mdzad pa dang*/ bso sprul rin po che la man ngag gsang ba'i gdams khrid rnams gcig brgyud du gnang ba dang*/ gzhan skal ldan rnams la'ang rang rang 'tshams pa'i chos dang gdams khrid gnang 256)ba sogs mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer dgu'i lor 'dus sde skal ldan du mar yab rje bla ma'i zab gter gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs gsungs nas gsal khyab tu spel bar mdzad/ sngar rje dbus la byon skabs yab rje bla ma zhing khams su yib/ sku mched dang ma yum la sogs pa sbas yul du 'byon/ gzhan yang gzungs ma 'khor slob thams cad rang skal gyi dngos rdzas ci yod khyer nas rang yul la song ba rnams kyang gdan sar 'dus pa'i phyag rdzas shin tu srab pas/ thams cad kyis rje de nyid gdul bya cung zad la byon dgos zhus nas/ nye gnas 'od 'bar dang*/

phyug shul kar don/ sgo pa chos gsal la sogs pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis sta gon byas te/ khro kho'i rgyal sar phebs/ de skabs su gdul bya 'phel 'grib song ba la/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan nas sngar tshe rabs kyi las lha gnod sbyin tsi dmar gyi gsol mchod dgos zer ba la/ de ltar byas pas 257)gang 'dod kyi phyag rdzas 'byor/ de nas khro kho kun la srung skyobs rim gro sogs gang 'dod dang*/ ser sde rnams la dbang khrid zab gter gsar phab spel ba sogs mdzad/ khong rnams kyis 'bul sdud dang zhabs tog chen po bsgrub nas gdul bya mtha' rgyas su 'byung ngo*/ de skabs su sngar 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gdan sa red zer ba'i nye logs na thang chen po zhig gi dkyil du 'bur gsum yod pas/ de ma gza' dam gsum gyi gnas yin par dgongs nas gsol mchod mdzad pas/ khong rnams kyi zhal bstan nas gang bcol gyi phrin las sgrub par ched('ches?)/ de ka nas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag gi chos skor rta mgrin lcags ral nag po'i chos gter bse sgrom rdo sgrom la sgrom gsum spyan drangs shing ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can du ma byung nas der 'dus thams cad yi rang nas dad mos kyi gsos su 'gyur/ de skabs gnod sbyin yin zer ba'i ban+de 258)zhig 'ong nas khyed da 'gor mi nyan pa 'dra/ ha li kun mo ni khyed med pas sdug bsngal dang mnol grib kyi song nas nad byung ba dang*/ bza' bca' sogs kyang mi ster ba'i lan 'dug pas myur du byon zer nas yal song bas/ rje'i thugs dgongs sad ha li de yul par bcol gtam legs par byas yod pas kho rang la sdug bsngal de tsam med/ khyad par mug bkres lhag gsum 'ong don med/ nad byung nges pa yin dgongs nas thugs ma bde ba'i de la rkyen nas rim gyis myur du gdan sar phebs tshe/ ḍāk+ki lung bstan ltar ha l̥'i lus po mes tshig nas rma ru song*/

byang khog mu ge byung nas 'chi la thug 'dug pas/ rje'i thugs shin tu skyo nas snyigs dus kyi mi la blo gtad med pa 'di ci red dgongs nas/ ha li la da phan chad khyod ngas mi skyur gsungs shing zhal gtugs te gces gces mdzad tshe/ ha lis kyang rje'i zhal la blta/ 259)mig nas 'chi ma 'ong gyin 'dug pas lhag par du rje'i thugs kyis mi bzod nas sgar pa'i mi go bar byas te/ ha li la rim gro dang rma bcos sogs mdzad nas nad las thar bar mdzad/ de nas zla ba bcig (bcu gcig?)pa'i nang du yab rje bla ma'i zab gter phur pa zla sgrub kyis dbu bzhugs mdzad nas sgrub pa la 'tshogs yod skabs su/ dpa' bo las rab rtsal gyi rnam sprul du bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ rgya rung rnam sprul legs pa'i rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar mdzad nas/ gter chen bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pas bka' gleng dang gsung phrin bskur ba la/ khyod da lo nga'i sar 'ong na phan tshun kun la rten 'brel gyi dgos pa chen po yod pa dang*/ khyad par bdag gi zab gter gyi mjug dang*/ gdul bya'i lhag ma thams cad khyed la dbang ba yin pa dang yang sgos nga'i gter grogs gnas zhing las 260)skyes pa rigs ldan gyi mi mo kalpa bha dra ta re zhes pa de khyod kyi grogs su smon lam yod pas/ da lan lhan du nga'i sar 'ong stabs ldan nas zab gter rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar sa gsum 'gran zla dang bral ba yong nges pa ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'khrul med du yod pas/ de lugs kyi stabs 'grig thabs la ma 'chug gsungs 'dug pas/ rje'i mtshams grol ma thag tu byon dgos snyam nas de lugs mdzad tshe/ bla brang gi khur thang pa rnams kyis da lo 'u cag la mo ngan yod pas/ thog mar 'brog skor la byon dgos zer nas phyi bshol du lus/ de nas dgung lo sum cu'i lor khong rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar 'brog skor la byon/

de rjes mgar ra gter ston mdun du byon dgongs kyang dus las yol te/ gter ston zhing du byon song ba snyan tshe thugs chung mdzad nas gsol 'debs dang 'o dod 'bod pa'i nub gcig gzim 261)lam la bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pas zhal gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs/ dpa' bo bdag ni zhing du 'gro don lhag /sangs rgyas bstan pa byang nas byang du dar// gdul bya ma zad 'dul byed rdzogs mi 'gyur// nga yi gdul bya'i lhag ma khyod la rag /thabs dang shes rab rten 'brel ma 'dzol na// zab gsang bla med bstan pa'i nyi gzhon bkra// bsod nams tshogs kyi zhing sa dam pa la// zab chos pad+ma snying thig dpal du lon// de yi bstan pa shar gyi phyogs nas dar// zhes gsungs nas rin po che'i gzhong pa la 'bru sna tshogs kyis bkang ba/ de'i steng na me long dar sna lngas brgyan pa zhig dang*/ shog dril gcig bcas gnang nas zab chos pad+ma snying thig 'bras bu lta bu ni chos yin pas/ skal ldan re 'ga' re 'ga' tsam ma gtog gzhan la ma ston cig gsungs/ yang rje'i 262)zhal nas bla ma rin po ches khyod bdag cag rnams kyi dpal du mi bzhugs pa zhing du byon pa ci lags/ da dung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang sems can gyi bde skyid/ yang sgos gu ru pad+ma'i rang lugs kyi bstan pa dar ba'i phyir du zab gter 'dzin skyong nus pa'i yang sprul zhig bdag gi rigs su byon na chog snyam zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas bdag gi 'di phyogs su gdul bya'i lhag ma tsam zhig min pa rdzogs song bas/ da lo khyod kyi rigs su bdud 'joms rdo rjai'i zla zhon de ngom rab yod gsungs shing rtsed mtshar gyi tshul du 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan du ma gsungs te thugs brtse brtse mdzad nas mi snang bar song*/ yang mkha' 'gro ye shes dbang mo yin skad pa zhig gis khyod kyi brda don 'di rnams i go gsungs tshe/

rjes ci yin cha ma chod zhus pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ rin chen gzhong pa sna tshogs 'brus bkang ba// khyod kyi bsod nams longs spyod rgyas 263)pa'i brda// de steng dri bral me long gsal ba 'di// ka dag spros bral thig le nyag gcig la// gzugs brnyan gsang mdzod sna tshogs dbang ba'i brda// sna lnga'i dar gyis mdzes par bkra ba 'di// zhing lnga'i mkha' 'gro grogs su dbang ba'i brda// de steng shog dril gnang ba 'di// zab pa skor bzhi chos kyi mdzod/ khyed la dbang ba'i lung byang brda// brda dang brda lan ma go na// gu ru pad+ma'i bu skal min// yid gnyis the tshom ma byed par// mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ji bzhin du// rten 'brel gnad la gzab gal che// zhes dang*/ bdud 'joms rdo rje'i thugs brgyud bskul ba'i gsol 'debs lung bstan rnams gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur pas mnal las sad do/ de nas zla ba cha shas song skabs yum la sras zhig yod pas/ rje de nyid kyi thugs dgongs la sngar bla ma rin po che zhing du byon khar bskal pa khyi'i lor 'u cag pha bu thug 'ong gsungs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i 264)lung bstan rnams la'ang da lo rigs sras zhig yod pas gzab gal che zer 'dug pas/ sngar sangs rgyas gling pa'i yang sprul dam grib kyi dbang du song ba yin pas da res sku rim zhig bsgrub dgos 'dug dgongs te phur pa'i sku mtshams la bzhugs/ gzhan yang rim gro sogs legs par bsgrubs rjes yar tshes la yum la gnod pa med par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas sku 'khrungs ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba yin no/ de nas dgung lo sum bcu so gcig lor bso sprul rin po ches gdan 'dren mdzad nas lha sde phan tshun thams cad kyi nang du gdan 'dren byas nas 'bul sdud sogs kyi zhabs tog rgya chen po bsgrubs/ de skabs su mkha' 'gro ral gri 'bar ma yin skad pa'i 'di skad zer/

ho hoḥ shar 'od lan mi bdun nub tu chas/ 265)khong dpyid kyi rgyal mos dbyangs snyan sgrogs// ri phag sna 'dra ba'i g.yas zur na// brag hom khung lto bar zab pa'i gter// gnam lcags kyi sbal sgrom nag po'i nang*// gsod byed kyi 'char ka'i las tshogs yod// bya rgod po'i nam 'phang gcod pa'i dus// dngos grub kyi pha phog de dus longs// des kla klo'i bstan pa lo brgyad bzlog /brda go 'am pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// zhes zer ba'i brda byang byung bas/ zab gter gsang thabs su bzhes nas gter sgrub mdzad tshe/ shog ser bdun 'dug kyang rtsa sgrub tsam zhig phab/ gzhan bka' gnyan pas phab ma thub par shog ser du bzhugs/ de nas dgung lo so gnyis lor gser smad phyogs su byon skabs/ rje de nyid kyi dngos slob bso sprul rin po che yang gnyan sar byon zhor la lhan du phebs nas don gnyis kyi mdzad pas gzugs can gzugs med kyi 'gro ba rnams chos lam la 266)blo bkod/ de skabs su rje de nyid la dad 'dun che ba'i yon bdag rnams kyis gsol chang mang po drangs nas bzi ba'i tshul mdzad tshe/ yul de'i rgyal po gdugs can zhig yod pa de mi spre'u'i mgo can zhig tu sprul nas rje'i mdun sar (rnye ?)'ong bas/ rje'i mkhyen bzhin ma gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad nas bzhugs/ khos lcags kyi sder mo rno ba zhig phud nas rje'i thugs kar tshad rtsam byed dus/ rje de nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi zil gyis mnan nas sku drung phur bu zhig yod pa de kho rang la gdengs ba'i tshe/ kho yang je chung je chung du song nas ban sprang lta bu'i gzugs bstan te smre sngags kyi tshig 'di skad zer/ tsi tsi ra ma mtho rtsal che/ khyed ban bon sngags pa rgyug grangs mang*// nga yul med 'khyams pa'i 'dre gdon la// sngags pas phur bu cis phyir gdengs// da nga 'gro rang yul phyogs su 'gro/ khyed rang nga gnyis gyod 'grigs snyam// nged cag

267)khyod la gnod mi bya// zhes zer nas 'gro grabs byed kyang ting nge 'dzin gyis bcing bas 'gro ma nus/ rje'i zhal nas/ khyod yul kun nyul ba'i stobs po che// skye 'gro yongs kyi srog la gnod// ma rungs cho 'phrul ston la mkhas// dgon sde bla ma yongs la 'tshe// las ngan sna tshogs rang gis bsags// phyi ma mnar med gnas su lhung*// de 'dra'i las ngan khyod re sdug /nga gu ru pad+ma'i bu gcig yin// chos bdud gcod zab mo'i gdams pa yod// yul gnyis 'dzin gcod pa'i phur bu 'di/ khyed 'khrul snang dngos por 'thas pa'i lus// ma lus thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag /'khrul med ye shes chen por āḥ gsungs pas kho na re da dung nga 'jig rten 'dir 'dug pa spro bas da ris khyod kyi thugs dam glod par mdzod dang*/ ngas khyod kyi dbang lung khrid gsum thob tshad dang*/ tha na chos kyi 'brel ba dang*/ dad pa yod tshad 268)kun la gnod mi byed zer nas khas blangs dam bcas sogs byas/ rjes kyang thabs gang drag gis sems can gzhan la yang gnod pa mi nyan gsungs pas/ de ltar ci lcogs byed zer nas rlung 'tshubs zhig tu gyur nas song*/ yul der lo 'gar mi phyugs kun la rgyal gdon gyi gnod pa zhi bar byed pa byung*/ de nas dgung lo so gsum lor stag thog gong ma'i nang du byon skabs/ nyag gter rin po che gdul byar byon pa dang mjal 'phrad mdzad tshe/ yab rje bla ma'i gsung chos 'od gsal ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi khrid gzhung rtsod gzhi mdzad nas nyin zhag 'gar rtsod pas/ las gling gi zhal nas khyed kyi slob ma 'gas blo ma'i sku bla btsong nas lta ba min pa mang po bshad 'dug pas/ da lan khyod bla ma'i sras yin yang dgongs pa lon i yod mi shes bsam nas dri rtsod byas pa yin pas/ da lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi 'jog mtshams 269)gnad 'gags ci 'dra yin gsungs pas/ rje'i zhal nas bdag gis yab rje bla ma'i dgongs zur tsam zhig las len par bka' na yang lta sgom spyod 'bras gnad bsdus kyi 'jog mtshams skye med du thag chod/

yengs med du rgyun skyongs/ 'gags med du rtsal sbyong*/ blo 'das su la zla ba'am dka' gnad kyi tshigs su bstan pa yin gsungs pas/ gter chen nyid thugs shin tu dgyes shing pha rjes bus non zer ba 'di ltar dgos/ da khyod kyi bla ma'i lta ba 'di red zer na kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung dang bcas pa min par nges so gsungs nas gzhan yang chos kyi bgro gleng mang du mdzad/ der 'dus kyi slob 'bangs grwa tshang kun gyis gcig gis gcig la bla ma nyag gter ni mkhas grub gnyis ldan du yin 'dug 'u cag gi sprul sku sang ni bslab sbyang gang mang ma brtson kyang da lan chos rtsod las rgyal kha thob pa 'di ngo mtshar che zer 270)nas nang grwa thams cad kyis dga' dga' byas/ de'i bar skabs bso sprul rin po che bde gnas brag dkar la byon song ba snyan tshe thugs chung mdzad nas da ni bsu ba la byon dgos dgongs te bzhugs yod skabs dub yol zhig mdzad tshe/ g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i bud med dar mthing gi lwa ba mnab pa phyag na me long dang mda' dar 'dzin pa zhig gis 'di skad zer/ e eḥ lho'i gser gyi ba dan 'od po che// byang 'brong gi khu ru ngoms pa'i tshe// nub rus sbal nag po'i mkhun pa 'debs// mi shes ldan blo yi ma go na// thang dkar pos sa lam gcod la ltos// dbyar skyes kyi 'dzum mdangs shar ba'i dus// grogs thog ma'i ming gis tshe 'phrang sel/ khong mi mo'i g.yo 'phrul rang la ston// thabs shes rab can gyi ma dpyod na// don gnyis kyi nor bu gzhan dbang srid// stod srin bya'i ngar skad 'brug la 'gran/ 271)/rgya stag gi ri mo mdangs ldan kyang*// ku ku yi mjug mas 'gran nyen yod// lha gnod sbyin chen por las bcol na// rkyen cho 'phrul ngan pa de yis sel// zhes zer zhing mdun thad de kar mar bab nas me long gsal ba 'di la ltos dang gsungs pas 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan sna tshogs kyi brda don rnams gsal bas/

rje'i zhal nas mi min lha yi grogs lnga dang*/ mchog gi gzungs ma gnyis la dbang ba'i dgos pa ji ltar yin gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas khyod grub chen ku ku ras pa'i dus lus med mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad nas lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i dngos med rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad/ de skabs lha yi bu mo 'od ldan dang*/ klu'i bu mo zla ba/ grul bum gyi bu mo gan dzar/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo gzugs legs/ skye dgu'i bdag mo re ma dza rnams kyi smon lam 272)gyi mthu la brten nas dus da bar la gang 'dod kyi dngos grub ster zhing las bsgrub/ khyad par khyed kyis dngos su gzugs med rnams chos la btsud cing thar pa byang chub kyi lam ston mdzad tshe khong rnams grogs su 'gyur ba yin no/ de dag kyang sngon gyi smon lam gyi las 'phro sad pas dpa' bo khyed kyi gdul byar gyur pa yin/ mchog gi gzungs ma ni skye ba smon lam dgos pa yon tan thams cad kha byang sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig nang du gsal la/ don la dpa' ba'i stong dbyings btsun mor shar ba yin pas tha dad yod pa ma yin no/ gsungs ma thag gtam gyi mjug ma rdzogs kyang gzhan rkyen gyis glo bur du mnal sad do*/ de nas dgung lo so bzhi'i lor mkhar nang gong ma'i nang du byon yod skabs mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas go mchog rang byung gi gnas dang*/ sbas gnas gsang phug rnams su zab gter 'byin pa'i dus tshig yod pas de kar byon dgos dgongs nas 273)yod tshe/ yang bdud 'joms pa'i zhal mjal nas 'di skad gsungs/ ho hoḥ bu chung dri ma med pa// yid kyi dwangs mtsho'i mos pa// thos byed sno (sne ?)la btang nas// don 'di yid la zungs dang*// nor bu 'od mdangs gsal 'ong*// shel bum dri ma med pa/ khyod kyi lag tu son tshe// gter gnyis bstan pa'i pad tshal// shar dang lho nas dar ba'i// thabs mkhas dbang gis lcags kyus// 'dren byed nus pa ma zhan// cang shes rtsal ldan ngang pas// rang skal chu la 'thung tshe/

khwa ta rog po'i bsam ngan// ha la'i me tog mdangs rgyas// tshul khrims lha yi ljon shing*// dpyid kyi rgyal mos bsus 'gro// gter srungs las la bskul na// pha rol nus pa bcom nges// yar mar tshes bcu gnyis la// ga ṇa'i 'khor lo ma chags// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i grogs ldan// dus dang dus su byed 'ong*// srid pa'i 'khyud 'khor gcig gi// chos brgyad thabs 274)kyis spongs la// sbas gnas rdo rje yang rdzong*// zab gter du ma'i gnas yin// de la rang tshug bzung na// don gnyis nor bu'i 'od brgya// mtha' dbus kun nas dar nges// grogs kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs// cer grol rgya yis btab na// rkyen ngan grogs su 'char nas// bden med sgyu mar mthong ste// dben par sgrub mtha' phyin nges// de dang de sogs ci 'gyur// dus su gsal ba e nam// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs 'ga' yi shog dril dang zhal ta mang du gnang nas mi snang bar yal/ de nas yab rje bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin dbang gi lha mo'i sgo nas sku mtshams la bzhugs nas kha bskang (skong?)me mchod sogs legs par grub rjes/ mchims phu'i zab gter mtsho rgyal sgrub thabs dpal ri mngon byed kyi chos sde gtan la phab nas/ chos kyi bdag po bi ma'i rnam rol bstan 'dzin dar rgyas la gsal khyab tu spel ba sogs mdzad/ de nas dgung lo so lnga'i lor bso sprul rin po che 275) rma nyen phyogs su bzhugs yod pas de kar rje de nyid byon zhor dang*/ sngar gyi mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin brag dkar gsum gyi gsang gter rnams 'don pa'i dus la bab pas/ de kar byon nas tshe ring mas dngos su grogs byas te/ chos kyi bdag po bso sprul snags rang lo bcas gter gnas rnams su byon te/ bde mchog thugs kyi gnas nas yang zab gsang ba snying khrag gi chos skor gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyi sgrub skor rin po che sna gsum las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang*/

g.yu sgrom chos sman bcas spyan drangs/ sku'i gnas dang gsung gnas rnams nas gter srung rnams kyis gter rdzas dngos su 'ong nas phul ba sogs rten 'brel gyi sna kha phun sum tshogs pa 'byung nas tshur phebs/ de nas mkhar 'gas sang gis gdan 'dren byas te/ de kar byon nas srung skyobs rim gro mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par dgon pa dang*/ bde bshegs mchod sdong bzhengs par sa 'dus mdzad skabs gang nas 'ong cha med pa'i 276)dge btsun zhig thon byung nas rje la phyag gsum phul te shog dril che ba gcig sprad nas/ 'di rang byung mchod rten bya rung kha shor nas mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo ches khyed la sprod zer 'dug pas/ mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag gi chos skor gyi kha byang yin zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ rjes shog dril de kha phyes nas gzigs tshe mthing shog ngos la gser bris kyi o rgyan brda dang*/ zangs gling gi brda gnyis su snang ba la/ rjes o rgyan gyi brda yig gtan la phab par mdzad/ zangs gling gi brda yang gter du sbas/ de'i nub gzim lam la mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ hai heḥ gzhi dbyings skye med nam mkha'i rang bzhin// gzhi snang 'gags med ye shes rol pa// gzhi rtsal rig pa don gyi ḍāk+kis// gzhir bzhengs lhun grub longs sku'i brda ston// ma 'gags brda gsang sgyu mar ngom na// e eḥ zab pa'i rnal 'byor chen po// rig 'dzin bi ma rasmi// dbang chen gsung gi 277) da lar// rang bzhin gsum du bzhugs na// dam sri'i 'tshe ba sel 'gro// rgya 'dre gdug pa'i stobs kyis// mi rung yo lang 'phrul 'gyed// bzlog phyed 'char ka nag po'i// tshe dpal rno la bsgyur mdzod// dbang gi lha mo'i phrin las// 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin// bdun phrag gsum du bsgrub na// 'chi bzlog gnad zab legs go /dbyings yum bde chen rgyal mo// lhan rkyen rnal 'byor su kha// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro grogs byed// dus tshigs rten 'brel brda rtags// 'byung ba gsher la ngom tshe// sngon gyi smon lam mthu btsan// skye 'phreng du mar thabs shes// zung 'jug bde chen pho nyar// 'bral med grogs su bcing ba'i// don gnyis nor bu rnyed nges// gzhan rkyen sab+tas bsgrib na// shel dkar rdo rje ta re// dgongs pa dbyings la gtad tshe// mkha' spyod zhing khams rang snang*// skad cig mngon du 'gyur 'ong*// pad+ma las 'brel khyod kyis// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i da lar// ga ṇa'i 'khor lo bskor yong*// me mchod las

278)kyi kha bsgyur// 'bum phrag gnad du bsnun na// glo bur rkyen snang byang 'gro// thabs mchog pho nya'i dbang phyug /shes rab mi 'gyur e waṃ// zung 'jug sbyor sgrol mthar phyin// gnyis snang ru tra bcom nas// mi 'jigs nor bu mchog rnyed// byang phyogs bdud kyi bslu ba// lho phyogs srin mo'i cho 'phrul// re zung rnam 'gyur ngom na// dmigs med ye shes chen pos// 'dzin med ngang du bsgral tshe// yul med zang thal rjen par// rang shar rang klong gzhir thim// don med gnas yul nyul nas// dgos med gzan la chags na// bung ba ro yis bslu bzhin// 'byung tshe dbyings kyi sprul pa// yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel// mi mngon dbyings la yib na// bstan 'gro'i don chen de tsam// ci dang ci 'gyur ci cha// dus su brda don gsal nges// zhes zer nas thal lcags zhig byas tshe gnyid las sad do/ 279) de nas nor bla ma 'od chung gi chos sgar steng du gdan 'dren byas nas 'bor pa gong 'gab bar gsum hor skor dang*/ pha dang*/ khang rgan la sogs pa'i bla ser thams cad 'dus pa la/ yab rje bla ma'i gter sar gyi dbang lung khrid gsum kha tshang gsung*/ gzhan yang rje'i gsung chos gsar phab spel ba sogs gsal khyab mdzad skabs/ smar gyi g.yu drung lcags rtse dang*/ gnyan po g.yu rtse/ rdza yu gser khrab rnams rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa rje'i mdun sar 'ong nas phyag phul te/ rang rang gi blo dang mthun pa'i chos 'brel mang po zhus/ de skabs g.yu drung lcags rtses rje la 'das ma 'ongs da lta rnams kyi lung bstan mang du zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas khyod mi ma yin rnams la snang srid gsal ba'i me long dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lung bstan med a gsungs pas/ kho na re nged rnams phyi ltar na sde brgyad kyi gtso bo dmar 280)la dgyes shing dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa/ nang ltar na slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan/

mgo nag mi'i dgra lha/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi mnga' bdag gsang ba ltar na dkar phyogs kyi kha 'dzin byed cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung*/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sku tshe bsring*/ sems can gyi bde skyid spel/ mtha' mi dbus su mi gtong ba sogs rgyal dbang pad+ma dang rgyal tshab rnams kyi bka' bzhin sgrub nas sa 'dzin gyi sems dpa' yin pas/ legs nyes ci 'ong gsal ba'i me long yod zer nas/ bstan pa spyi la phan pa'i lung bstan mang po smras/ khyad par da res kyi skabs khyed kyis don zab mo 'di la mi min mi ru brdzus nas bar chad cung zhig 'dug pas/ de la dam gegs bka' yi phyag rgya gal che zer nas thams cad mi snang bar gyur/ de nas zhag 'ga' song tshe mi snying rlung gis bsgul nas 'dus sde rnams la/ glo bur gyi rkyen snang 281)cung zad la brten nas mkhon mtha' cig byung skabs/ yab rje bla ma'i zhal gzigs nas lung bstan bslab bya du ma gnang*/ khyad par da lan gyi 'thab mkhon 'di'i rkyen mi ma yin rgyal gshed cig gis gnod pa yin pas/ thabs ni zhi ba chen pos dam la bzhag na yul sde phyi nang kun dang*/ dgon sde'i bla sprul rnams la gnod mi tshugs pa'i don yod gsungs/ de nas rjes kyang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin yul de kar dbang ba'i gdon zhig yod pa de thabs zhi bas sgo nas dam la btags pa sogs mdzad cing yul de bde la bkod/ de skabs g.yas ru'i chos sgar nas sgo sprul 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros kyis rje de nyid kun mkhyen chen po dngos yin gsungs nas dpon g.yog 'ga' byon te dbang khrid mang po gsan/ nga khyod kyi chos kyi bdag po yin kyang tshe ci 'dra yod mi go yang*/ skye ba phyi ris khyod kyi bstan pa 282)la zhabs zhu re 'ongs bar la thang ci yod gsungs tshe/ rje'i zhal nas khyod bdag gi chos bdag yin na nga rang gis khyod kyi sku gegs sel thabs los 'ong gsungs pas/

yang sgo sprul zhal nas rten 'brel bzang*/ da lan nga rang la tshe gegs yod kyang thabs zhig ldan 'ong gi ta/ nam zhig na ngas khyed la re ltos zhig bca' dgos thang*/ de dus lugs gnyis gang thad nas ma 'chug gsungs/ rje'i thugs dgongs su gsung mdzad 'dir bltas na sku mi bzhugs pa 'dra dgongs te/ da dung khyed bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la bzhugs dgos/ nam zhig nga sar byon dus zhabs zhu gang ldan zhu gsungs/ yang sgo sprul gyi zhal nas khyed kyis mgar ra sang gi dbus kyi mkha' 'gro ma de los shes i red gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas shes dang cha rgyus ye med/ sngar yab rje bla ma'i lung bstan dang*/ rang gter gyi kha 283)byang rnams la de dang 'dra mtshungs pa'i mtsho rgyal gsung sprul gter la dbang ba zhig yod 'dug pas/ de i yin snyam yang*/ nga rang gi gzungs ma legs pa'i sems bab yod med cha mi chod pa dang*/ khyad par mgar ra sprul sku'i sku rtsar yod pas stabs legs de tsam re gsungs/ sgo sprul gyi zhal nas kho rang gter chos yod nges pa yin 'dug kyang*/ gter grogs dang ma 'phrad nas gsang rgya dam po byas te tha mal lta bu'i spyod pa bskyang 'dug de dang khyed gnyis 'phrad na ma 'dzol ba 'dra gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas khyod dang mkha' 'gro gnyis ka cha rgyus zhib mo yod pa 'dra na/ khong la gter rigs ci 'dra 'dug gsungs pas/ sgo sprul gyi zhal nas nga rang gi mkha' 'gro mig gis rig ma myong dang*/ nga'i slob ma chos skor 'jigs chos zhes pa des mgar sprul yod sar gter chen rin po che'i gsungs chos nyams 284)len byas te/ de kar zla chas rer 'dug myong bas/ de la cha zhib yod pas lo rgyus rnams des nga la smras pa yin/ yin kyang hor bla ma 'od chung la'ang cha zhib 'dug pas/ nyin cha shas nas 'di kar 'khor lo rab gnas byed dgos pas/ dpon g.yog thams cad byon rgyu red zer 'dug khyed cag phan tshun kun la rten 'brel re yod na gzhan dbang ma gtong gsungs/

yang rje'i zhal nas nga ni nga rang gis yab rje bla ma rin po che'i bstan pa ma zin kyang*/ gcig pur dben ri zhig la 'dug snyam nas nyin mtshan med par bla ma lha la gsol ba 'debs kyin yod ma gtogs gter ston byas nas rig ma sogs rten 'brel i ldan mi bsam nges pa yin gsungs/ sgo sprul gyi zhal nas khyed pad+ma'i rgyal tshab 'khrul med yin pas/ da dung rten 'brel la rag las yod pas thugs sun ma mdzad par bstan pa dang sems can gyi don dang*/ khyad par khyed rang gi yab rje bla ma'i 285)gter mjug khyed la thug yod pas thugs gzab legs par dgos/ khyed kyi rig ma de ka nor song ni i red gsung*/ yang rjes zhal nas nor ba ma song nges pa yin/ bla ma rin po che'i sku bzhugs yod skabs kha byang bla ma'i spyan lam la brgyud nas nges (ngas ?)bzung ba yin kyang*/ de skabs gsung mdzad re yod pas de'i thog tu song ba 'dra gsung*/ sgo sprul gyi zhal nas da de ltar yin kyang thugs gzab dgos gsung nas phan tshun thugs snang mthun pa'i gsung mdzad dang*/ nyams len gnad gsang gi bgro gleng mang du gsungs nas sgo sprul gdan sar byon/ rje de nyid de kar bzhugs nas ske sang gi zur la mkhyen sprul rin po che'i sku sras zhig yod pa de dang*/ sngar yab rje bla ma'i gter rdzas rnams mkhyen sprul gyi phyag bsnams mdzad pa'i nang nas phran bu re yod pa thams cad la bdag po mdzad/ de skabs gnod sbyin chen po yin skad pa'i ban+de zhig 'ong nas 'di 286)skad zer/ rang byung chos sku'i klong yangs nas// 'gags med brda yi rol mo ngom// shes rab ldan pa'i go bar mdzod// sngon smon 'brel zab che ba yis// gtad rgya dus 'dir sad pa ni// nga yis khyed la grogs ldan byas// sprin dkar stod kyi g.yu 'brug gi// gtsug nor rang bzhin shugs kyis lon// dngos grub skyon du ma 'dzin na// thabs shes rten 'brel rab la dbang*// dus kyi 'pho 'gyur rgud pa sel// dmag 'khrugs nad yams mu ge zhi// gter gnyis bstan pa phyogs kun khyab// snyan grags byar rnga'i sgra dang mnyam// phrin las bzhi yis 'gro dbang bsdus// don gnyis dgos 'dod nor bu rnyed// de don la mor gsal bar nges// zer zhing mi snang bar gyur/

de nas zhag cha shas nas mgar ra gter chen gyi rgyal sras dang*/ mkha' 'gro dpon g.yog bcas 'khor lo rab gnas byed pa la byon 'ong skabs/ rje'i thugs dgongs la sgo sprul gyis gsungs pa ltar/ 287)rten 'brel gyi brda don rnams bgro gleng der mdzad dgos dgongs nas/ thog mar rgyal sras dang mjal 'phrad mdzad pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gros phyag gsum phul nas rje la sku khams bzang zhus te/ rin chen gnyis pa dang dar bcas mjal dar du phul nas phyag dbang blang*/ rjes kyang rten 'brel gyi thog mar dgongs nas dbang mdog 'dzin pa'i rin po che dang dar bcas gnang*/ yang mkha' 'gro sprul sku rin po che khyed kyi sgrub thabs tshig nyung la don 'dus pa byin rlabs che ba zhig bka' drin ma chung zhus nas rang gnas kyi gur nang la song*/ rgyal sras dang rje de nyid 'khor lo'i khang pa'i nang du bzhugs nas gsung mdzad zhib rgyas su mdzad/ de nas nangs snga mo rje dpon g.yog dang*/ rgyal sras mkha' 'gro dpon g.yog thams cad lhan du 'tshogs nas 'khor lo rab gnas mdzad tshe/ mkha' 'gro kun gsal ma yin skad pa'i shel gyi sgrom bu zhig 'ong nas mkha' 'gro bde ba'i rdo rje la sbyin pa rjes gzigs tshe/ bde ba'i rdo rjes 288)shel sgrom sbas pa'i tshul gyis mdun sgam gyi 'og tu bzhag rje'i zhal nas gter sgrom de khyed la ma mkho na nga rang la dgos gsung*/ mo na re gter ma red nga rang gi bu mo'i rtse rdo red zer/ rje'i zhal nas ci yin ngas mthong ba yin pas khyer shog gsung*/ bde ba'i rdo rjes kyang rje'i bka' ma gcog par gter sgrom phyag tu phul bas rje'i thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad/ de skabs bde ba'i rdo rjes rje la gsol ba/ nga rang la (las ?)ngan pa dang lus dman pa'i dbang gis gzhan don phar zhog rang don kyang phran bu tsam yang 'ong ba dka' 'dug pas/ sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu khyed kyis thugs gtad re ma 'chug dang*/
